records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
**Position Summary**
The Director, Quality is responsible for leading multiple manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality resources in the execution of the overall STERIS Quality System. This position is principally responsible for manufacturing/service site or functional quality system execution to drive product/service quality improvement and ensure compliance with, as appropriate, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA QMSR CFR Part 820/211, EU MDR, and other applicable standards. Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.
 
 
Preferred onsite location: Mentor, OH, with consideration for candidates based in Plymouth, MN or Conroe, TX.
 
 
**What You’ll Do As a Director Quality**

* The Director, Quality will have responsibility for the following: Leads manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality staff in the execution and continuous improvement of the STERIS Quality System. Operates with a focus on the following objectives:

+ Ensures site level compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
+ Drives strategies and methods to continuously improve capital, consumable and service product quality performance.
+ Establishes clear and consistent quality measurement systems in order to monitor and drive results.
+ Leads quality planning and the execution of assigned New Product/Service Development (NPD) projects to achieve targeted quality deliverable adherence.
+ Drives targeted supplier quality improvement efforts and oversees supplier evaluation, approval, and control for assigned manufacturing sites.
+ Assists in the continuous improvement and standardization of quality system procedures and monitor effectiveness.
+ Supports the reliability function by integrating design for reliability tools and techniques within the local projects.
+ Leads quality planning efforts through cross-functional teaming at a site level.

* Supports the New Product/Service Development process and projects to ensure projects attain cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Directs local staff on planning sequential and concurrent quality activities. Establish planning and monitoring tools and techniques.
* Provides Quality viewpoints and opinions in planning and specifying existing and future products.
* Assists in the development of the Quality budget. Helps to ensures resources are adequate to fully support the Quality System.
* Takes ownership of all local quality issues, projects, and development activities. Works closely with the site’s Senior Management Teams to provide strategic direction and development of the manufacturing sites product quality strategies and tactics.
* Manages and provide direction to a teams of quality professionals both at corporate and manufacturing sites, with responsibility for hiring, performance management, appropriate staffing, and deployment of resources.
* Assures that local sites maintain and improve operational and quality systems to remain in a state of compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
* Works closely with the regulatory function to ensure compliance to appropriate ISO and FDA standards; plans for and assists in the management of external audits.
* Leads manufacturing and service site quality teams to ensure alignment to operations, support of Lean efforts and drive quality improvement performance for products, services, and processes across the sites.
* This individual has autonomy to perform the duties of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) on behalf of STERIS legal manufacturing entities under the EU MDR. This individual shall suffer no disadvantage within the organization in relation to proper fulfilment of his or her duties in lieu of article 15 of the EU MDR.

**Required**
**The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Engineering or related technical field)
* Minimum 10 years of experience with increased responsibility leading quality system and product quality improvement efforts. Exceptional leadership manifested through organizing and motivating teams toward their respective goals by employing hands-on management.
* Must fulfil the experience requirements listed in Article 15 of the EUMDR (PRRC).
* A solid quality foundation indicated by a demonstrated understanding of Lean/Six Sigma, quality system, and product/process improvement methodologies.
* Solid business acumen and proven ability to build and lead process and product improvement strategies and results.
* Strong expertise in analytical methods, quality systems, and continuous improvement methods.
* Excellent interpersonal, as well as verbal and written communication skills in order to develop and maintain rapport and effective internal and external relationships to support business success.
* The ability to work hard and deliver results under pressure, as well as the willingness to address and shift priorities in rapidly changing markets.

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree.
* Experience with statistical analysis software and Visio.
* Experience in medical device industry.

**Other**

* Excellent problem-solving skills.
* Focus on identification of potential issues and continuous improvement.
* Experience working on cross-functional teams and on own initiative.
* Demonstrated excellent organizational, oral, and written communications skills.
* Must have PC experience, as well as working familiarity of desktop applications including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**What STERIS Offers**
We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being, and financial future.
 
 
**Here Is a Brief Overview Of What We Offer**

* Market competitive pay
* Extensive paid time off and (9) added holidays
* Excellent healthcare, dental, and vision benefits
* Long/short term disability coverage
* 401(K) with company match
* Maternity and parental leave
* Additional add on benefits/discounts for programs such as pet insurance
* Tuition reimbursement and continued educational programs
* Excellent opportunities for advancement in a stable long-term career

Pay range for this opportunity is $144,500.00 - $187,000.00. This position is eligible for bonus participation.
 
 
Minimum pay rates offered will comply with county/city minimums, if higher than range listed. Pay rates are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to local labor market costs, years of relevant experience, education, professional certifications, foreign language fluency, etc.
 
 
STERIS offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits portfolio. Click here for a complete list of benefits: STERIS Benefits
 
 
Open until position is filled.
 
 
STERIS is a leading global provider of products and services that support patient care with an emphasis on infection prevention. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS CREATE A HEALTHIER AND SAFER WORLD by providing innovative healthcare and life sciences products and services around the globe. For more information, visit www.steris.com.
 
 
If you need assistance completing the application process, please call 1 (440) 392.7047. This contact information is for accommodation inquiries only and cannot be used to check application status.
 
 
STERIS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity to ensure that persons are recruited, hired, trained, transferred and promoted in all job groups regardless of race, color, religion, age, disability, national origin, citizenship status, military or veteran status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, and any other category protected by federal, state or local law. We are not only committed to this policy by our status as a federal government contractor, but also we are strongly bound by the principle of equal employment opportunity.
 
 
The full affirmative action program, absent the data metrics required by
 
 

* 60-741.44(k), shall be available to all employees and applicants for employment for inspection upon request. The program may be obtained at your location’s HR Office during normal business hours.

records.title: Director of Quality Assurance
records.description:
Elevate is committed to providing the highest quality commercial roofing, wall and lining systems to solve our customers’ challenges, grounded by a 45-year legacy of proven experience. Our mission is to deliver solutions that save time, perform reliably and protect our communities. We are devoted to building partnerships rooted in trust in reflection of our Elevate promise that Nobody Covers You Better™.
 
 
Elevate is part of the Amrize family of brands. Visit ElevateCommercialBP.com to learn more.
 
 
We’re seeking a Director of Quality Assurance who’s ready to be part of a people-first company offering best-in-class products, exceptional training, and deep industry pride—all built to help our partners and team succeed.
 
 
**About The Role**
The Quality Assurance Director strategically leads the development, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive quality evaluation and control systems across the organization. This includes overseeing the design and analysis of inspection and testing processes, ensuring the precision and accuracy of products and equipment, driving root cause analysis for incidents, and establishing compliance with reliability standards and documentation requirements to uphold the highest levels of product quality and operational excellence
 
 
**What You'll Accomplish**

* Strategic Oversight - Overseeing and directing the overall operations of quality assurance within a company to ensure continuous improvement and compliance. This involves defining and promoting a quality mindset across the entire company.
* Quality Management System - Developing and implementing quality management systems to ensure product and service quality, and maintaining and improving quality standards, policies, and procedures.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight - Ensuring compliance with industry standards, regulations, and company policies, and coordinating with regulatory bodies and external auditors.
* Quality Control, Claim Mgmt, Supplier Quality - Overseeing quality control processes to ensure products meet quality standards, and conducting regular quality audits and inspections to identify and address quality issues.This also includes establishing and enforcing quality standards, testing materials and products, and developing raw material and in-process product inspection standards.
* Continuous Improvement - Leading continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency, and implementing best practices to reduce defects and improve processes. This can involve applying tools such as CAPA, SPC charts, Root Cause Analysis, and FMEA, and leading Six Sigma or Lean initiatives.
* Leadership & Team Development - Leading and mentoring the quality assurance team, fostering a culture of high performance and professional development, and ensuring the team has the necessary skills and resources. Responsible for generating a culture of collaboration across the organization.
* Budget & Financial Management - Achieving financial objectives by preparing the quality assurance budget, scheduling expenditures, analyzing variances, and initiating corrective actions.
* Customer Experience - Gathering customer feedback through gemba and data collection on quality andperformance, ensuring products meet or exceed customer expectations, and implementing changes based on feedback
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas.
* Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Mgmt, or related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* At least 8 y+ years of relevant quality, continuous improvement, manufacturing experience including at least 5 years management or direct/indirect leadership experience.
* 3+ years of QMS / ISO9001 or similar experience required.
* CMQ/QE, CQE, CQA are all preferred.
* Six Sigma certification preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators.
* Employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Retirement Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program

records.title: Director, Field Quality
records.description:
Our purpose,
*Refresh the world and make a difference*
, is uniquely us, and part of our vision includes making a positive difference in people's lives, communities, and our planet by doing business the right way.
 
 
The Director, Field Quality plays a critical role within the North America Operating Unit Supply Chain QSE organization. This position is responsible for driving the consistent execution of quality and food safety programs across company-owned and co-manufacturing operations within assigned regions. The role ensures facilities maintain audit readiness, comply with internal and external regulatory requirements, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement. By providing technical expertise and leadership, this role enables operational excellence and ensures our products meet the highest standards of quality and safety
 
 
**What You’ll Do For Us**

* Provide leadership and technical guidance for quality programs across assigned regions.
* Ensure facilities comply with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and maintain audit readiness.
* Implement and maintain foundational quality systems, including adherence to the TCCC and NAOU Quality requirements.
* Monitor regional quality metrics, consumer complaint data, and operational trends to identify and mitigate risks proactively.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action planning for quality system failures and IMCR events within assigned regions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues and support commercialization processes for new products and packages.
* Deliver quality training programs to build plant-level expertise and ensure consistent execution of standards.
* Champion digital tools and data-driven approaches to enhance quality performance and operational efficiency.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
* HACCP/PCQI Certification required.
* 8+ years of experience in quality and food safety within FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) or pharmaceutical sectors.
* Experience implementing quality assurance, quality control, and management system programs (e.g., HACCP, GFSI, ISO9000/22000, SPC).
* Strong problem-solving skills and experience with root cause analysis.
* Familiarity with digital quality and compliance systems (e.g., EtQ, SAP, SPC/InfinityQS).
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation).
* Exposure to lean/six sigma tools and methodologies preferred.
* Ability to travel 50–75% within North America.

**Skills**
Regulatory & Food Safety Knowledge, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Technical Leadership, Continuous Improvement Mindset, Quality Systems Management
 
 
**What We Can Do For You**
 
 

* Innovative Technology:  We utilize and lead the market with our large supply chain network and state-of-art technology we use each day.
* Exposure to World Class Leaders: Availability to global technology leaders that will expand your network and exposure you to emerging technologies and techniques.
* Agile Work Environment: We embrace agile with management that believes in removing barriers, so you are empowered to experiment, iterate, and innovate.

records.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
 
 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
 
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

records.description:
**About this Director of Quality Assurance role:**

The Director, Quality Assurance provides strategic leadership for the company's quality organization and Quality Management System across multiple locations. This position is responsible for ensuring product quality, regulatory and customer compliance, and the effectiveness and integrity of quality systems supporting both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume manufacturing operations. The Director leads the development of the quality organization, drives continuous improvement and operational excellence, and partners with cross-functional leadership to strengthen quality performance and support the organization's growth.

**Reports to:**
VP Operations & QA

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the quality organization across all company locations.
* Maintain and continually develop the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring process integrity and compliance with applicable customer, regulatory, and industry requirements, including AS9100 and ISO 9001.
* Establish quality strategies, standards, and control plans that support product quality, operational performance, and customer requirements.
* Lead and develop the Quality team, establishing clear expectations and building organizational capability to support current and future business needs.
* Monitor and analyze quality and manufacturing performance metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen product quality, reduce scrap and rework, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Drive effective corrective and preventive actions and promote systematic problem-solving to address quality issues and prevent recurrence.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to improve product and process quality throughout the organization.
* Ensure products and processes meet applicable customer, regulatory, contractual, and company quality requirements.
* Provide leadership and oversight for customer quality issues, supplier quality performance, audits, and other significant quality matters.
* Maintain organizational readiness for customer, registrar, and regulatory audits and ensure appropriate resolution of identified findings.
* Support capital planning, equipment investments, facility needs, and long-term manufacturing strategies from a quality and operational risk perspective.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Comply with all company policies and applicable quality, safety, cybersecurity, customer, and regulatory requirements, including ITAR/export control, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) handling, and Foreign Object Damage (FOD) prevention.
* Complete all required training and use approved methods to protect company and customer information.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or higher, ideally in Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible quality leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading quality operations across multiple locations.
* Experience supporting both high-mix, low-volume and high-volume manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading quality organizations through periods of significant growth and operational change.
* Demonstrated knowledge of Quality Management Systems and applicable quality standards, including AS9100 and ISO 9001.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* US Citizen, Permanent Resident, or Protected Individual (as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3)) preferred due to ITAR responsibilities.
* ASQ certification such as Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Experience in aerospace, defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Experience with government contracting quality requirements.
* Lean/Six Sigma certification or demonstrated continuous improvement experience.
* Experience scaling quality systems to support organizational growth.

Our client is an equal opportunity employer.

records.title: Director of Quality, Regulatory & Improvement
records.description:
***Title: Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:***
*Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Strong background in ISO 9000 system management, including training and auditing.
* Strong background in ISO 13485 system management and thorough knowledge of FDA requirements and other international standards that regulate the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of automated inspection equipment, including vision systems and coordinate measuring devices.
* Adept at delegating and managing multiple tasks with various levels of priority.
* Excellent communication skills; must be able to present ideas, results, and requirements effectively throughout the organization and to the customer on a timely basis.
* Expert skill set in applied statistics, reliability, design of experiments, MSA, GR&R, and project management.
* Fluency with various software packages commonly used in project management, database, SPC, word processing, and data acquisition.
* Analytical, problem-solving, project management, facilitation, and decision-making skills are essential.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, resolve conflict, and promote teamwork.
* Ability to see and hear the facts from several viewpoints while promoting success through interactive problem solving and teamwork.

**Experience & Education Requirements:**

* Technical degree (BS, BSE, or BSME) with a minimum of 10 years' experience in quality engineering or quality management.
* Strong preference for relevant industry experience in a metals or electrical connectors company or similar.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or Regulatory Affairs within a regulated field such as medical devices, automotive, or defense.
* Preferred certifications: Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Demonstrated project management skills in the areas of process control, SPC, automotive PPAP submission, and statistical analysis.
* Lean Green Belt or Black Belt certification, Six Sigma, and DMAIC process experience.
* Actively continuing training through courses and seminars.

***Physical Requirements:***

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
* Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities.
* Travel to other locations as required.

records.description:
**Requisition ID: 273234**
**Locations: Bishopville**
**Schedule: Start time 6:30AM Monday - Friday, weekends/holidays per business needs.**
Click here to experience a Day in the Life of our Teammates !
 
 
**Uncap Your Potential at America's Largest Coca-Cola Bottler — Pour Your Passion into Purpose!**
We're more than beverages—we're building meaningful careers and vibrant communities. Join our team where your talent meets purpose, and every teammate directly shapes our success.
 
 

* Career Growth: Clear pathways to advance and develop your career
* Competitive Benefits: 401(k) match + health coverage + employee stock purchase plan
* Purpose-Driven: Create meaningful impact in the communities you serve
* Professional Development: Dedicated training + personalized mentorship

**Join us - your refreshing new chapter starts here!**
**Job Overview**
The Director, Production will ensure that manufacturing processes run reliably and efficiently; through the management of production processes, planning and organizing production schedules, assessing project and resource requirements, and ensuring that health and safety regulations are met. T he Director will oversee the organizing of repair and routine maintenance of production equipment in collaboration with the Maintenance Manager, as well as supervising the work and leading relevant training sessions. As well as coordinate the activities of the production, maintenance, and quality assurance departments to ensure effective execution of the weekly production schedule. The Director also ensures the effective utilization of resources including staffing, equipment, and materials.
 
 
****Duties & Responsibilities****

* Conduct daily line performance review meetings with representatives from all departments to ensure production KPIs are being met and to identify potential issues impacting productivity
* Prioritize maintenance work orders in conjunction with the maintenance manager and supports team meetings to address issues that affect production line performance
* Collaborate with the Product Supply Planning team to manage raw material inventory and production schedules and ensure that production is scheduled in such a manner as to minimize downtime and maximize productivity
* Conduct daily reviews and ensure production is scheduled to avoid out-of-stock situations by resolving any issues as to consumer complaints and customer feedback; ensure cross-functional communication within the plant is timely and effective and drives efficient and effective resolutions to deliver satisfaction to both internal and external customers
* Review P&L statement weekly to ensure accuracy and manages budget for all production supplies; review daily raw materials yield reporting, investigate and resolve inventory variances; review weekly labor reporting to manage labor and ensure overtime is minimized
* Manage, lead, and motivate a team to deliver results by communicating company goals and deadlines. Engage and develop teammates through effective performance management, coaching, and training. Implement continuous improvement methods and embody company purpose and values to inspire servant leadership

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* 3-5 years of food and beverage industry experience required
* Experience with supervising associates in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to plan and execute complex projects
* Strong communication skills
* Successful background in change management and building a winning culture
* Successfully build cross-functional relationships and have a strategic vision
* Ability to lead, manage and develop a team
* Advanced PC skill - MS Office Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SAP
* Ability to stand for extended periods of time, walking manufacturing floor, climbing stairs, and lift up to 25lbs

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (4 years)
* Knowledge acquired through 3 to up to 5 years of work experience

**Preferred Qualifications**
Food Industry, Supply Chain, Business, or equivalent experience may be acceptable
 
 
****Work Environment****
Office Environment
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer - All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

records.title: Director, Operations
records.description:
**Company Overview**
**Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases**
is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, services, and solutions for the LNG and industrial gases industry. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with over $1.5 B in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
 
 
**Nikkiso ACD**
is an engineering and manufacturing company specializing in machinery designed to operate at cryogenic temperatures as low as – 420 degrees Fahrenheit, the boiling point of Liquid hydrogen. For over 50 years, Nikkiso ACD has specialized in centrifugal and reciprocating pumps as well as turbines for air separation. Nikkiso ACD has the most diversified product line in the industry covering nearly every application requiring pumps or turboexpanders.
 
 
**Job Overview**
The Director, Operations is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the manufacturing process. This role will develop and implement strategies that optimize the efficiency and effectiveness of the manufacturing operations to ensure the delivery of high-quality products on time and within budget.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement operational strategies that improve the efficiency, productivity, and profitability of the manufacturing operations for cryogenic pumps
* Ensure that manufacturing operations comply with all relevant safety and environmental regulations
* Develop and manage the annual manufacturing budget and monitor and control expenses to ensure that they remain within budgetary constraints
* Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance product quality while reducing product cost and increase margins
* Manage and develop a large team of manufacturing professionals, providing coaching and mentoring to enable them to reach their full potential
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and sales, to ensure that products meet customer requirements
* Maintain positive relationships with key stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, and outsourced manufacturing partners
* Develop and implement consistent processes and best practice strategies, policies, procedures, and goals
* Work cross-functionally with product manager, product development, engineering and project management teams to ensure company goals are met and the necessary support to deliver on time is provided
* Lead the effort in identification, recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, training, and ongoing engagement of high-performance team members
* Monitor and analyze key performance indicators for manufacturing such as safety, quality, delivery, cost, cash and, people
* Address escalated customer issues with speed and urgency, orchestrating resources across the company as appropriate
* Identify and remove obstacles to delivering products consistently on time with the right quality

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, or Operations Management, or related field or equivalent work experience
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in a manufacturing leadership role, preferably in the rotating equipment industry
* Extensive knowledge in manufacturing that are consistent with pump products, and how they are manufactured for the cryogenic industry preferred
* Proven track record of developing and implementing operational strategies that improve efficiency, productivity, and profitability
* Experience managing budgets and controlling expenses for operations
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and environmental and safety regulations
* Extensive knowledge in lean manufacturing
* Strong knowledge of quality control systems and procedures
* Hands-on experience working with global manufacturing operations
* Broad knowledge of multi-functional and multi-site teams working in a global environment
* Broad knowledge working with cryogenic industries
* Hands-on experience with Problem Solving / Six Sigma
* Project Planning / Project Management experience is preferred
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior management
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
* Progressive experience in roles leading manufacturing operations
* High adaptability and flexibility, including the ability to manage deadline pressure, ambiguity, and change
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to connect with and positively influence leadership at all levels of the organization
* Self-motivated with extremely strong sense of urgency-act as a change agent in the organization
* Demonstrates excellence in interpersonal skills - verbal and written communication, self-starter, positive make-it-happen attitude, team player
* Able to travel domestically and internationally as needed

**Supervisory Responsibility**
Reports to Director, Operations and manages and develops a team of manufacturing professionals, providing coaching and mentoring to enable them to reach their full potential.
 
 
**Work Environment**
This job operates in both a professional office environment and a manufacturing/production environment. Commitment to safety is essential. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as laptop computers, photocopiers, and smartphones.
 
 
**Physical Demands**
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary.
 
 
**Other Duties**
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
 
 
**Salary Range:**
$150,000 - $200,000 per year.
 
 
**EEOC Statement**
Nikkiso CE&IG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

records.title: Director of Operations | OKC
records.description:
**General Description:**

The Director of Operations is a strategic leader who oversees the entire production lifecycle. This role is responsible for optimizing production schedules to meet customer delivery requirements and maximizing the company’s productive capacity. A key function is process management, which involves constantly analyzing and refining workflows to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and enhance product quality. The director is also crucial to ensure customer satisfaction by guaranteeing that products are delivered on time and meet quality standards. The Director of Operations ensures that all operational components work together seamlessly to achieve business goals.

**Essential Functions:**

* Production & Process Management: Oversee the entire production process, ensuring all production schedules meet customer delivery requirements and maximize the company's productive capacity.
* Blueprint & Specification Interpretation: Read and interpret blueprints, customer purchase orders, and process specifications to guide production activities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal communication, collaborating with the Quality, Production, and Engineering Departments to address Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and ensure accuracy.
* Quality System & Audits: Develop a deep understanding of the company's quality system to effectively participate in customer quality audits and sales visits.
* Customer & Scheduling Coordination: Partner with Customer Service to prioritize jobs and adjust production schedules based on customer urgency.
* Process Improvement: Establish, document, and continuously improve production processes and schedules to meet release dates and enhance overall efficiency.
* Inventory Management: Manage and maintain optimal inventory levels to support production needs without creating excess stock.

**Competencies:**

* Leadership & Team Management: Ability to lead and manage a diverse team, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
* Operational & Technical Expertise: A strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including plating, grinding, and HVOF, with the ability to schedule work across various centers.
* Problem-Solving & Analysis: Skilled in identifying issues, analyzing root causes, and implementing effective solutions to improve operations.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interfacing with internal teams and external customers.
* Organizational & Time Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
* Ethical Conduct: Upholds high ethical standards in all business practices.
* Technical Proficiency: Computer literate with the ability to use standard office software and specialized production systems.

**Supervisory Responsibility:**

**This position is responsible for managing all shop employees, including performance management and assisting with hiring needs.**

**Required Education:**

**5-10 years of experience in production operations, including managing employees, implementing processes, and purchasing. Proven experience in production and process improvement.**

**Experience:**

**A degree in a related field is preferred but not required with sufficient experience.**

**Work Environment:**

**This role operates in both a professional office environment and on the production floor.**

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

·        Mobility and Lifting: This role requires frequent movement and the ability to lift and move objects. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The job may also require occasional sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, or crawling.

·        Vision: Specific vision requirements include close vision for reading documents and labels, distance vision, and the ability to distinguish colors, as well as peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. A minimum of 20/20 vision with or without corrective lenses is required.

·        Safety Equipment: The employee must be physically able to safely utilize, and wear required PPE, such as a dust mask, steel-toe footwear, and safety glasses.

·        The role requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:**

**This is a full-time position with an expected work schedule of Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.**

**Travel:**
No travel is expected for this position.

**Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

records.title: Director of Integrated Fab Manufacturing
records.description:
**Bold Thinking. World Changing.**
At SkyWater, our ingenuity helps improve lives around the world by manufacturing U.S. made semiconductors that are essential ingredients of modern life. Automotive safety enhancements, life-saving medical devices, consumer electronics and American security require semiconductors. Working in our Minnesota headquarters, Florida, or Texas location — employees join together to improve the world.
 
 
**Explore what’s possible.**
Joining our U.S. - based team means contributing to and learning about the commercialization of some of the most exciting technologies the world has ever seen. We are turning “science fiction” into everyday reality through technologies such as superconducting, 3D integrated circuits or computer chips, carbon nanotubes, photonic logic devices, micro electro-mechanical systems and other emerging device topologies. We manufacture products for aerospace and defense, medical, automotive, consumer and industrial markets, to name a few. Our customers include emerging leaders who rely on our intellectual property security and quality manufacturing services.
 
 
**Step into the future.**
SkyWater’s values of Integrity, Excellence, Collaboration, Empowerment and Growth Mindset guide us to cultivate an empowered, learning environment. We also invest in developing highly skilled, dedicated employees — and employees who are entering the workforce for the first time, from the military, and a variety of educational backgrounds.
 
 
**Are you bold thinking?**
Find your place on our team and help us change the world!
 
 
**Primary Objective**
Join an innovative semiconductor manufacturing organization at the forefront of advanced technology and manufacturing excellence. The Director of Integrated Fab Manufacturing owns the operational, financial, and strategic leadership of the Bloomington fabrication facility, including the Advanced Technology Services (ATS) Process Engineering Technician team. This role ensures the factory achieves world-class safety, quality, output, cycle time, and cost performance while directing a 24/7 organization and partnering across engineering, planning, and quality teams to meet all customer and business commitments.
 
 
In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end operational execution, strategic planning, budgetary ownership, and leadership to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient semiconductor manufacturing. You will be responsible for driving absolute excellence across safety, quality, output, cost optimization, and ensuring smooth production flow to consistently meet internal and external customer quality and on-time delivery (OTD) commitments, and fab velocity metrics / key performance indicators (KPIs).
 
 
The successful candidate will own the organizational design and talent strategy for their organization, serving as a role model and lead a highly matrixed organization consisting of the Manufacturing team, Process Engineering Technicians group, and Flow Engineers. This role is expected to partner closely with Program Managers, Technical Leads, Wafer Planning, Manufacturing, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and Technology Development teams to improve operational performance, resolve manufacturing constraints, and deliver business objectives. This leader will play a critical role in transforming factory capabilities to meet strict customer commitments and flexible demand by influencing long-range capacity and setting standards for the MN fab operations organization.
 
 
**Major Areas Of Accountability**

* Operations Leadership: Lead the daily and long-term operational execution in the fab, as well as the ATS technician and flow engineer teams to meet all production starts, output targets, yield expectations, cycle time goals, and quality standards, including setting clear priorities for the organization. Direct, develop, and coach the 24/7 operations teams—including Production, ATS Process Engineering Technicians, and Flow Engineers—to ensure capability, accountability, and organizational readiness.
* Team Leadership: Lead, develop, and empower the Production team, Process Engineering Technicians and Flow Engineers to provide effective manufacturing support, maintain production continuity, and resolve process and workflow issues
* Budgetary Responsibility: Own the fab operating budget, including labor, materials, maintenance, and operational spending; drive cost-reduction initiatives and evaluate capital investments using ROI-based decision-making.
* Wafer Planning and Customer Delivery: Partner with Wafer Planning and Program Management to align schedules, capacity, and customer priorities; identify delivery risks and oversee recovery plans to maintain on time delivery (OTD) performance.
* Manufacturing Performance: Partner with Industrial Engineers, and drive continuous improvement in throughput, cycle time, WIP management, yield, quality, equipment availability, and manufacturing cost using data-driven decision-making and structured problem-solving.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and Technology Development to resolve production constraints, improve equipment readiness, and maintain stable manufacturing operations.
* Operational Excellence: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including customer OTD, cycle time, throughput, equipment availability, and quality. Promote standardization, disciplined execution, effective escalation, and continuous improvement.
* Talent Development: Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, collaboration, and development of technical and operational talent. Responsible for the organizational design and talent strategy of these teams, with a focus on cultivating and retaining key talent, developing future leaders and preparing current leaders for the next level role.

**Required Qualifications**- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related technical discipline.
- Experience: Minimum 12 years in semiconductor manufacturing or operations; minimum 5+ years leading fab operations in a senior manager or director capacity within a 24/7 manufacturing environment.
- Skills:

* Demonstrated ability to improve manufacturing performance (throughput, cycle time, yield, cost, and customer delivery).
* Expertise in wafer planning, WIP management, or production scheduling.
* Strong capability in statistical process control (SPC), structured problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated leadership with large technical teams, with an ability to communicate and collaborate cross-functionally, delivering results in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Proven track record of managing a 24/7 manufacturing organization and guiding cross-functional teams through technical tool or yield crises.
* Citizenship: US Citizen required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to enter the cleanroom in full PPE to provide technical and operational support.
* Ability to navigate multi-level fab environments, including prolonged walking and standing when needed.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.*
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Education: Master’s or PhD in a relevant technical discipline.
* Experience: Deep knowledge of advanced Complimentary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) nodes, fab toolsets (Lithography, Etch, Diffusion, Thin Films, Chemical Mechanical Polish, Metrology, Metals), and factory automation systems.
* Skills: Experience driving major manufacturing transformations, automation or digitization initiatives, or large-scale capacity improvements.

**The annual salary range for this role is $159440 - $239,160. Pay offered is based on many factors, including, but not limited to, the job-related experience, skills, education, and credentials of each candidate.**
SkyWater offers an exciting environment where the brightest semiconductor minds come together to achieve exceptional results. We offer competitive salary and an opportunity to participate in incentive plans as well as other employee financial benefits, including 401k match, and life insurance.
 
 
Additionally, SkyWater offers a comprehensive benefits package which promotes a healthy life. This includes benefit eligibility day one, medical, dental, mental health benefits, vision, legal planning, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid holidays, an on-site fitness facility, and an on-site self-serve market.
 
 
SkyWater complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities unless doing so would cause an undue hardship. Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. To request reasonable accommodations, to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources at 952-851-5200 or Recruiting@SkyWatertechnology.com.
 
 
**EOE, including disability/vets**
We will never ask applicants to pay fees, purchase equipment or gift cards, or provide financial information before a formal offer of employment has been accepted. If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to represent our company, please verify its authenticity by contacting our recruitment team at recruiting@skywatertechnology.com before responding.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
**About Us:**
Alliance Machine Systems International, LLC is a privately held company with over 35 years of history dedicated to providing corrugated box manufacturing machines and services to the changing industry. As the paperboard packaging industry's premier global supplier of productivity-enhancing process machinery and systems, we supply innovative designs, intelligent automation, and optimized workflow, coupled with highly responsive parts and service support. Our United States and Europe based engineering, manufacturing, sales and service operations provide a global support system covering the full product portfolio of Alliance, Serco, TEI, ASC, Pallmac, J&L and Tanabe machines.
 
 
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
 
 
**Job Description:**
***THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE LOCATED IN SPOKANE, WASHINGTON.***
**Job Overview:**
Alliance Machine Systems Int is seeking a Director of Manufacturing to lead manufacturing performance and operational scale across its North American production sites.
 
 
This is a considerable leadership role for an experienced manufacturing leader who understands the complexity of producing industrial automation equipment and engineered systems.
 
 
The Director of Manufacturing will be responsible for improving the connection between engineering, production, quality, supply chain, and customer delivery.
 
 
The successful candidate will lead a manufacturing environment where products may include complex electrical, mechanical, robotic and controls. The role will involve managing high-mix production, engineered-to-order or configure-to-order manufacturing, and the delivery of technically sophisticated equipment to major industrial customers.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead manufacturing operations across the company’s production facilities.
* Set standards for safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Improve the transfer of products and projects from engineering into manufacturing.
* Increase capacity while maintaining quality, delivery, and customer performance.
* Improve on-time delivery, lead times, throughput, and gross margin.
* Strengthen production planning, scheduling, capacity planning, and work-in-progress control.
* Manage critical components, suppliers, and long-lead materials with procurement and supply chain teams.
* Establish scalable processes for complex, high-mix, engineered-to-order automation products and systems.
* Support new product introduction and design-for-manufacture initiatives.
* Improve collaboration across sales, engineering, project management, procurement, and manufacturing.
* Lead recovery plans for delayed or strategically important projects.
* Establish clear manufacturing and performance-management KPIs.
* Develop plant managers, production managers, and operational teams.
* Support facility expansion, automation investment, capital planning, and potential upcoming new-site development.
* Partner with the executive team on manufacturing strategy, capacity, organizational design, and long-term growth.

**Requirements:**

* 12+ years’ experience in manufacturing, operations, or plant leadership within an industrial manufacturing environment.
* At least 7 years in manufacturing leadership, with direct responsibility for manufacturing performance.
* Experience within industrial automation, robotics, machinery, electrical equipment, motion control, or engineered capital equipment manufacturing.
* Direct leadership of manufacturing operations, rather than engineering or project delivery alone.
* Experience with complex, high-mix, engineered-to-order, configure-to-order, or project-based production.
* A proven record of improving delivery, quality, productivity, capacity, cost, and gross margin.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across production, quality, planning, and supply chain.
* Strong understanding of the transition from engineering and product design into manufacturing.
* Experience leading managers and developing scalable operational structures.
* Working knowledge of ERP, MRP, production planning, scheduling, and manufacturing-performance systems.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across engineering, sales, project management, supply chain, service, and executive leadership.
* Willingness to travel to US manufacturing sites, suppliers, and customers as required.

Compensation: $150,000-180,000 base salary
 
 
Benefits: Alliance offers a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, 401K with employer match, PTO, paid holidays and a bonus program.
 
 
*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*
Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.
 
 
Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments.
 
 
**Company:**
Alliance

records.description:
**Director of Manufacturing (Rubber)**

The Director of Manufacturing will oversee rubber production operations across 2 manufacturing plants with 200 total employees, 100 employees per plant, 1 union plant & 1 non-union, 5-8 Direct Reports (Department Managers) with responsibility for safety, quality, delivery, and cost, acting as leader with accountability for both operations.

**Location**
: Columbia, Missouri (Relocation Assistance Offered)

**Compensation**
: $175,000 - $215,000 base salary + 15% bonus.

**Benefits**
: Medical, Dental, Vision, STD, LTD, 401k Match 6%, 3 weeks PTO, Tuition Assistance, etc.

**Job Description:**

*Operational Leadership & Plant Management*

* Hold full P&L, safety, quality, delivery, and cost accountability for both rubber manufacturing plants across textile & milling operations including mixing and cord production, acting as a multi-site operations leader.
* Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of 6-8 managers who in turn lead roughly 200 salaried and hourly employees across multiple shifts.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, capital plans, and budgets; manage conversion cost, yield, scrap, rework, material variance, and overhead against targets.
* Balance production schedules and capacity across both sites to meet downstream Belt and Hose demand, optimizing changeovers, inventory, and material availability.
* Partner with the VP of Manufacturing, plant managers of downstream operations, supply chain, and commercial teams on demand planning, capacity strategy, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Spend meaningful time on the floor at each site (approximately 30% travel), maintaining a visible presence on all shifts and engaging directly with operators and supervisors.

*Compound Quality, Technology & Process Control*

* Own end-to-end compound consistency, using rheology (Mooney, MDR/RPA), physical properties, and downstream processing and molding results as the measures of success.
* Reduce process variation through structured methods such as design of experiments (DOE), statistical process control, capability studies, and root cause analysis.
* Develop, standardize, and improve mixing programs (load order, ram pressure, rotor speed, mix time, dump temperature, energy-based and multi-stage mixing) for new and existing compounds, including EPDM, CR, HNBR, NBR, SBR, and NR systems.
* Oversee textile operations (cord unwinding, coating, and rewinding) and raw material handling, heating, and cooling to ensure consistent adhesion and reinforcement performance in finished belts and hoses.
* Lead cross-functional troubleshooting with chemists, the materials lab, process and manufacturing engineers, and downstream operations, leading investigations through disciplined experimentation.
* Establish a single, controlled system of work instructions, batch cards, and process parameters across both sites so that the same compound is produced the same way regardless of site, shift, or operator.
* Evaluate and recommend mixing equipment, automation, weighing/batching, and tooling options for current and new processes and products.

Mill: raw materials are received and handled, then weighed, mixed, heated, and cooled to produce uniform rubber compound for downstream product production.

Textiles: cord is carefully unwound, coated, and rewound to specification, giving finished products consistent strength and adhesion.

*Safety, Compliance & Culture*

* Champion a zero-harm safety culture, including lockout/tagout, machine guarding, mill nip and pinch-point hazards, hot surfaces, combustible dust, and chemical handling.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, environmental permitting, SDS requirements, and applicable customer, ISO/IATF, and corporate standards.
* Drive 5S, standardized work, and lean manufacturing practices; treat housekeeping as both a safety and a quality requirement.
* Build a culture of accountability in which following the documented process is the standard and deviations are surfaced openly.

*Talent Development & Organizational Capability*

* Build a bench of operators, leads, supervisors, and managers through structured training, skills matrices, cross-training, and succession planning.
* Set clear expectations, conduct performance reviews, and partner with HR on coaching, corrective action, recognition, and labor relations.
* Capture experienced operators' tribal knowledge and convert it to documented, teachable standards.
* Attract, hire, and retain top technical and operational talent in a competitive labor market.

*Strategy & Continuous Improvement*

* Work with the plant leadership and engineering leadership to define annual improvement initiatives, then align cross-functional teams to targets and track results.
* Lead capital projects, technology transfers, and new-process launches from concept through ramp-up.
* Use KPIs, trend charts, and daily management routines to drive visibility, problem solving, and sustained results.
* Contribute to the North American and global compounding strategy, sharing best practices with sister sites and corporate technology teams.

*Key Performance Indicators*

* Safety: recordable incident rate, near-miss reporting, and audit results
* Compound first-pass quality and out-of-spec rate; rheology capability and variation reduction
* Downstream molding and processing results attributable to compound and cord
* Schedule attainment and on-time delivery to downstream operations
* Scrap, rework, yield, and material and conversion cost versus budget
* Equipment uptime and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
* Operator qualification coverage and cross-training depth
* Employee engagement, turnover, and leadership bench strength

**Qualifications Seeking:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Chemical, Polymer, Mechanical, Materials, or Industrial), Chemistry, or a related technical field preferred. Experience in lieu of Bachelors will be considered.
* 8+ years of manufacturing experience, including 5–10 years of hands-on polymer or rubber compounding and mixing experience.
* 5+ years of progressive leadership experience managing managers and multi-shift operations, including responsibility for safety, quality, cost, and delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of internal mixers (tangential and intermeshing), two-roll mills, TSE, weigh-up/batching, and compound testing (Mooney, MDR/RPA, specific gravity, dispersion).
* Demonstrated experience reducing process variation using DOE, SPC, and structured problem-solving methods.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional troubleshooting with chemists, lab, engineering, and production teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, direct without being abrasive.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30% between sites and to work on the floor in a manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications (Not Required):**

* Master's degree in Polymer Science, Chemistry, or Engineering, or an MBA.
* Experience in belt, hose, or other engineered rubber product manufacturing, with understanding of rheology and downstream extrusion, calendering, and molding.
* Experience with cord treatment, textile reinforcement, or adhesive systems.
* Experience managing multi-site operations and leading change across sites.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt certification, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ERP/MES systems, mixing control software, and automation for production and material traceability.
* Experience leading capital projects, new-equipment commissioning, or greenfield/expansion launches.

**Core Competencies Seeking:**

* Technical depth: credible expert in rubber chemistry, rheology, and mixing who can coach engineers and operators alike.
* Leadership: develops managers, builds accountability, and engages a unionized or non-union frontline workforce.
* Systems thinking: standardizes work and builds sustainable processes rather than relying on individual heroics.
* Analytical rigor: makes decisions with data, experimentation, and clear trend visibility.
* Business acumen: manages cost, capital, and capacity with a P&L mindset.
* Learning agility: quickly learns new technologies and applies them to business needs.
