records.title: Chief of Staff and Strategic Operations
records.description:
**Position Summary**

LTI, a family-owned manufacturer of premium commercial foodservice equipment, is seeking a highly motivated, results-oriented Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations leader to partner directly with the CEO and executive leadership team in driving organizational performance, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence.

This individual will serve as a trusted advisor, strategic business partner, and execution leader responsible for translating company priorities into measurable results. The position will work across all functional areas to strengthen communication, improve business processes, accelerate decision-making, and ensure critical initiatives are completed on time and achieve their intended outcomes.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on impact player who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, demonstrates exceptional business judgment, takes ownership of results, and holds themselves and others accountable. This individual must balance strategic thinking with tactical execution and possess the leadership maturity to influence executives without relying on direct reporting authority.

As LTI continues to grow, this position will play an important role in scaling the organization, strengthening leadership effectiveness, and building the operational discipline necessary for long-term success.

**Major Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Planning and Execution**

* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to develop, prioritize, and execute company-wide strategic objectives.
* Translate long-term business strategies into actionable plans with clearly defined milestones, responsibilities, deadlines, and performance measures.
* Lead and coordinate high-priority strategic initiatives that span multiple departments.
* Monitor progress against strategic objectives, identify obstacles, and drive corrective actions to ensure timely completion.
* Provide the CEO with objective assessments of organizational performance, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure strategic initiatives remain aligned with company growth objectives, financial expectations, and organizational capabilities.

**2. Executive Leadership Support and Organizational Alignment**

* Serve as a strategic advisor and trusted business partner to the CEO.
* Function as a force multiplier by improving the effectiveness, focus, and execution capabilities of the executive leadership team.
* Coordinate cross-functional priorities involving Manufacturing, Engineering & Customer Support, Finance, Human Resources, and Business Development & Marketing.
* Facilitate executive leadership meetings, strategic planning sessions, and performance reviews to drive decisions and measurable outcomes.
* Establish clear accountability for decisions, action items, and commitments made by executive leadership.
* Identify organizational barriers, competing priorities, and communication gaps that negatively impact performance.
* Support the CEO in evaluating organizational effectiveness, leadership capacity, and future business needs.

**3. Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate company-wide business processes, workflows, and operating practices to identify opportunities for greater efficiency and effectiveness.
* Partner with functional leaders to implement improvements that enhance productivity, quality, customer satisfaction, profitability, and organizational responsiveness.
* Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts involving complex operational and business challenges.
* Promote disciplined execution, process standardization, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and coordinate resources to resolve issues that impact company performance.
* Support initiatives that improve the scalability of manufacturing operations and supporting business functions.
* Ensuring improvement initiatives produce measurable business results rather than simply generating additional activities or reporting.

**4. Performance Management and Accountability**

* Develop and maintain executive-level scorecards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and strategic initiative tracking systems.
* Establish consistent processes for monitoring progress toward company objectives and departmental commitments.
* Work with executive leaders to identify performance gaps and develop appropriate corrective action plans.
* Provide the CEO and leadership team with timely, accurate, and actionable information to support decision-making.
* Establish disciplined follow-up processes to ensure projects, initiatives, and executive commitments are completed within established deadlines.
* Promote a results-oriented culture that emphasizes ownership, urgency, transparency, and accountability.

**5. Strategic Projects and Change Management**

* Assume direct leadership of high-impact projects assigned by the CEO that require coordination across multiple functions.
* Develop project plans, define deliverables, establish timelines, and coordinate resources necessary for successful execution.
* Lead organizational change initiatives associated with business growth, process improvements, technology implementation, and operational transformation.
* Evaluate project risks, resolve implementation challenges, and communicate progress to executive leadership.
* Manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and consistently meeting deadlines.
* Support the evaluation and implementation of new business systems, technologies, and organizational capabilities.
* Ensure completed projects are successfully transitioned to the appropriate functional leaders for ongoing ownership.

**6. Financial and Business Performance**

* Partner with the CFO and functional executives to understand financial performance, operating results, and business trends.
* Support initiatives designed to improve profitability, productivity, cost management, and return on investment.
* Assist in evaluating business cases, capital investments, resource allocation, and strategic growth opportunities.
* Ensure major strategic initiatives include appropriate financial objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Monitor performance against established financial and operational targets and help coordinate corrective actions when necessary.
* Maintain a company-wide perspective when evaluating decisions and recommending business priorities.

**7. Leadership Development and Organizational Effectiveness**

* Support the CEO in strengthening executive leadership effectiveness, collaboration, and organizational accountability.
* Identify opportunities to improve leadership processes, decision-making practices, and communication across departments.
* Partner with Human Resources and executive leadership to support succession planning, leadership development, and organizational readiness for growth.
* Encourage a culture of constructive debate, timely decisions, and consistent execution.
* Serve as a positive role model for LTI's core values of **Humble, Hungry, and Smart**.
* Build trust and credibility at all organizational levels, including executive leadership, office personnel, and manufacturing employees.
* Help preserve LTI's family-oriented culture while introducing the structure and discipline necessary to support continued growth.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline required; MBA or advanced business degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive business leadership experience, including significant responsibility for operations, strategic planning, organizational performance, or cross-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with CEOs, presidents, business owners, or senior executive leadership teams.
* Experience in manufacturing, industrial products, or a similarly complex operational environment strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, managing complex projects, and delivering measurable business improvements.
* Experience in a growing, privately held, or family-owned business environment preferred.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial statements, business performance metrics, budgeting, and operational profitability.
* Experience implementing performance management systems, operational improvements, or organizational change initiatives.

**Leadership and Professional Competencies**

* **Strategic and Analytical Thinking:** Ability to understand the broader business environment, evaluate complex issues, and translate strategy into actionable priorities.
* **Execution and Results Orientation:** Strong sense of urgency, personal accountability, and demonstrated ability to deliver results within demanding deadlines.
* **Executive Presence and Influence:** Ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* **Business and Financial Acumen:** Strong understanding of how operational decisions affect financial performance, customer satisfaction, and long-term business success.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Ability to coordinate multiple departments, build alignment, resolve conflicts, and drive shared objectives.
* **Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:** Ability to quickly assess challenges, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions.
* **Project and Priority Management:** Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively from the production floor to the executive office.
* **Adaptability and Resilience:** Comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where business priorities and demands may change.
* **Integrity and Confidentiality:** Demonstrated sound judgment, professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle sensitive business and personnel information.

**Personal Attributes and Cultural Fit**

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following characteristics:

* A highly motivated self-starter who takes initiative and requires minimal supervision.
* An impact player who is energized by challenging assignments and opportunities to make a measurable difference.
* A strong work ethic with a willingness to roll up their sleeves and personally drive execution.
* A collaborative leader who values team success over individual recognition.
* A confident but humble professional who can respectfully challenge ideas and accept constructive feedback.
* A proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues rather than waiting for direction.
* A disciplined leader who establishes priorities, follows through on commitments, and consistently meets deadlines.
* A relationship builder who earns trust through credibility, transparency, and demonstrated results.
* A leader who embraces the values and personal accountability expected within a family-owned business.

**Organizational Authority and Scope**

The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will report directly to the CEO and work collaboratively with all members of the executive leadership team.

The position will initially operate primarily through cross-functional leadership, executive influence, and authority delegated by the CEO rather than through direct supervision of existing functional departments.

Functional executives will retain accountability for their respective departments, while the Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations will help coordinate company-wide initiatives, facilitate decision-making, and ensure execution of strategic priorities.

The position may assume additional operational responsibilities and direct reports as the organization grows and business needs evolve.

**Measures of Success**

Success in this position will be evaluated through demonstrated improvements in:

* Timely completion of strategic initiatives and executive priorities.
* Organizational alignment and accountability across functional departments.
* Operational efficiency, productivity, and business process effectiveness.
* Achievement of established company-wide performance objectives.
* Executive leadership effectiveness and decision-making.
* Successful implementation of high-impact business projects.
* Financial and operational improvements resulting from strategic initiatives.
* Organizational readiness to support continued growth.

**Overall Expectation:** The Chief of Staff & Strategic Operations must consistently demonstrate an ability to convert business priorities into completed actions, measurable improvements, and sustainable organizational results.

records.title: Director of Fabrication
records.description:
**DIRECTOR OF FABRICATION** 
Sargent Electric is a leading specialty contractor focused on electrical, instrumentation, wireless, utility, and low voltage systems. Founded in Pittsburgh in 1907, we operate from 8 locations across the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic and Northeast, delivering projects nationwide for our strategic customers. 
We support the breadth of client needs — from routine 24/7 service and emergency restoration to their largest and most complex projects. Our proven safety record, technical depth, and longstanding client relationships have made us a partner of choice for Fortune 500 companies, leading general contractors, and EPC contractors. 
We are seeking a **DIRECTOR OF FABRICATION** to support our Mission Critical team. 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Champion Safety Culture.** Set the standard through visible, consistent leadership. Ensure fabrication, material handling, equipment operation, and facility activities are planned and performed in alignment with company requirements and applicable safety standards.
* **Lead from the Facility Floor.** This is a working leadership role. Maintain a consistent presence in the facility, understand the daily heartbeat of the operation, engage the team directly, and act quickly when conditions require attention.
* **Facility Operations and Execution.** Lead the day-to-day operation of an 80,000 square-foot fabrication facility, including fabrication, modular assembly, receiving, inventory, shipping, equipment, maintenance, and facility services.
* **Production Planning.** Translate the demand and released work scopes of multiple regional projects into practical weekly and monthly production plans. Align labor, materials, equipment, floor space, and support resources with field installation sequence and committed delivery dates.
* **Reliable Flow and Delivery.** Monitor backlog, throughput, labor performance, work in process, capacity, and on-time completion. Balance work across production areas, remove constraints, and communicate risks before they become missed commitments.
* **Field First Fabrication and DFMI.** Partner with preconstruction, planning, modeling, procurement, operations, and field leadership to turn coordinated information into fabrication ready work. Help advance repeatable assemblies, kitting, bills of material, and installation-ready work packages.
* **Quality and Standards.** Establish practical inspection, testing, release, and nonconformance processes that protect workmanship, accuracy, traceability, and project requirements. Maintain standards with discipline while remaining agile when project or market conditions require a different path.
* **Inventory, Warehousing, and Logistics.** Maintain material visibility and inventory accuracy from receipt through shipment. Improve packaging, loading, transportation, delivery tracking, and site handoff while reducing shortages, damage, excess inventory, obsolete material, and double handling.
* **Financial and Operational Stewardship.** Manage the facility operating budget and the cost drivers within the role, including labor, equipment, maintenance, occupancy, material handling, logistics, and overhead. Provide forecasts and clear explanations of material variances.
* **Build and Develop the Team.** Recruit, organize, coach, and retain production and support personnel. Set clear accountabilities, staffing and training plans, and performance expectations while building a culture of safety, respect, urgency, craftsmanship, teamwork, and ownership.
* **Continuous Improvement.** Apply practical Lean methods, standardized work, visual management, and structured problem solving. Improve flow, first pass quality, cycle time, productivity, and usable capacity without creating process for the sake of process.
* **Progressive Entrepreneurial Leadership.** Bring courage of conviction, sound judgment, and a bias for action. Challenge the status quo when the facts support it, remain open to better ideas, and adapt tooling, methods, layout, and staffing to changing customer and market needs.
* **Performance Visibility and Accountability.** Create and maintain a focused operating dashboard including KPIs that drive decisions, including safety, quality, backlog, staffing, throughput, delivery, inventory, cost, and improvement actions.

Any additional duties and responsibilities as delegated by Sargent Electrical Management 
 
**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Demonstrated ability to convert forecasted and released demand into executable production plans.
* Working knowledge of electrical construction materials, means and methods, field installation sequencing.
* Excellent written communication skills. Proficiency with computers, particularly Microsoft Office applications, including the ability to type.
* Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills and the ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of diverse individuals.
* The ability to work efficiently under tight time frames, the ability to respond to requests in a timely manner, and effective communication as a team player.
* Understanding of the importance of multi-tasking.

 
**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or a related discipline. Relevant trade, field, fabrication, or operations experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Minimum five (5) years of experience in fabrication, modular construction, manufacturing, industrial operations, or a closely related environment (electrical preferred).
* Minimum three (3) years leading fabrication, production, warehouse, or industrial operations personnel.

 
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience starting, scaling, reorganizing, or materially improving a fabrication, manufacturing, or distribution operation.
* Practical experience with Lean manufacturing, standardized work, and continuous improvement.
* Experience with ERP, production planning, inventory management, fabrication tracking, and reporting systems.
* Lean, Six Sigma, CM-Lean, or comparable continuous improvement training.

 
**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**

* Travel to project sites, training, trade shows, and conferences as required.

 
**WHY JOIN SARGENT?**

* Established, growing company with a strong industry reputation
* Collaborative, team-driven environment
* Competitive compensation based on experience

 
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** 
*Sargent Electric Company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
Santa Maria Independent School District

**Job Title:** Operations Director **Exemption Status/Test:** Exempt

**Reports to:** Superintendent of Schools

**Dept./School:** Operations Department **Date Revised: 11/2026**

Primary Purpose:

Direct and manage district’s maintenance, transportation, and custodial operations. Ensure safe and efficient operation of transportation department. Oversee maintenance of all district-owned vehicles. Maintain physical school plant in excellent operating condition so that full educational use may be made at all times. Provide a physical environment that is functional, safe, clean, and attractive.

Qualifications:

Education/Certification:

Clear and valid Texas commercial driver’s license with Passenger (P) and School Bus (S) endorsements

Special Knowledge/Skills:

Ability to direct and manage operations of school buses and operations inventory 
Knowledge of basic principles of construction, school plant maintenance, and custodial operations

Ability to pass U.S. Department of Transportation alcohol and drug tests and annual physical exam

Knowledge of energy management and vehicle repair and maintenance

Ability to conduct on-site inspections of all vehicle repair and maintenance operations

Ability to manage budget and personnel

Ability to implement policy and procedures

Ability to interpret data and learn transportation routes

Ability to use technology to plan, operate, monitor, and evaluate transportation operations

Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills

Experience:

1-3 years’ supervisory experience in transportation and maintenance operations

1-3 years’ experience as a bus driver

Major Responsibilities and Duties:Building Maintenance and Repair

1. Ensure district facilities are functional, safe, clean, and well maintained.

2. Develop and maintain written departmental procedures for maintenance, repair, and operations of all district buildings and equipment. Ensure work orders are processed and executed in a timely manner.

3. Prepare plans and specifications for contracted repair work and site improvement for submission to purchasing department for bids.

Transportation and Vehicle Maintenance Operations

4. Manage the delivery of transportation services for students and ensure they are picked up and arrive safely and on time.

5. Oversee preparation and updating of bus routes and schedules for all schools in district and develop plans to meet future transportation needs.

6. Communicate changes in routes and scheduling to campuses and the public when warranted.

7. Coordinate transportation for extracurricular activities and special programs.

8. Assign bus drivers to routes and extracurricular trips and find substitutes as needed.

9. Monitor fuel deliveries and distribution.

10. Oversee repair of all district-owned vehicles and preventive maintenance. Ensure vehicle repair requests and work orders are prioritized and processed in a timely manner. Contract for outside services that cannot be performed in shop.

Policy, Reports, and Laws

11. Implement federal and state law, State Board of Education rule, and board policy.

12. Compile, maintain, file, and present all reports, records, and other documents required.

13. Prepare, process, and maintain all documents required to verify safety certification and alcohol and drug testing of bus drivers.

14. Ensure employee time records are accurately maintained and data necessary to process transportation payroll is delivered in a timely manner.

15. Follow district safety protocols and emergency procedures.

Budget and Inventory

16. Develop and administer budget based on documented needs and ensure operations are cost effective and funds are managed wisely.

17. Maintain current inventory of supplies and parts and initiate purchases in accordance with budgetary limitations and district policies. Approve and forward invoices for transportation to accounting department.

18. Recommend disposal of obsolete or worn out vehicles and equipment. Recommend purchase of vehicles as necessary.

Student Management

19. Implement district’s student discipline policies and ensure expectations about appropriate behavior when using district transportation are communicated to students. Enforce student discipline and suspension of riding privileges for any student who violates rules and regulations.

20. Investigate reported concerns and take appropriate action to resolve issues.

Personnel

21. Select, train, supervise, and evaluate staff and make recommendations relative to assignment, retention, discipline, and dismissal.

Safety

22. Enforce safety standards that conform with state, federal, and insurance regulations and develop a program of preventive safety.

23. Ensure equipment is maintained in optimum operating condition.

24. Maintain safety standards in conformance with federal, state, and insurance regulations and district requirements and develop a program of preventive safety.

25. Assess road conditions and hazards and advise administration about inclement weather conditions that may result in delayed starts or the closing of schools.

26. Investigate school bus accidents and student safety violations.

27. Maintain safety standards in conformance with federal, state, and insurance regulations.

28. Organize and conduct training programs to promote a safe work environment.

29. Ensure transportation equipment is in excellent operating condition.

30. Follow district safety protocols and emergency procedures.

Other

31. Participate in development of the district’s disaster plan and be prepared to take an active role in responding to emergencies as needed.

32. Operate bus and district vehicles as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Supervise, evaluate, and recommend the hiring and firing of maintenance and transportation employees

Mental Demands/Physical Demands/Environmental Factors:

**Tools/Equipment Used:** Standard office equipment including computer and peripherals; district vehicle; school bus

Posture: Prolonged sitting; frequent standing, kneeling/squatting, bending/stooping, pushing/pulling, and twistingMotion: Frequent walking; regular grasping/squeezing, wrist flexion/extension, and reaching; regular drivingLifting: Regular light lifting and carrying (less than 15 pounds)Environment: Work outside and inside, on slippery or uneven walking surfaces; frequent exposure to extreme hot and cold temperatures, dust, noise, vibration; exposure to chemical hazards; work around vehicles and machinery with moving parts; regularly work irregular hours; occasional prolonged hours; frequent districtwide travel; occasional statewide travelMental Demands: Maintain emotional control under stress

*\*To meet the executive exemption test, the primary duty must be management* ***and*** *the employee must supervise at least two full-time employees.*

This document describes the general purpose and responsibilities assigned to this job and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties that may be assigned or skills that may be required.

**It is the policy of Santa Maria ISD not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex or handicap in its vocational programs, services or activities as required by Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, as amended; Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972; and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended.**

Pay: $198.72 - $280.08 per day

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Retirement plan

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines. 
 
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work? 

**Director - Integrated Services Access & Operations**
======================================================

**Entity:** Clinical Practices of the University of Pennsylvania 
**Department:** Psychiatry Administration 
**Location:** (based out of Penn Behavioral Health, 3535 Market Street, Philadelphia, PA) 
**Schedule:** 8-Hour Days

**Summary**
-----------

The Director of Integrated Services Access & Operations serves as a senior operational leader within the Department of Psychiatry, reporting jointly to the Chief Operating Officer and Vice Chair for Clinical Operations. This role provides strategic and operational leadership for integrated care programs and other clinical initiatives across the department and downtown entities.

Key responsibilities include improving patient access, optimizing operational performance, supporting financial sustainability, ensuring regulatory compliance, managing quality initiatives, and advancing data-driven decision-making to deliver high-quality, evidence-based patient care.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

#### **Strategic Operations & Program Leadership**

* Partner with departmental and health system leaders to evaluate, prioritize, and implement initiatives that improve patient access to innovative behavioral health services.
* Lead operational support for integrated care programs, including Penn Integrated Care (PIC), Mental Health Engagement Navigation & Delivery (MEND), and other departmental initiatives.
* Support expansion and optimization of neuromodulation services, including Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS), Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT), esketamine, and neurosurgical interventions.
* Oversee redesign and optimization of psychiatric admission and referral pathways.

#### **Penn Integrated Care (PIC)**

* Collaborate with clinical and operational leaders to develop, launch, and expand integrated behavioral health services in specialty and primary care settings.
* Partner with clinical practices to assess needs, implement workflows, establish operational processes, and support provider and staff onboarding.
* Coordinate training programs, reporting tools, patient registries, and clinical workflow enhancements.
* Monitor outcomes, operational performance, and compliance with collaborative care requirements.

#### **MEND & Care Navigation Programs**

* Support growth and expansion of MEND services across hospital settings.
* Review performance data and collaborate with hospital leadership on program improvements.
* Assist with implementation of technology solutions and operational dashboards to support care delivery.

#### **HUP Cedar Operations**

* Provide departmental operational support for HUP Cedar behavioral health services.
* Serve as liaison to site leadership to ensure alignment with departmental operations.
* Manage physician payroll, incentive payments, requisitions, and related administrative support.

#### **Quality, Compliance & Performance Improvement**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and regulatory requirements, including DOH, TJC, HIPAA, CMS, OSHA, and other governing bodies.
* Lead audit and survey readiness activities.
* Partner with clinical leadership to establish and achieve quality, access, service, and performance goals.
* Monitor and analyze operational and clinical performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.

#### **Staff Leadership**

* Manage selected outpatient clinical support staff.
* Directly supervise Medical Assistants and Clinical Service Associates supporting the 3535 Market Street ambulatory practices.
* Ensure competency assessments, training requirements, and scope-of-service standards are maintained.

**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------

* Master's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
* 7+ years of relevant healthcare operations experience.
* Healthcare management experience preferred.
* RN or equivalent clinical licensure (e.g., LCSW, PT/OT, Speech-Language Pathology, Pharmacist) preferred.

We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives. 
 
Live Your Life's Work

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

records.title: Area Operations Director
records.description:
**American Welding & Gas Inc**. is thrilled to announce an immediate opening for a dynamic Area Operations Director in the vibrant **Western**

**Montana market**. Don't miss the chance to make an impact in this key leadership role!

**Summary**

The Area Operations Director is responsible for the overall operational performance of multiple branch locations and facilities within an assigned region. This role provides leadership across distribution, logistics, customer service, safety, and facility operations to ensure consistent service delivery, regulatory compliance, and financial performance. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with deep experience in industrial distribution or manufacturing environments and a proven ability to lead teams, improve processes, and scale operations.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership**

* Provide strategic and day-to-day operational leadership for multiple branch locations and facilities.

* Ensure consistent execution of AWG operational standards, policies, and best practices.

* Drive operational efficiency, service reliability, and customer satisfaction across the region.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Champion AWG's safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, DOT, EPA, FDA (medical gases), and CGA requirements.

* Lead safety initiatives, audits, incident investigations, and corrective action plans.

* Ensure facilities, fleets, and operations meet all regulatory and company safety standards.

**Logistics** **& Distribution**

* Oversee packaged gas distribution, including fleet management and route optimization.

* Partner with supply chain teams to ensure inventory accuracy, asset utilization, and product availability.

* Support implementation of technology and process improvements to enhance delivery and warehouse operations.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop branch managers, operations managers, and frontline supervisors.

* Support recruiting, training, performance management, and succession planning.

* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**Financial & Performance Management**

* Manage regional operating budgets, labor costs, and capital expenditures.

* Monitor KPIs related to safety, service levels, productivity, and profitability.

* Identify cost-saving opportunities and operational improvements while maintaining service quality.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with sales, production, safety, HR, and finance teams to align operations with business objectives.

* Support integration of newly acquired branches and standardization of operational processes.

* Serve as an escalation point for customer and operational issues requiring senior leadership involvement.

* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications & Education Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Management, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

* 10+ years of progressive operations experience in industrial distribution, manufacturing, or logistics.

* Proficiency in supply chain/inventory management in a B2B organization.

* Strong knowledge of safety regulations, DOT logistics, and distribution operations.

* Proven ability to lead teams, manage budgets, and drive operational improvements.

* Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Willingness to travel regularly within the assigned region

**Incentives**

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

* 401(k) with company match.

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage from day one.

* Life and disability insurance.

* Generous paid time off and paid holidays.

* A supportive, team-oriented culture with opportunities for growth.

**AWG Culture**

A family-like atmosphere known for growth opportunities and a low turnover rate in the industry.

AWG is expanding and seeking exceptional talent to drive our progress forward. Don't miss out on a promising future — join our team today!

American Welding & Gas (AWG) is a manufacturer and distributor of industrial gases as well as a provider of all your welding supply needs. We are a family and team member owned company that is headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. Our company provides industrial, medical, and specialty gases as well as food and beverage gases across the United States, from Montana to Pennsylvania and down through Texas and Florida. With a team of over 800 employees, over 100 retail locations, and 22 fill plants, we pride ourselves in our customer service, expertise, assets, and resources that allow us to reach a large and diversified customer base of the highest quality.

*\*\*American Welding & Gas is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability* *\*\*\**

records.title: Director of Business Systems & Operations
records.description:
About the Company

CCS / Orange Tape operates a multichannel business encompassing direct-to-consumer ecommerce, wholesale distribution, and Amazon marketplaces. Our portfolio includes CCS, Alien Workshop, and Habitat Skateboards. We are an entrepreneurially minded, creatively ambitious company focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Founded in 1985, CCS is one of the most recognized names in skateboarding and streetwear. For generations, the CCS catalog helped shape skateboarding culture, introducing millions of customers to new brands, products, artists, and ideas. Today, CCS is a digital-first retailer and apparel brand, combining a deep history in skateboarding with a focus on creating compelling products and connecting with the next generation of customers. Alien Workshop and Habitat Skateboards, two iconic skateboarding brands, are operated through Orange Tape, our wholesale distribution business.

We are based in Portland, OR, with 50+ employees.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical, technically capable Director of Business Systems & Operations to help improve how our business operates through better systems, stronger analysis, and effective execution.

Working closely with our CEO, CIO, and department managers, this individual will identify opportunities to improve business performance, develop internal applications and reporting tools, and take responsibility for a variety of operational and administrative initiatives.

The position combines business analysis, operations management, and technology-enabled process improvement. Responsibilities range from developing tools to improve reporting and inventory planning to analyzing shipping costs, evaluating operational productivity, and negotiating vendor agreements.

We are particularly interested in candidates who combine strong business judgment and analytical skills with technical aptitude and the ability to develop practical solutions. Traditional software engineering experience is not required. We place greater value on intellectual curiosity, initiative, operational understanding, and demonstrated success solving business problems.

This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys both analyzing problems and taking responsibility for getting things done.

Key Responsibilities

* Business Systems Development: Design, build, and maintain internal applications, reporting tools, and automated workflows supporting merchandising, purchasing, inventory management, finance, fulfillment, and other functions
* Business & Operational Analysis: Analyze sales, inventory, margins, shipping costs, labor productivity, and other operating metrics to identify problems, recommend improvements, and support management decisions
* Business Operations: Support and improve operations across CCS and Orange Tape, including evaluating performance, identifying inefficiencies, resolving cross-functional issues, and ensuring effective execution of key initiatives
* Inventory Planning: Support inventory planning, purchasing budgets, forecasting, and open-to-buy processes, working with buyers and other employees to improve inventory productivity, availability, and working capital efficiency
* Vendor & Cost Management: Evaluate vendor performance and costs, assist with shipping carrier and other vendor negotiations, and identify opportunities to improve service and reduce expenses
* Reporting & Decision Support: Develop tools that improve access to operational and financial information, automate repetitive reporting, and help employees analyze data and make better decisions
* Technology & Systems Projects: Work closely with our CIO on NetSuite, Shopify, systems integrations, data infrastructure, and other technical initiatives, including projects supporting ecommerce operations
* Administrative Oversight: Supervise the HR/Office Manager, including payroll review and approval, insurance administration, and related responsibilities
* Operational Improvement & Execution: Identify opportunities to improve business processes and own selected projects from initial analysis through implementation, testing, and employee adoption

Qualifications

Required:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience
* 4+ years of relevant experience in business operations, business systems, business analysis, finance, inventory planning, ERP systems, or related functions
* Hands-on experience with NetSuite, including a strong understanding of its business processes, data, and reporting capabilities
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret business and financial information and develop practical recommendations
* Strong business and financial acumen, including an understanding of profitability, inventory management, operating costs, and the financial implications of business decisions
* Strong Excel skills and general technical proficiency, including the ability to use technology to develop practical business solutions
* Ability to work across departments, coordinate projects, negotiate with vendors, and take responsibility for operational results
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, initiative, and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently

Preferred:

* Experience in ecommerce, retail, wholesale distribution, consumer products, or another inventory-intensive business
* Experience in accounting, financial analysis, financial systems, or operations analysis
* Experience with NetSuite administration, consulting, reporting, saved searches, or workflows
* Experience with inventory forecasting, open-to-buy planning, or operational performance management
* Experience using AI tools, such as Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar platforms, to develop applications, automate workflows, analyze data, or solve business problems
* Experience developing internal applications, reporting tools, or business process automations
* Familiarity with Shopify, Amazon, and multichannel business operations
* Experience improving operational efficiency, implementing business applications, or negotiating vendor and service agreements

Compensation

$110,000 - $160,000 per year, depending on experience

Benefits

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* 401(k)
* Employee discount on merchandise
* Catered lunch every other week

records.description:
**Pay Range:**

$53.07 - $79.60

A successful candidate's actual pay rate will be based on several factors including relevant experience, skills, training, certifications and education.

Hospital Sisters Health System (HSHS) is seeking an Executive Director-Mission Outreach Operations to join our team. Provides oversight and leadership within assigned areas of responsibility; is responsible for more than one area of service. Manages the overall operational, budgetary, and financial responsibilities and activities. Plans and implements systems that accomplish work objectives and fulfill the mission and goals efficiently and effectively. Plans and allocates resources to effectively staff department and meet productivity and quality goals. Plans, evaluates, and improves the efficiency of processes and procedures to enhance speed, quality, efficiency, and output. Formulates business decisions that are financially responsible, accountable, justifiable, and defensible in accordance with organization policies and procedures. Establishes and maintains relevant controls and feedback systems to monitor the operation of all areas of responsibility. Reviews performance data that may include quality, satisfaction, engagement, and financial reports. Monitors and measures productivity, goal achievement, and overall effectiveness. Participates in the preparation and maintenance of reports necessary to carry out the functions of the area of responsibility. Prepares periodic reports for management to track goal accomplishment.
 
 
Leads colleagues using performance management and development process. Plans and directs the activities of the service areas to ensure timely and accurate information to management and external parties. 
 
Oversees areas of responsibility operations and exercises discretion and independent judgment. Evaluates performance and professional development of staff. Supervisory authority includes authority to hire, transfer, suspend, layoff, recall, promote, discharge, assign, reward, discipline, responsibly direct or adjust grievances. 
 
Position Specifics:
 
o Department: Mission Outreach
 
o Core Function: Leadership
 
o Schedule: Full Time
 
o Facility: Mission Outreach 
o Location: Springfield, IL
 
o Compensation that aligns with your experience 
**Education Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field is required.
* Master’s degree in business or a related field is preferred.

**Experience Qualifications**

* 5 years of healthcare, medical missions or supply chain experience is required.
* 5 years of progressively more responsible leadership experience is preferred.

**Certifications, Licenses and Registrations**

* N/A

Job Description

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Throughout communities in Illinois and Wisconsin, 13 hospitals, numerous community-based health centers and clinics, our 13,000+ colleagues have built a culture based on our solid core values of respect, care, competence, and joy. These are the ideals we believe in, work by, and live each day.

Built upon more than 145 years of service to the communities we serve, we now look to the future and our place in it as a healthcare system that strives to continually improve processes, procedures, and outcomes with the latest and most advanced technologies and treatments.

Regardless of how far our passion for excellence carries us, our focus will always remain on the most important person in our entire organization: The patient.

**Benefits:** HSHS provides a benefits package designed to support the overall well-being of our colleagues including their physical, emotional, financial, spiritual, and work health. **Colleagues budgeted to work at least 48 hours per pay period are eligible for HSHS benefits.**

* Comprehensive and affordable health coverage includes medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage for full-time and part-time colleagues.
* Paid Time Off (PTO) combines vacation, sick, and personal days into one balance to allow you the flexibility to use your time off as you need.
* Retirement benefits including HSHS 
 contributions.
* Education Assistance benefits include up to $5,250 of educational assistance each calendar year and tuition discounts to select colleges with no waiting period.
* Adoption Assistance provides financial support up to $7,500 for colleagues growing their families through adoption to reimburse application and legal fees, transportation, and more!
* Other benefits include: Wellness program with incentives, employer-paid life insurance and short-term and long-term disability coverage, flexible spending accounts, employee assistance program, ID theft coverage, colleague rewards and recognition program, discount program, and more!

Benefits

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**Salary:** 140,000-180,000

**Other Forms of Compensation:**

Our Passion is Food! 
 
At Bon Appetit Management Company we are committed to two things, great food and outstanding service! At Bon Appetit you won't find our managers referring to a corporate recipe book or our chefs microwaving the lunch special. We do not have standardized recipes or central commissaries, instead, our chefs and managers are expected to stay abreast of current culinary trends and bring cutting edge food into their cafes. We are a restaurant company that operates in contract food service. That means you will have the freedom to be creative, take risks, and truly shine. We are committed to our staff growing, trying new things, and learning all that they can. Our rapid growth and breadth of accounts translates into exciting opportunities for our people!

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Director of Operations serves as the senior on-site leader and primary client partner for a premier workplace hospitality program designed to deliver an exceptional employee experience through intentional service, elevated culinary offerings, and world-class hospitality. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for building the operation from the ground up, establishing a culture of excellence, and ensuring every aspect of the program reflects the standards of leading workplace environments.

As the face of the account, the Director of Operations will oversee all dining, hospitality, catering, retail, and workplace experience initiatives while serving as the trusted advisor to the client. This leader will drive operational performance, financial stewardship, team development, and strategic growth while ensuring a seamless experience across breakfast, lunch, dinner, micro-kitchens, and a robust catering program. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in premium corporate dining, luxury hospitality, fine dining, or high-end food service environments and possesses the executive presence, emotional intelligence, and business acumen necessary to lead a rapidly growing operation.

Responsibilities

 

* Serve as the primary client-facing leader and strategic partner, building trusted relationships through exceptional communication, responsiveness, and operational execution.
* Lead the overall account strategy and daily operations, ensuring alignment with client goals, employee expectations, and company objectives.
* Launch and scale a premium workplace hospitality program designed to support significant organizational growth.
* Oversee multiple service platforms, including cafés, catering, workplace hospitality, executive events, micro-kitchens, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Provide leadership and direction to Café Managers, culinary leadership, catering teams, and hospitality staff while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and service excellence.
* Establish and maintain hospitality standards that deliver a highly personalized, white-glove guest experience.
* Drive a culture of intentional hospitality where every interaction enhances the employee and guest experience.
* Partner closely with the Senior Executive Chef to develop innovative dining experiences, culinary programming, and hospitality activations.
* Oversee a significant catering operation, ensuring flawless execution of meetings, executive functions, company events, and VIP hospitality experiences.
* Manage all financial aspects of the account, including budgeting, forecasting, P&L performance, labor management, cost controls, and financial reporting.
* Analyze operational and financial performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead recruitment, succession planning, employee engagement, and talent development efforts across the operation.
* Conduct regular business reviews with client stakeholders and provide strategic recommendations to enhance service offerings and overall program performance.
* Establish operational systems, policies, procedures, and service standards that support long-term scalability.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, client requirements, food safety programs, workplace safety standards, and applicable regulations.
* Champion innovation through hospitality programming, employee activations, wellness initiatives, and unique dining experiences.
* Create a highly engaged, service-focused culture that attracts, develops, and retains top hospitality talent.
* Collaborate with regional and corporate leadership to support account growth, business objectives, and long-term client retention.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Hotel Management, Culinary Management, or related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* 8-12+ years of progressive leadership experience in premium corporate dining, luxury hospitality, upscale restaurants, hotels, workplace experience, or high-end food service environments.
* Proven success leading large-scale food service, hospitality, or workplace dining operations with significant client interaction and operational complexity.
* Strong financial acumen with extensive experience managing P&Ls, budgets, forecasting, labor models, and operational performance metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to build and grow high-performing teams through leadership, coaching, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Experience opening new operations, launching hospitality programs, or leading rapidly growing business environments.
* Strong background managing catering operations, executive dining programs, VIP events, and hospitality-driven service models.
* Exceptional client relationship management skills with a track record of building trusted partnerships and delivering measurable business results.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to navigate complex situations, influence stakeholders, and lead through change.
* Experience working within highly visible client-facing environments where service expectations and attention to detail are exceptionally high.
* Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on operational leadership.
* Strong understanding of workplace hospitality trends, guest engagement strategies, and premium employee experience programs.
* Knowledge of food service operations, culinary programs, labor management, purchasing, inventory controls, and hospitality best practices.
* Proven ability to analyze business performance and develop operational strategies that drive growth, efficiency, and guest satisfaction.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive-level relationship-building skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, financial reporting tools, and operational management systems.
* Demonstrated professionalism, executive presence, business maturity, and leadership credibility.
* Passion for hospitality, service excellence, innovation, and creating extraordinary workplace experiences.

records.title: Director Supply Chain Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Who we are? As the world's largest organization of board-certified pathologists and leading provider of laboratory accreditation and proficiency testing programs, the College of American Pathologists (CAP) serves patients, pathologists, and the public by fostering and advocating excellence in the practice of pathology and laboratory medicine worldwide.
 
 
Our Culture
 

* CAP employees make a meaningful difference by partnering with colleagues customers and members on challenging and rewarding work
* CAP provides its employees with an energetic and collaborative work environment and encourage opportunities to further develop their skills—offering reimbursement for educational programs and participation in events that enhance your skills
* We offer a generous compensation and benefits package, 401K, and more -- visit Careers at the CAP for more details

Brief Description
 
The Director, Supply Chain Continuous Improvement is accountable for optimizing the end-to-end flow of work across the Supply Chain & Logistics function, including order management, procurement, planning, fulfillment, distribution, and logistics, from order receipt through customer delivery. The role streamlines and simplifies work, establishes process ownership and decision rights, clarifies roles and responsibilities, designs reliable handovers, and improves on-time delivery and temperature integrity through data, cross-functional leadership, and employee coaching.
 
 
Specific Duties
 

* Provides enterprise-wide matrix leadership to process owners, functional leaders, operations managers, and cross-functional transformation teams.
* Establishes accountability for outcomes, milestones, financial benefits, risk mitigation, and sustainment across a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
* Coaches senior leaders, managers, professional staff, and frontline employees in Lean, Lean Six Sigma, structured problem solving, change leadership, and daily management.
* May lead direct reports, contractors, consultants, or dedicated project resources as the transformation portfolio evolves.
* Develop and execute a multi-year Supply Chain & Logistics continuous improvement and operational excellence strategy aligned with enterprise customer, financial, quality, and service objectives.
* Own the Supply Chain & Logistics transformation portfolio: identify opportunities, size value, prioritize initiatives, define resource requirements, and govern delivery to scope, schedule, budget, risk, and targeted benefits.
* Lead end-to-end supply chain value-stream redesign across order management, procurement, planning, fulfillment, distribution, logistics, customer service, quality, and enabling functions.
* Establish process ownership, decision rights, escalation paths, governance forums, RACI frameworks, standard work, controls, and reliable handovers.
* Create an enterprise performance-management system and single source of truth for OTIF, temperature excursions, productivity, cost, handover defects, and customer-impact measures.
* Build executive-ready business cases for process, automation, analytics, and technology investments; partner with Finance to validate baselines, track realized value, and prevent benefit leakage.
* Lead complex Lean, A3, kaizen, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving initiatives that resolve systemic constraints and deliver sustained results.
* Sponsor digital process improvement using D365, WMS, TMS, workflow automation, Power BI/Tableau, and other enterprise platforms where appropriate.
* Build organizational capability through leader standard work, training, coaching, certification pathways, communities of practice, and succession development.
* Lead change-management and stakeholder-engagement plans that drive adoption, accountability, and sustained behavioral change.
* Partner with Quality, Customer Service, Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Human Resources, cold-packaging teams, suppliers, technology partners, and external carriers.
* Present portfolio performance, financial impact, risks, decisions, and recommendations to executive leadership and governance forums.

Source of Supervision
 
The Director, Supply Chain Continuous Improvement is a seasoned supply chain and operations excellence leader accountable for creating measurable enterprise value by improving the end-to-end flow of work across Supply Chain & Logistics and the broader value chain, from order receipt through customer delivery. This role owns the continuous improvement operating system and process governance for Supply Chain & Logistics, while leading a portfolio of high-impact cross-functional initiatives that improve customer experience, service reliability, quality, temperature integrity, productivity, working capital, and cost. The Director partners with executive and functional leaders to translate supply chain and logistics strategy into scalable processes, clear decision rights, disciplined execution, and sustained financial and operational results.
 
 
Education / Experience
 

* Expert-level knowledge and practitioner of Lean, operational excellence, supply chain value-stream management, process governance, and structured problem solving.
* Demonstrated record of leading supply chain, logistics, or enterprise-scale transformations and delivering measurable improvements in customer service, quality, productivity, cycle time, cost, working capital, and operational resilience.
* Strong financial acumen, including business-case development, investment prioritization, benefit validation, sensitivity analysis, and executive-level performance reporting.
* Advanced analytical capability using data modeling, dashboards, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable tools to convert complex data into decisions and action.
* Proven ability to influence executives and functional leaders without direct authority in a complex, matrixed, and regulated environment.
* Exceptional executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, change leadership, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Preferred: Experience with D365, WMS, TMS, workflow automation, process mining, and regulated, laboratory, life-sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics-distribution, or cold-chain operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Industrial or Systems Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field required; master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced education preferred.
* Twelve or more years of progressive experience in operational excellence, process transformation, and continuous improvement.
* Seven or more years leading teams, enterprise programs, or complex cross-functional transformation portfolios with executive visibility and measurable financial and operational outcomes.
* Experience partnering with Finance to validate benefits and with IT to deliver process-enabled digital transformation strongly preferred.
* Experience in laboratory, life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, diagnostics distribution, cold chain, or another quality-driven and regulated environment preferred.

Additional Criteria
 
This position requires candidates to live within 75-miles of Northfield, IL and meet in office requirements.
 
**Salary:** $138,000 - $176,000

records.description:
**Entity:** CSL Behring

**Job Category:** Research Development & Sciences

**Job Family:** Clinical Development Operations

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Location****:** King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States

**Employer Reference:** R-296735

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Director, Performance Management & Continuous Improvement**
====================================================================

 
 

**Location: King of Prussia, PA or Melbourne, Australia | Hybrid – 3 days onsite**
==================================================================================

 
 

CSL Behring is a global biopharmaceutical leader committed to developing innovative therapies for patients with rare and serious diseases. Through scientific innovation, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to patients, we strive to transform treatment options and address significant unmet medical needs.

 
 

**The Opportunit****y**
=======================

 
 

The Senior Director, Performance Management & Continuous Improvement will provide strategic leadership for an integrated R&D capability focused on strengthening organizational performance, accelerating execution, and maximizing the value of R&D investment.

 
 

This is a high-impact leadership role that connects performance analytics, continuous improvement, program execution, and organizational change to help transform how R&D operates. The successful candidate will establish a strategic vision for how performance insights translate into meaningful business action, enabling leadership to identify opportunities, optimize resources, prioritize investments, and drive sustainable improvements across the global R&D organization.

 
 

Leading a multidisciplinary team, the Senior Director will oversee a portfolio of interconnected capabilities, including performance metrics and analytics, continuous improvement, major R&D initiatives, change management, process management, and project management tools and capability development.

This individual will serve as a strategic partner to R&D leadership, bringing together data, people, and processes to strengthen decision-making, improve operational effectiveness, and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

 
 

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

 
 

**R&D Performance Management & Resource Optimization**
======================================================

 
 

* Establish and evolve an integrated performance management framework for R&D, including objectives, KPIs, benchmarks, and operational performance measures.
* Lead the development of resource capacity and schedule management strategies aligned with portfolio priorities, governance, and delivery commitments.
* Leverage performance data and analytics to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and areas requiring intervention.
 

 

**Executive Insights & Strategic Decision Support**
===================================================

 
 

* Translate complex performance data into meaningful insights, recommendations, and executive-level reporting.
* Partner with senior R&D leaders to support strategic decision-making, resource optimization, investment prioritization, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish a consistent approach to performance reviews and business insights that drives accountability and informed action.
 

 

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**
===================================================

 
 

* Define and lead the continuous improvement strategy across R&D, identifying opportunities to increase productivity, improve processes, reduce costs, and enhance organizational effectiveness.
* Prioritize improvement initiatives based on strategic value, business impact, and alignment with R&D objectives.
* Drive structured problem-solving and data-driven improvement methodologies to ensure sustainable outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Establish governance, sponsorship, and performance measures to track the success and long-term impact of improvement initiatives.
 

 

**Strategic Initiatives & Cross-Functional Execution**
======================================================

 
 

* Provide portfolio-level leadership and oversight for major, cross-functional R&D initiatives.
* Ensure initiatives are aligned with strategic priorities and supported by disciplined planning, governance, stakeholder engagement, and transparent reporting.
* Coordinate improvement initiatives across R&D functions, ensuring teams move effectively from identifying business challenges to implementing sustainable solutions.
* Proactively identify barriers, manage escalations, and maintain focus on execution and measurable outcomes.
 

 

**Enterprise Change Management & Transformation**
=================================================

 
 

* Lead the development and execution of change management strategies supporting the adoption of new processes, systems, governance models, and ways of working across R&D.
* Ensure initiatives have comprehensive change plans, including stakeholder assessments, communications, training, sponsorship, change networks, readiness assessments, and adoption measures.
* Partner with Quality and other relevant functions to ensure changes within GxP-regulated environments meet applicable SOP, training, documentation, and inspection-readiness requirements.
* Drive organizational alignment and adoption to ensure transformation initiatives deliver lasting business value.
 

 

**Process Management & Organizational Learning**
================================================

 
 

* Strengthen R&D process effectiveness through structured issue resolution, process reviews, audit implementation, and continuous improvement practices.
* Promote consistent use of Before- and After-Action Reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future execution.
* Establish mechanisms to share best practices and embed organizational learning across R&D.
 

 

**Project Management Capability & Development**
===============================================

 
 

* Provide strategic direction for common project management tools, methodologies, templates, and governance practices.
* Sponsor project management capability-building initiatives, including PM Academy activities, to strengthen execution and delivery discipline across R&D.
* Promote consistent project management practices that enable teams to effectively plan, manage, and deliver complex initiatives.
 

 

**People Leadership & Organizational Integration**
==================================================

 
 

* Lead, develop, and inspire a multidisciplinary performance management and continuous improvement team.
* Establish a clear vision, priorities, and accountabilities across performance analytics, continuous improvement, major initiatives, change management, and project management capabilities.
* Foster collaboration and integration across disciplines, coach and develop talent, and create an environment focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 

 
 

**Qualifications & Experience**
===============================

 
 

* Bachelor's degree in Science, Business, Operations, Analytics, or a related discipline required. Master's degree in a relevant field preferred.
* Professional certifications or training in project management, Lean/Six Sigma, operational excellence, change management (Prosci, ACMP/CCMP), analytics, or related disciplines are advantageous.
* 12+ years experience in R&D operations, performance management, operational excellence, continuous improvement, strategic initiative management, program/project management, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated success integrating performance analytics and business insights with strategic decision-making and practical improvement execution.
* Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities, including experience with KPIs, performance metrics, benchmarking, portfolio data, and resource management.
* Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives within a global, matrixed organization.
* Extensive experience in continuous improvement, structured problem-solving, organizational transformation, and benefits realization.
* Demonstrated expertise in enterprise change management, including stakeholder engagement, change strategy, communications, training, adoption, and resistance management.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical R&D and the broader research, development, and manufacturing environment.
* Proven ability to build relationships, align diverse stakeholders, and drive results across functions and geographies.
* Successful track record leading and developing multidisciplinary teams and integrating complementary capabilities into a cohesive operating model.
 

 

#LI-HYBRID

**About CSL Behring**
---------------------

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients' needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world's largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL.

**You Belong at CSL**
---------------------

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.

To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement.

records.description:
### **Description**

**Schedule**: Exempt, min 40 Hours per week | Monday - Friday | 8am - 4:30pm 
**Department:** Interdisciplinary | Muskegon, Mi
 
 
**What You’ll Do:**

Lead a dedicated interdisciplinary team in delivering high-quality, participant-centered care through the PACE model. You'll coach and mentor team members, collaborate with organizational leaders, and empower participants to achieve their goals while promoting independence, dignity, and overall well-being.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and support a high-performing interdisciplinary team.
* Facilitate IDT meetings and promote collaboration, accountability, and participant-centered decision-making.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing team development.
* Monitor team and participant outcomes using data to drive continuous improvement.
* Foster exceptional customer service and a culture aligned with LifeCircles' mission, vision, and values.

**Care Planning & Coordination**

* Guide comprehensive care planning that reflects participant goals, preferences, and needs.
* Partner with interdisciplinary teams, departments, and external providers to ensure coordinated care.
* Oversee implementation of care plans and service delivery.
* Support participant eligibility, enrollment, and care transitions through strong understanding of PACE requirements.
* Identify and address high-risk clinical, behavioral, or operational concerns.

**Operations & Quality**

* Ensure compliance with PACE regulations, organizational standards, and quality initiatives.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including participant outcomes and service utilization.
* Support effective use of the electronic medical record (EMR) and operational processes.
* Lead quality improvement efforts that enhance care delivery, efficiency, and participant experience.
* Participate in audits, surveys, and regulatory reviews.
* *Additional duties may be assigned as needed.*

*The above is a summary of the position, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties this position will be required to perform. If selected for the position you will receive a full job description.*

 

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 

* Bachelor's degree in a healthcare-related field required; Master's degree preferred.
* Professional licensure (RN, LMSW/LLMSW, RD, PT, OT, or similar) preferred.
* Current CPR certification or willingness to obtain.
* Valid Michigan driver's license and reliable transportation required.

* Minimum of one (1) year of experience working with frail older adults required; three (3) or more years of experience in an interdisciplinary, team-based healthcare setting preferred.
* Leadership or supervisory experience in PACE, managed care, home health, hospice, geriatrics, or a related healthcare environment preferred.
* Experience leading interdisciplinary teams and coordinating participant-centered care.
* Experience with care coordination, service utilization, population health, or quality improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to support operational excellence, process improvement, and change management efforts.

* Knowledge of PACE regulations, CMS requirements, and Medicaid guidelines.
* Strong leadership, coaching, team-building, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive operational excellence.
* Experience using data and performance metrics to support decision-making.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic health record (EHR) systems.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and influence positive outcomes.

 

### **Benefits**

 

* **Generous 6 weeks of Flexible time off per year**—plus **paid holidays** on top of that.
* **Competitive Benefits for Full-Time Team Members** – Enjoy Medical, Vision & Dental Insurance starting on the 1st of the month after 30 days of hire.
* **Retirement Savings Plan** – Secure your future with employer contributions.
* **Daily Pay** –Instantly transfer your daily earnings.
* **Team Member Referral Bonus Program** – Earn $500 when you bring great people to our team!
* **Career Growth & Development** – Advance your career with tuition assistance and school scholarships up to $3,000 per semester.
* **Wellness Program & Reimbursemen**t – Prioritize your health and well-being, reimbursed 120 a year!
* **Mileage Reimbursement** – Offered for work-related travel.

Brio Living Services is dedicated to enriching the lives of seniors through exceptional, faith-based, nonprofit senior living communities. Offering a full continuum of care, including independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and memory care, Brio provides maintenance-free lifestyles and personalized support to meet residents' evolving needs. With a focus on wellness, connection, and vibrant aging, Brio empowers residents to pursue their interests, build meaningful relationships, and thrive in welcoming communities.

Brio Living Services does not use artificial intelligence (AI) to make employment decisions. AI may be used only to assist with administrative tasks, such as organizing information, summarizing reviewed materials, and collecting notes.
