If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please contact us at **loveyourcareer@mybrio.org**. Language assistance may also be available for applicants who require support in a language other than English. Please reach out so we can discuss your needs and available resources.

Brio Living Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

records.title: Director, Business Ops & Analytics - Talent Operations, Governance & Enablement

postedPay.title: Director, Business Ops & Analytics - Talent Operations, Governance & Enablement

records.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

**Job Summary**

Own the operating systems, governance, controls, enablement, and execution disciplines that allow Talent to deliver strategy consistently, safely, efficiently, and at scale. 
Translate Talent strategy and enterprise requirements into clear operating models, processes, controls, decision rights, knowledge, readiness, and adoption mechanisms while protecting regulatory, compliance, and business-continuity obligations.

**Job Description**

**Key Accountabilities:**

* **Design and govern the Talent operating model**, establishing clear processes, standards, decision rights, ownership, handoffs, and escalation mechanisms across Talent.
* **Own the Talent compliance operating framework**, translating Legal and Compliance requirements into operational controls, monitoring, documentation, evidence, and sustainable Talent practices.
* **Lead Talent audit readiness and coordination**, maintaining visibility to compliance obligations, control ownership, audit evidence, findings, remediation, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Provide governance and execution discipline for strategic programs**, ensuring clear ownership, dependencies, risks, decisions, readiness, and accountability.
* **Lead organizational and operational readiness**, ensuring new processes, technologies, automation, and strategic programs can be successfully implemented and sustained.
* **Own change, adoption, and enablement disciplines**, translating organizational change into the knowledge, capabilities, communications, tools, and reinforcement required for successful execution.
* **Govern Talent knowledge and process architecture**, establishing trusted sources of truth, documentation standards, knowledge ownership, and scalable access to policies, processes, and guidance.
* **Drive process optimization and continuous improvement**, identifying friction, simplifying work, standardizing execution, and partnering with Technology & Automation partners to embed processes and controls into systems.
* **Own or coordinate Talent business continuity, operational risk, and records-management requirements** within the Talent operating environment.
* **Establish and govern the Talent responsibility model for AI-enabled work**, ensuring clear human accountability as automation scales through defined decision rights, policy and control logic, data and knowledge integrity, exception management, escalation paths, documentation, and ongoing oversight of AI-enabled processes and outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**

* Directing the implementation of operational policies to enhance organizational effectiveness and strategic execution
* Leading the design and execution of business strategies to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness
* Guiding cross-functional teams in the integration of analytics for robust strategic decision-making support
* Driving the optimization of business processes to improve overall performance and market positioning
* Championing the adoption of innovative operational practices to maintain a leading edge in business operations
* Steering the evaluation and refinement of operational policies to support dynamic business needs
* Cultivating a culture of continuous improvement to foster operational excellence and strategic growth
* Facilitating the alignment of financial and business analytics to inform and influence key strategic initiatives
* Managing the analysis and communication of management data to support operational decisions and highlight areas for improvement
* Aligning business processes within functional areas to the broader strategic objectives of the organization
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

**Skills**

Advanced Analytics, Business Process Improvements, Executive Leadership, Financial Management, Operational Excellence, Organizational Change Management, People Management

**Compensation**

This job can be performed in Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, Washington, and Denver Campus with a Pay Range of $132,421.96 - $248,291.18. This job can be performed in California with a good faith estimated pay range upon hire of $119,179.77 USD - $220,703.27.Comcast intends to offer the selected candidate base pay within the posted range for this role at the time of posting dependent on job-related, non-discriminatory factors such as experience. The application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree

**Certifications** (if applicable)

**Relevant Work Experience**

10 Years +Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations**
--------------------------------------------

**Location:** Warren, MI 
**Work Model:** On-Site 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:**General Manager

**About SLPT**
--------------

**SLPT** is a manufacturing organization committed to delivering quality, reliability, and operational excellence for our customers. Located in Warren, Michigan, we take pride in building a culture where safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement drive everything we do.Our success starts with our people. We believe the best results come from empowered leaders who are willing to take ownership, develop talent, solve challenges, and continually raise the bar for performance. From the production floor to the leadership team, we foster an environment where employees are respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally.As we continue to invest in our operations, technology, and workforce, we are seeking leaders who are passionate about manufacturing excellence and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in shaping plant culture, driving continuous improvement, developing future leaders, and ensuring we consistently deliver exceptional results for our customers.

**Why Join SLPT?**
------------------

* Lead a high-impact manufacturing operation with significant responsibility and visibility.
* Influence plant strategy, operational performance, and business growth.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful results.
* Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
* Develop and mentor employees while building a culture of accountability, engagement, and success.
* Join an organization that values strong leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.

**At SLPT, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our people, our customers, and the future of our manufacturing operations.**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? We are seeking an experienced **Plant Manager**to lead all aspects of our Warren, Michigan manufacturing operation. In this role, you will oversee safety, quality, production, delivery performance, cost management, and employee development across a 24-hour operation.You will play a key role in driving operational excellence, implementing Lean Manufacturing initiatives, and developing high-performing teams while ensuring customer expectations and business objectives are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership experience, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering results in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across multiple shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, environmental standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Oversee production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, warehousing, and logistics functions.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximize Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor plant financial performance, including labor costs, operating expenses, inventory, maintenance spending, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support successful new product launches by partnering with engineering, quality, materials, and program management teams.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions to improve quality performance, reduce scrap and rework, and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Develop leaders and employees through coaching, succession planning, workforce development, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Utilize KPIs and operational metrics to identify opportunities, solve problems, and drive sustainable business improvements.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or similar senior manufacturing leader.
* Proven success managing multi-shift manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve and sustain performance targets in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets and operational expenses.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Automotive manufacturing experience.
* Experience supporting or maintaining IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 quality systems.
* Expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Kaizen, and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Certified Manufacturing Manager (CMfgM), PMP certification, or similar professional credentials.
* Master's degree in a related discipline.

Why you'll want to join our team:

* Lead a critical manufacturing operation with broad operational responsibility.
* Make a meaningful impact on plant performance, customer satisfaction, and company growth.
* Partner with an experienced leadership team in a collaborative environment.
* Drive operational excellence and shape the future of the facility.
* Develop and mentor the next generation of manufacturing leaders.
* Influence strategic initiatives, capital investments, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive benefits and salary package being offered for this role.

This position is based on-site in Warren, MI and requires a strong presence on the production floor. Occasional travel may be required for customer meetings, supplier visits, training, and corporate initiatives.

**Job Summary**
Responsible for providing leadership and direction to Quality team(s) to ensure quality and compliance for the applicable products and processes for assigned department(s) at the manufacturing site. Develop strategy, translate into functional plans and guide execution of long-term goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**

* Management Representative for the site to ensure quality and regulatory compliance with applicable regulations (e.g., QSR, PQS, GMP, ISO, ICH) pertaining to the product's applicable life cycle and regions of distribution.
* Partner with Plant Operations to ensure optimal collaborative, effective relationships and drive continuous improvement.
* Develop and implement a strategy for the Quality department(s) based on the Quarterly Management Review.
* Ensure the Manufacturing site readiness for internal audits, external regulatory audits, and customer visits.
* Act as liaison with Senior Leadership of Divisions, Suppliers, Manufacturing, and/or Operations to ensure quality products, on time delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Oversee procedures for inspection and ensure test methods are followed for incoming, in-process, and finished product release to ensure product is in alignment with applicable regulations
* Oversee QSR/QMS/PQS for assigned department(s) and ensure compliance as measured by FDA/ISO/internal audits.

**Management Responsibilities Include**

* Typically, manages through multiple Managers. Provides leadership and management to site QA/QC teams.
* Strategic, tactical and operational planning (12 + months) for the function or department;
* Direct budgetary responsibility for one or more departments, functions or major projects/programs;
* Interpret and execute policies for departments/projects and develops;
* Recommend and implement new policies or modifications to existing policies;
* Hiring staff, recommending pay increases, performing performance reviews, training and development of staff, estimating personnel needs, assigning work, meeting completion dates, interpreting and ensuring consistent application of organizational policies.

**Qualifications**

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or Technical Field.
* At least 7 years of experience related to the design/operation of medical device or drug combination product platforms, design controls, risk management, including working in compliance with QSR/GMP/ISO/PQS/ICH requirements or other regulated industries (21CFR 820, 21CFR 210/211, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR).
* Depth of technical knowledge of relevant standards and regulations (21CFR 820, 21 CFR 210/211, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, MDSAP, and MDR etc.)
* Proficiency in analyzing and reporting data in order to identify issues, trends, or exceptions to drive improvement of results and find solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to control and coordinate concurrent projects, competing priorities and critical deadlines.
* Advanced level skill in Microsoft Excel (for example: using AVERAGE function, merging and centering cells, printing centered page and/or creating a pivot table).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* At least 6 years of managerial experience preferred.
* At least 8 years of related experience in Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Food, Cosmetic, or Personal Products industries preferred.

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

Join the Home for Entrepreneurs
  
  
Pioneer your career! Körber is the home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do. Entrepreneurial spirit is our joint DNA. We develop future technologies and support talents to deploy their skills and reach their full potential. Together, we aim for being the first to do the right thing at the right time. Join the home for entrepreneurs!
  
  
As the Director of Quality at Körber USA, you are responsible for leading the organization’s quality strategy and Quality Management System. This role ensures product, plant, supplier, project, and service quality and drives compliance with ISO 9001 and other applicable quality requirements. You will lead the Quality department, strengthen customer satisfaction, improve product reliability, reduce warranty and cost of poor quality, and promote continuous improvement across the business.
  
  
**Your Role in Our Team**

* Develop and lead the Quality Vision, Mission, and strategy for Körber USA, aligning quality objectives with business goals and customer expectations
* Drive quality performance by implementing initiatives that improve KPIs, reduce cost of poor quality, enhance product reliability, and increase customer satisfaction
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality organization, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence
* Own and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and other applicable regulatory and industry standards
* Establish and enforce quality assurance policies, processes, and product quality standards across manufacturing operations and project sites
* Manage internal and external audits, regulatory compliance activities, and corrective actions to ensure ongoing adherence to quality requirements
* Partner with customers and suppliers to improve product and service quality through feedback, supplier development, audits, performance evaluations, and continuous improvement programs
* Integrate quality planning, risk management, and quality controls into project execution and operational processes to ensure compliance with specifications and customer requirements

**Your Profile**

* Proven leadership ability to build, coach, and develop high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and employee engagement
* Demonstrated success leading organizational change and influencing cross-functional stakeholders to achieve business and quality objectives
* Deep expertise in Quality Management Systems (QMS), ISO 9001, quality audits, corrective actions, compliance programs, certification activities, and regulatory requirements
* Ability to develop and execute a quality strategy aligned with business goals, driving KPI improvement, customer satisfaction, warranty reduction, and cost of poor quality initiatives
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate organizational objectives into actionable quality programs, prioritize initiatives, and make sound decisions
* Experience building organizational capability through talent development, performance management, succession planning, training programs, and leadership development
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, customer service, and relationship-building skills, with a commitment to fostering psychological safety, inclusion, and ethical decision-making
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field required; Master's degree and/or certifications such as CQE or Six Sigma Black Belt preferred, with 15+ years of quality leadership experience in manufacturing and a proven record of achieving and maintaining ISO certification and driving quality improvements

Eligible applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The employer will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

records.description:
**Position Summary**
The Director, Quality is responsible for leading multiple manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality resources in the execution of the overall STERIS Quality System. This position is principally responsible for manufacturing/service site or functional quality system execution to drive product/service quality improvement and ensure compliance with, as appropriate, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, FDA QMSR CFR Part 820/211, EU MDR, and other applicable standards. Supporting the GI Reprocessing business, this role provides quality leadership for products, processes, and services that help healthcare providers safely clean, disinfect, and reprocess gastrointestinal endoscopes and related equipment. The Director will champion a culture of quality, compliance, and continuous improvement, helping ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and reliable solutions that support infection prevention, patient safety, and customer confidence. The Quality Director will lead teams of quality managers and engineers responsible for product and service quality, supplier quality, new product/service support, continuous improvement initiatives, and quality system execution. This leader will partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, support innovation, and enhance quality performance across the GI Reprocessing portfolio.
  
  
Preferred onsite location: Mentor, OH, with consideration for candidates based in Plymouth, MN or Conroe, TX.
  
  
**What You’ll Do As a Director Quality**

* The Director, Quality will have responsibility for the following: Leads manufacturing/service sites and/or corporate quality staff in the execution and continuous improvement of the STERIS Quality System. Operates with a focus on the following objectives:

+ Ensures site level compliance to appropriate ISO, FDA, and other applicable regulatory standards.
+ Drives strategies and methods to continuously improve capital, consumable and service product quality performance.
+ Establishes clear and consistent quality measurement systems in order to monitor and drive results.
+ Leads quality planning and the execution of assigned New Product/Service Development (NPD) projects to achieve targeted quality deliverable adherence.

General Summary
  
  
The Global Director of Quality is responsible for oversight of Quality Management and Continuous Improvement Programs for Team Industrial Services globally. The position is ultimately responsible for all corporate and Divisional Quality and Continuous support personnel. The successful candidate provides the necessary management and oversight to ensure the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of TEAM’s Quality Management System (QMS) as well as the supplemental Quality Control and Technical programs. Position is responsible for managing and coordinating all Quality support activities relating to the execution of the Quality Management System (QMS) for Team Corporate, Product and Service Line, Engineering and Manufacturing, and Operations. Global Director of Quality is responsible for operating on a cost-effective basis within the framework of company approved policies, objectives, and budgets.
  
  
**Essential Job Functions**

* Maintains a safe, secure and healthy environment by adhering to Company/Customer safety and quality standards and practices and to legal regulations, alerting others regarding potential hazards or concern
* Adheres to and is a champion of TEAM’s Core Values
* Establish a continuous improvement culture across the enterprise utilizing known methods and concepts such as Lean, Six Sigma, FMEA, Kaizen, Poka-yoke, CAPA, 8D, etc.
* Maintains contact with district, division and corporate levels to promote and instill a “Quality Culture” throughout the organization.
* Ensure TEAMs QMS is globally consistent and regionally precise based on local requirements.
* When necessary, provide training to affected personnel, including customers, to obtain maximum process efficiency, productivity, cooperation, and morale.

* Manage the Supplier Quality Management program and supports third-party and Customer assessments.

* Experience in Oil and Gas, Lean Manufacturing, Petrochemical, or a Field Service Industry is a must.
* 15 years’ experience in Quality or Operational Excellence related function.
* Experience with problem solving methods such as A3, FMEA, etc. preferred.
* Experience in introducing/implementing a solid warranty tracking system that captures accurate Customer and or Field related issues.

At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.

* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.

**Nice to have:**

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Position Overview:**

The Director of Quality will lead the quality function across the organization and create the operating model required for the company’s next stage of growth. This leader will be accountable for enterprise quality strategy, product and process quality, supplier and customer quality, and the effectiveness of the company’s quality management systems. The role will maintain applicable certifications, including ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and AS9100, while establishing a disciplined approach to quality diligence and integration for future acquisitions.

The Director of Quality must combine independent judgment with a practical understanding of manufacturing. This leader will know what strong quality looks like, but will build it in a way that fits the company's scale, products, customers, and maturity. Success requires the ability to move between enterprise strategy and a specific customer or production issue; challenge legacy practices while respecting operational knowledge; and bring people through change with clarity, evidence, and follow-through.

This is not a quality-systems-only position. The Director must remain close to manufacturing, customers, and the issues that affect product conformity, delivery, cost, and trust. The successful candidate will bring the rigor expected in regulated manufacturing, apply it without unnecessary bureaucracy, and build a quality organization that can identify risk early, solve problems at their source, and support sustainable growth.

**Essential Functions:**

* Set the global quality strategy. Assess the company's current quality environment and establish a multiyear roadmap aligned with business strategy, customer commitments, regulatory obligations, and acquisition plans. Translate the roadmap into clear priorities, resources, ownership, and measures of success.
* Lead the quality organization. Direct and develop quality leaders and teams across the sites. Define the structure, capabilities, decision rights, and functional accountability required to support a larger international manufacturing organization.
* Own the enterprise quality management system. Ensure effective governance and execution across document and change control, training, nonconformance, CAPA, complaints, risk management, supplier controls, internal audits, management review, and other core processes. Maintain applicable certifications and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.
* Strengthen product and process quality. Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve quality planning, process validation and control, inspection, calibration, measurement systems, first-article or new-product readiness, and change execution. Use disciplined problem solving and prevention to reduce defects, scrap, rework, escapes, and recurring failures.
* Lead customer and supplier quality. Establish consistent expectations for customer issue response, supplier qualification and monitoring, supplier corrective action, and escalation. Ensure material issues are contained quickly, investigated to root cause, resolved with effective corrective action, and communicated with credibility.
* Create audit and inspection readiness. Lead the enterprise internal audit program and oversee registrar, customer, and regulatory audits. Maintain visibility to findings, commitments, certification status, and systemic risk, and verify that corrective actions are timely and effective.
* Use data to govern performance. Establish a focused set of enterprise and site quality measures, including customer complaints, defects, escapes, scrap and rework, supplier performance, CAPA effectiveness, and audit performance. Lead global management review and give executives a clear view of trends, risk, and required actions.
* Harmonize with purpose. Define the policies, standards, escalation requirements, and controls that must be common across the organization. Rationalize legacy processes and quality technologies, including eQMS capabilities, while preserving local differences that are justified by product, customer, regulatory, or operating needs.
* Lead quality through acquisitions. Support quality due diligence by assessing systems, certifications, audit history, customer and regulatory commitments, product and process risk, and organizational capability. Build and execute risk-based integration plans with clear Day 1 controls, remediation priorities, and a realistic path to the quality model.
* Exercise independent quality authority. Ensure that Quality has direct access to the information and leaders needed to escalate material risk. Maintain clear authority to contain nonconforming product and stop release or shipment when applicable requirements may not be met, while building shared ownership of quality across the business.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, quality, or a related technical field.
* At least 10 years of progressive quality experience in manufacturing, including at least five years leading quality teams or leaders.
* Demonstrated success leading quality across multiple manufacturing sites, business units, or regions.
* Experience with product and process quality, quality engineering, customer quality, supplier quality, and quality management systems in a regulated or highly technical environment.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and AS9100, including direct responsibility for audits, certification, corrective action, and management review. Equivalent experience spanning multiple regulated standards will be considered.
* Deep experience with CAPA, nonconformance, root-cause analysis, risk management, process validation and control, measurement systems, and data-driven continuous improvement.
* Ability to identify and communicate material product, customer, and compliance risk and to influence operational and executive decisions with sound evidence and judgment.
* Experience building teams, developing leaders, and driving change across a matrixed or decentralized organization.
* Ability and willingness to travel regularly within the United States and Europe.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in precision manufacturing serving medical device, aerospace, life sciences, or other regulated and quality-sensitive markets.
* Experience in an acquisition-driven, or rapidly scaling organization.
* Experience conducting quality due diligence and integrating acquired manufacturing businesses, sites, or quality systems.
* Experience with electronic quality management systems, quality data architecture, or digital quality transformation.
* Working knowledge of applicable medical device regulations and audit programs, such as FDA QMSR, EU MDR, or MDSAP.
* Lead Auditor, ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, or Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Experience leading quality across the United States and Europe.

**Director of Manufacturing**

This is an opportunity for someone who understands how to grow a manufacturing operation without sacrificing safety, quality, or workmanship.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Vice President of Manufacturing, the
**Director of Manufacturing**
will oversee daily manufacturing operations across multiple production departments, with responsibility for production performance, labor efficiency, quality, safety, and workforce development.

We're looking for a leader who is just as comfortable on the manufacturing floor as they are developing operational strategy. Someone who understands how to identify bottlenecks, develop frontline leaders, establish accountability, and translate business objectives into measurable results.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead Manufacturing Operations**

* Oversee daily manufacturing operations, production schedules, capacity planning, and labor utilization to meet production and customer delivery commitments.
* Lead and develop production managers, supervisors, and department leaders.
* Establish clear performance expectations and consistent production standards across departments.
* Improve coordination between production teams to maintain workflow and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Plan and implement multi-shift operations as production demands increase.

**Improve Operational Performance**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase throughput, improve labor efficiency, reduce costs, and expand manufacturing capacity.
* Establish and monitor manufacturing KPIs, including production output, labor efficiency, schedule attainment, rework, and on-time delivery.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement sustainable solutions.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies to standardize processes and improve performance.
* Develop scalable manufacturing processes that support long-term business growth.

**Build and Develop Strong Teams**

* Coach and develop manufacturing managers and supervisors to become effective, independent leaders.
* Establish a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and quality workmanship.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, staffing, succession planning, and employee development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, and supervisory coverage to meet operational needs.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, attendance, performance, and adherence to company policies.

**Champion Safety and Quality**

* Maintain a safe manufacturing environment in compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and applicable industry standards.
* Partner with Quality and Safety teams to reduce defects, rework, incidents, and operational risks.
* Ensure manufactured products consistently meet engineering specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective actions to prevent recurring production and quality issues.

* Partner with Finance and executive leadership on manufacturing budgets, capital expenditures, and cost-control initiatives.
* Evaluate equipment, facility, workforce, and technology needs to support increased production.

**Company Description**
The Father’s Table is a privately owned national dessert manufacturer based in sunny Sanford, Florida, known for its innovation and extensive product lines. The company serves multiple channels, including national retail accounts, food service, wholesale clubs, convenience stores, and school lunch programs, reaching far beyond local bakeries. A unique production process and strong company values have helped The Father’s Table become the #1 branded cheesecake in the retail in-store bakery segment. Applicants can learn more about the company by visiting www.thefatherstable.com.

**Director of Manufacturing**

Department: Operations Reports To: President ,Direct Reports: Plant Managers, Senior Manager of Cheesecake Production, Position Summary: The Director of Manufacturing provides strategic and operational leadership across two manufacturing facilities overseeing approximately 1,000 employees. This role serves as the primary architect of operational excellence moving the organization toward more data-driven decisions. The Director standardizes processes, drives toward modern manufacturing systems (KPIs, OEE, ERP), ensures food safety, and champions the successful implementation and optimization of our core cheesecake production lines.

---

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

**1. Change Management & Professionalization**

· Standardize Operations: Develop, implement, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) across both plants to ensure consistency in quality, safety, and efficiency.

· Cultivate Leadership: Mentor, coach, and upskill plant managers and front-line supervisors, shifting the culture from firefighting to proactive, structured problem-solving.

· Data-Driven Culture: Introduce and track rigorous key performance indicators (KPIs) and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) metrics to guide daily, weekly, and monthly business reviews.

**2. Core Product Implementation & Optimization (Cheesecake Operations)**

· Product Optimization: Partner with the Senior Production Manager to evaluate all new cheesecake formulas, sizes, and configurations introduced into production.

· Constraint Assessment: Review new product introductions to assess potential issues or constraints affecting quality performance, labor efficiency, run rates, and operating costs.

· Executional Direction: Provide hands-on, "feet-on-the-floor" leadership to the operations team during major line optimizations, ERP system changes, and plant renovations.

**3. Food Safety, Quality & Compliance**

· Regulatory & Legality: Ensure both facilities strictly adhere to FDA, USDA, OSHA, and local regulations, taking ultimate responsibility for the safety and legality of all food products.

· Audit Readiness: Maintain "always audit-ready" standards for SQF, BRC, or other GFSI-benchmarked certifications and retail customer audits.

· Safety Culture: Champion a zero-injury safety culture through robust Hazard Identification, training, and behavioral safety programs.

4. Financial & Strategic Management

· P&L Responsibility: Manage the manufacturing budget, labor costs, variances, and operational expenses across both plants.

· CAPEX Planning: Identify, justify, and execute capital expenditure (CAPEX) projects aimed at automation, capacity expansion, and facility modernization.

---

**Required Qualifications**

· Experience: 10+ years of progressive food production operations management experience, with at least 5+ years in a multi-plant or regional leadership role.

· Scale & Product Expertise: Proven track record of managing a large workforce (500–1,000+ employees) in high-volume environments, with deep knowledge of automated bakery or cheesecake production processes.

· Transformation Experience: Demonstrated success leading an organization through a professionalization journey or significant operational scaling.

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related technical field. An MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

· Certifications: Lean/Six Sigma Green or Black Belt highly desirable. Full understanding of SQF/BRC and HACCP systems.

---

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

· Mobility: Must be able to travel between both manufacturing facilities on a daily/regular basis and spend significant time on the shop floor.

· Environment: Willingness to work in production environments with moderate-to-high noise levels (requiring hearing protection) and varying temperatures ranging from 45°F to 95°F.

* · Physical Capability: Ability to stand and walk for extended periods (up to 8–12 hours) during plant walkthroughs and occasionally lift or handle up to 35–50 lbs when assisting on the line

records.description:
Please review the job details below.
  
  
Intuitive Machines - West is currently seeking a courageous, innovative, multi-skilled Director of High-Rate AIT Production to join our spacecraft production team in Palo Alto, CA.
  
  
**Life with Us**
Your Project: Intuitive Machines is a world leader in high-power spacecraft, having delivered some of the largest and highest-power spacecraft in the world. We are now looking to take this legacy of excellence to the next level, architecting a high-volume production line to build a large number of advanced spacecraft.
  
  
In this role, you will architect and implement a high-volume assembly, integration, and test (AIT) production line for these next-generation vehicles. You will be responsible for transforming our AIT operations from low-rate to high-rate production, establishing scalable processes and organizational capabilities to support our ambitious production targets. The scope includes complete spacecraft AIT from component receipt through final acceptance testing, encompassing electrical systems integration, solar array integration with the spacecraft bus, battery integration, advanced thermal solutions, and comprehensive environmental testing at production scale.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is developing an efficient, right-sized test program—one that provides high confidence the vehicles will perform as designed while eliminating non-value-added test activities that add cost and schedule without commensurate risk reduction. You will apply rigorous engineering judgment to distinguish between essential verification activities and legacy testing practices that may not be necessary for production-rate vehicles.
  
  
We are looking for leaders to bravely challenge conventional AIT approaches and establish production-rate processes for these advanced systems. You will play an essential role in applying design-for-manufacturing/design-for-test (DFM/DFT) principles to develop AIT specifications and manufacturing plans suitable for volume production. Additionally, you will represent AIT capabilities during customer proposal efforts, providing technical credibility and instilling confidence in our ability to execute high-volume production of complex spacecraft.
  
  
Your Career: We're very serious about professional development and continuing education at Intuitive Machines - West. We offer our team members the opportunity to define their own career trajectory. You will work with your manager to set goals and design a development plan to advance your career. This unique opportunity is a high-visibility role critical to our company's leadership position in spacecraft manufacturing.
  
  
What We Offer: Time for dedicated professional development, conference attendance, industry training, peer group collaboration, as well as paid certifications and education reimbursement.
  
  
Who you will work with: You will report to the VP of Spacecraft Production and Operations and collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams. You will lead a team of AIT production engineers and technicians while partnering with design engineering to ensure producibility of our spacecraft systems. You will also engage directly with potential customers during proposal phases to communicate our production and test capabilities.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end AIT production flow optimized for high-volume throughput
* Develop capacity models, takt time analysis, and process flow requirements for production-rate AIT
* Define capital equipment strategy including test equipment, handling systems, and tooling
* Establish scalable AIT work instructions, process controls, and quality gates
* Lead development of an efficient, risk-informed test program that ensures vehicle performance confidence while eliminating non-value-added testing
* Oversee spacecraft-level integration of solar arrays, batteries, and other major subsystems with the spacecraft bus

* Define requirements for low-cost mechanical and electrical assembly, integration and test equipment, and production tooling

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging lean manufacturing principles

* Represent AIT production capabilities to potential customers during proposal efforts, providing technical credibility on execution readiness
* Support business development with AIT cost models and production capacity commitments

**How You Will Be Evaluated**
Your performance will be measured against AIT production readiness milestones, test program efficiency metrics, production ramp targets, quality metrics, and cost per unit objectives.
  
  
**What We Look For In Team Members**
As a team member at Intuitive Machines - West, we expect you to demonstrate honesty, integrity, innovation, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field. Four additional years of experience may be substituted for a degree
* Minimum of 15 years related aerospace manufacturing/AIT experience
* Minimum of 7 years leadership experience in production or manufacturing engineering
* Experience working cross-functionally within a company and/or with external partners and contractors
* Proven track record scaling aerospace production operations
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with volume production of spacecraft or complex aerospace systems
* Direct experience developing and implementing a spacecraft AIT production line
* Experience with large spacecraft systems (solar array integration, battery integration, high-voltage testing)
* Demonstrated experience developing efficient, risk-based test programs that balance verification rigor with schedule/cost efficiency

records.description:
**Job Summary**
The
**Director, Manufacturing Process Development**
will develop, characterize, scale, validate, transfer, and optimize manufacturing processes for dental consumables globally. This role translates product, chemistry, material, quality, and customer requirements into robust, compliant, cost-effective manufacturing processes within an FDA- and ISO-regulated environment.
  
  
Reporting to the VP, Innovation & R&D, this leader bridges R&D Engineering, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Procurement, driving manufacturing readiness, technical risk management, and process ownership. The role leads a team of engineers and requires strong influence, relationship-building, and cross-functional navigation skills.
  
  
*Candidate must reside within a commutable distance to Pomona, CA. This is not a hybrid or remote opportunity and requires onsite presence 4 days per week.*
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Develop process development strategy and roadmaps aligned to business and portfolio priorities, setting standards, governance, and resourcing for development, scale-up, validation, and lifecycle support.
* Lead, coach, and develop a process engineering team, building technical depth, accountability, and succession planning.
* Develop scalable manufacturing platforms, standards, and reusable process technologies to accelerate future product introductions and operational excellence.
* Drive development and adoption of innovative manufacturing technologies and automation solutions to improve scalability, quality, efficiency, and competitive advantage.
* Partner with product development teams to embed design-for-manufacturability principles early in product and formulation development.
* Own process development from feasibility through validation and transfer for adhesives, composites, cements, endodontic, and other dental consumable platforms, defining process specifications, critical parameters, and controls.
* In collaboration with Chemistry team, characterize material and process behavior (e.g., rheology, mixing, variability, hold times) to build scientific understanding linking materials, equipment, and finished-product performance.
* Apply Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, and risk-based tools to define process design spaces, control strategies, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate manufacturing, scale-up, and commercialization risks throughout the product lifecycle.
* Lead pilot builds, scale-up, qualification, validation, and manufacturing transfer, ensuring readiness criteria, documentation, and training are in place.
* Provide process development leadership on New Product Development (NPD), commercialization, and lifecycle teams, aligning scope, risk, resources, and timelines across functions.
* Serve as the key technical liaison between Manufacturing and R&D, building trust and alignment across functions without relying on positional authority.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to optimize processes, troubleshoot issues, and improve capability across the product lifecycle, clarifying handoffs from development to routine manufacturing.
* Collaborate on investigations into nonconformances, deviations, and quality events using root-cause analysis and statistical methods to drive effective CAPAs.
* Define equipment and process requirements and partner with cross-functional teams and vendors on selection, integration, and automation to improve safety, quality, and efficiency.
* Drive measurable improvements in yield, throughput, cycle time, capability, and cost through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure all activities comply with the Quality Management System (QMS), FDA requirements, ISO 13485, GMP, EH&S, and applicable SOPs; support audits, CAPAs, and regulatory submissions.
* Communicate strategy, readiness, risk, and outcomes to senior leadership, ensuring sound documentation and escalation practices.
* Travel approximately 25% domestically and internationally to support manufacturing sites.

**Incidental Duties:**
The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, and additional responsibilities may be assigned, as required, by management.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Qualifications:**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. This individual must be able to function in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change rapidly. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline required; master’s degree or PhD preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across developing, scaling, or validating manufacturing processes in a regulated or formal quality-system environment is required.
* 5+ years of people and cross-functional leadership experience required.
* Experience in supporting multi-site or global manufacturing operations preferred.
* Experience with Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma tools and/or methodologies required.

**Skills/Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, gain commitment, and lead through relationships, technical credibility, data, and shared business objectives required.
* Exceptional relationship-building and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to create alignment and trust between Manufacturing and R&D required.
* Strong people leadership skills with a record of developing technical talent, building capability, setting clear expectations, and driving accountability required.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills, including Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, process capability, root-cause analysis, and risk-based decision making required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex programs, prioritize resources, manage ambiguity, resolve conflict, and drive execution across functions and sites required.
* Strong business and operational acumen, including the ability to balance safety, quality, compliance, delivery, innovation, capacity, and cost required.
* Strong verbal, presentation, facilitation, and technical writing skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively from the manufacturing floor through executive leadership required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with formulated medical-device products preferred.
* Ability to build business cases and use data to support equipment, automation, process technology, capacity, and cost-improvement investments preferred.
* Intermediate Microsoft Office skills, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, required; proficiency with statistical analysis software and aptitude to learn enterprise systems preferred.

postedPay.title: Sr Director - Advanced Manufacturing Engineer - NPI

records.description:
**Job Description**
Be part of the global Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) Engineering leadership team driving factory improvements, product improvements for producibility and cost savings, manufacturing technology implementation, and new product development for Honeywell Aerospace.
  
  
We are hiring a Sr Director to lead the global ISC Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME) team for New Product Introduction (NPI) supporting programs across the Aerospace portfolio.
  
  
In this role, you will leverage your extensive product development experience and leadership skills. You will drive continuous improvement to develop new products, processes, and standards in support of the organization's business strategies with a direct impact on development program success. You will develop strategy, hold teams accountable and deliver high impact business results.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver NPI program objectives including product producibility, design-to-cost (DTC) targets, production readiness, and customer quality.
* Operate as a change agent to embed producibility into our core design processes.
* Build Employee Engagement and Skills through the development of standard work, clear roles and responsibilities, and effective training programs.
* Design and develop Management Operating Systems to ensure effective team operations, driving results to program and department objectives.
* Work closely with the SBU engineering team, Program Management, and ISC leaders to build cross-organizational alignment

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics
* 8 years of experience in New Product Development
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes
* Experience working with suppliers on technical issues
* Track record of managing multiple projects with demonstrated results on a macro scale
* Experience leading a team with direct line reporting responsibility
* Abitlity to travel 30%

**Us Person Requirements**
Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.
  
  
**WE VALUE**

* Advanced degree in engineering or business
* Exceptional data analysis and communication skills
* Willingness to raise standards each year to drive organizational excellence
* Ability to make sound and timely judgments in ambiguous environment
* Ability to convey subtle or complex messages clearly, as appropriate for the topic and audience.
* Diverse and global teaming and collaboration
* Balance between demand and capacity when establishing priorities for the organization.

**For Mn Candidates**
The annual base salary range for this position is $238,000-$297,000. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.
  
  
This position is incentive eligible.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:
  
  

* Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
* Employee assistance program and educational assistance
* Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
* Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/
  
  
**POSTING TIMELINE**
The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
  
  
Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At
**Honeywell Aerospace**
(NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.
  
  
Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.
  
  
Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
  
  
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.
  
  
Honeywell Aerospace Products And Services Are Found On Aircraft Across Commercial Aviation, Defense And Space. We Operate Through Three Business Areas
  
  
Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology on board 90% of the world's aircraft
  
  
Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep those aircraft flying
  
  
Control Systems supplies the thermal and motion control systems that support takeoff, landing and the safety of everyone on board
  
  
With approximately 58,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, we are also advancing systems for autonomous and supersonic platforms — bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com
  
  
Join Honeywell Aerospace! Our aerospace innovations bring people together, make the world safer and more secure, and help humankind reach for the stars. Now we’re shaping aviation’s future with sustainable aviation fuels, smarter cockpits, ultra-efficient engines, smart airports, flying taxis and much more.

records.title: Senior Manager, QMS - Manufacturing
records.description:
Crusoe is on a mission
*to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*
. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.
  
  
We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.
  
  
We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.
  
  
If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.
  
  
**About This Role:**
The
**Senior Manager, Quality Management Systems (QMS)**
will lead the development, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Crusoe's enterprise Quality Management System across multiple manufacturing facilities, supplier operations, subcontractors, and field deployment activities.
  
  
This individual will be responsible for establishing a scalable, standardized, risk-based QMS that enables consistent product quality, manufacturing process control, regulatory and customer compliance, and operational excellence across the organization.
  
  
The role will provide strategic and operational leadership for QMS governance, internal and external audits, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), document and records management, quality processes, compliance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead and develop a team of QMS professionals, auditors, and documentation specialists while partnering closely with Product Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Field Quality leadership.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of progressive Quality Management System experience, including substantial people-management experience in complex manufacturing environments. This individual must be capable of translating quality standards and business requirements into practical operating processes that improve manufacturing effectiveness, prevent defects, reduce operational risks, and support organizational growth.
  
  
**The ultimate objective is to establish a proactive, business-enabling QMS that drives consistency, accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement across Crusoe's growing AI Data Center infrastructure manufacturing and deployment ecosystem.**
**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Enterprise QMS Strategy, Governance & Leadership

+ Own and lead the enterprise Quality Management System strategy, architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.
+ Establish and maintain a scalable QMS aligned with ISO 9001:2015 and applicable customer, regulatory, contractual, and industry requirements.
+ Develop standardized Quality policies, procedures, processes, work instructions, forms, and records applicable across all manufacturing facilities and operational functions.
+ Establish QMS governance, process ownership, accountability matrices, escalation mechanisms, and management review processes.
+ Ensure consistent implementation of Quality Management System requirements across Brighton, Tulsa-1, Tulsa-2, Arvada, Ponchatoula, and other future manufacturing and operational locations.
+ Establish a process-based, risk-oriented approach to quality management rather than a documentation-driven compliance culture.
+ Partner with Quality leadership to establish annual QMS objectives, strategic initiatives, resource plans, and performance targets.
+ Lead QMS maturity assessments and develop roadmaps to strengthen process effectiveness and organizational readiness.
+ Ensure QMS requirements are appropriately integrated into product development, manufacturing, supplier management, and field operations.

* ISO Compliance & Audit Management

+ Own the enterprise internal and external audit program, including audit planning, scheduling, execution, reporting, and follow-up.
+ Maintain organizational readiness for ISO 9001 certification, surveillance audits, recertification audits, and customer or third-party audits.
+ Lead and oversee internal audits across manufacturing, engineering, procurement, supplier quality, production, inspection, testing, and field operations.
+ Ensure audit programs evaluate actual process implementation and effectiveness rather than merely verifying documentation.
+ Manage relationships with external certification bodies, registrars, customer auditors, and regulatory or industry assessment organizations.
+ Establish risk-based audit schedules considering process criticality, historical performance, operational changes, and previous audit findings.
+ Ensure audit findings are appropriately classified, assigned, investigated, corrected, and closed within established timelines.
+ Verify corrective action effectiveness and prevent recurrence of systemic audit findings.
+ Develop and maintain qualified internal auditor resources across multiple facilities and functions.

* CAPA, Nonconformance & Continuous Improvement

+ Establish and govern enterprise-wide CAPA, nonconformance, deviation, and quality escalation processes.
+ Ensure effective root cause analysis using structured methodologies such as 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, fault tree analysis, and other appropriate problem-solving techniques.
+ Drive accountability for corrective and preventive actions across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Operations.
+ Monitor CAPA aging, overdue actions, recurrence rates, effectiveness verification, and systemic trends.
+ Identify recurring process failures, systemic weaknesses, and opportunities for organizational improvement.
+ Establish standardized requirements for nonconformance documentation, containment, disposition, investigation, and closure.
+ Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that reduce process variation, eliminate waste, improve first-pass yield, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
+ Ensure lessons learned from internal defects, supplier issues, customer complaints, and field failures are incorporated into the QMS.

* QMS Documentation & Records Management

+ Own enterprise document and records management governance.
+ Establish standardized requirements for document creation, review, approval, release, revision control, distribution, retention, and obsolescence.
+ Ensure controlled management of Quality Manuals, policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, inspection plans, test procedures, forms, and quality records.
+ Implement effective document control processes across multiple facilities and functional organizations.
+ Ensure personnel have access to current and approved documentation at the point of use.
+ Establish document ownership and periodic review requirements.
+ Eliminate uncontrolled documentation, obsolete work instructions, inconsistent forms, and duplicate processes.
+ Drive adoption and effective utilization of electronic QMS platforms and digital document management solutions.
+ Ensure objective evidence and records are maintained to demonstrate process conformity and effectiveness.

* Risk Management & Operational Quality Governance

+ Establish enterprise-level Quality risk management processes.
+ Ensure risk-based thinking is incorporated into business processes, product realization, supplier management, manufacturing operations, and field activities.
+ Oversee QMS-related risk assessments and coordinate with functional leaders on DFMEA, PFMEA, process risk assessments, and operational controls.
+ Establish escalation mechanisms for significant Quality risks, process deviations, regulatory concerns, and potential customer impacts.
+ Ensure changes to products, processes, suppliers, equipment, and organizational structures are appropriately evaluated for QMS impact.
+ Drive management review processes that evaluate QMS performance, organizational risks, customer satisfaction, audit results, CAPA effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.

* Multi-Site Standardization & Deployment

+ Establish a consistent enterprise QMS framework while allowing controlled, documented site-specific requirements where necessary.
+ Lead QMS deployment, implementation, and maturity improvement across existing and new manufacturing facilities.
+ Partner with site Quality leaders to ensure standardized processes are effectively implemented and sustained.
+ Conduct periodic site assessments to evaluate QMS effectiveness, process adherence, and compliance maturity.
+ Establish cross-site benchmarking and sharing of best practices.
+ Ensure new manufacturing facilities and acquired or outsourced operations are incorporated into the enterprise QMS framework.
+ Develop standardized QMS deployment and operational readiness plans for new facilities.

* Customer, Supplier & Regulatory Quality Support

+ Partner with Supplier Quality leadership to ensure QMS requirements are incorporated into supplier qualification, supplier audits, corrective actions, and supplier performance management.
+ Ensure subcontractors and outsourced manufacturing partners operate under appropriate Quality requirements and controls.
+ Support customer audits, quality assessments, and contractual compliance requirements.
+ Ensure effective management of customer complaints, quality escapes, and external nonconformances through the enterprise CAPA framework.
+ Partner with Product and Manufacturing Quality to ensure appropriate quality planning and process controls are established.
+ Maintain awareness of applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and customer-specific Quality requirements relevant to electrical and mechanical infrastructure manufacturing.

* People Leadership & Organizational Development

+ Build, lead, and develop a high-performing QMS organization.
+ Directly manage QMS personnel, including QMS Leads, Quality Auditors, QMS Documentation Specialists, and other assigned Quality professionals.
+ Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and individual development plans.
+ Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, talent assessments, and succession planning.
+ Develop technical and leadership competencies within the QMS organization.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
+ Establish effective working relationships with site Quality leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
+ Identify resource requirements and develop headcount and organizational plans to support current and future business growth.
+ Mentor and develop future Quality leaders and technical subject matter experts.

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Establishing, monitoring, and improving measurable QMS performance indicators, including:

+ QMS Compliance
+ Audit Management
+ CAPA Effectiveness
+ Document Control
+ Multi-Site Standardization
+ Process Effectiveness
+ Organizational Development
+ Customer Quality
+ Continuous Improvement

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* Educational Foundation: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Professional Experience:

+ 7+ Years of Dedicated Experience in QMS, plus additional experience in Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Assurance.
+ 5+ Years of People Leadership Experience: Including managing and developing Quality professionals and technical teams (these years may overlap with the 10+ above).

* QMS Expertise: Demonstrated experience owning, implementing, and improving enterprise or multi-site Quality Management Systems.
* ISO 9001 Expertise: Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 requirements and certification processes.
* Core Quality Methodologies: Demonstrated expertise in CAPA, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and continuous improvement.
* Quality Documentation & Document Control: Experience developing and implementing Quality policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, and document control systems.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience managing cross-functional Quality initiatives across Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Supply Chain.
* Risk & Process Management: Strong understanding of risk-based thinking, process management, and operational excellence.
* eQMS Implementation: Experience implementing or administering electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
* Influence & Accountability: Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational accountability without relying solely on hierarchical authority.
* Communication & Analytical Skills: Excellent written, verbal, analytical, organizational, and presentation skills.
* Travel: Willingness to travel 25–40% of the time, based on business needs.
* Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility; drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.
