records.title: Manufacturing Quality Senior Manager
records.description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality builds and leads the quality system supporting Harris' manufacturing network. This role owns quality and certifications across multiple facilities, including the ISO 9001 and ASME (non-nuclear) certification programs, inspection and hold/release, and independent verification of VDC deliverables, so products leave Harris' shops conforming to customer, code, and specification requirements.
  
  
This role builds and leads the plant-level QA/QC team, who will report directly to it. It holds quality stop-work authority and provides independent verification across facilities. The Senior Manager partners with the Harris corporate QA/QC program, applying and extending it to manufacturing, and works with Manufacturing Operations, Engineering and VDC, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, and Safety. The role standardizes quality practices and supports certification of new facilities as the network scales.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Quality Management System & Certifications**

* Own the manufacturing certification programs, including ISO 9001 and ASME, with documentation, internal audits, and management review.
* Lead certification and recertification for new and existing facilities, including customer and third-party audits.
* Align manufacturing procedures with the Harris corporate QMS manual and manage manufacturing-specific procedures and records.
* Drive consistent quality system implementation across the network.
* Represent Harris in professional and industry organizations.

**Plant QA/QC Leadership & Inspection**

* Build, staff, and lead the plant-level QA/QC team, including roles, hiring, training, and standards.
* Establish and own inspection, verification, and hold/release processes, from receiving through final inspection.
* Define inspection plans and travelers by product and customer requirement.
* Ensure welding procedures and welder qualifications meet code, and manage calibration of inspection equipment.
* Manage third-party inspection firms and their scope, schedule, and results

**VDC Deliverable QA/QC Review**

* Spot-check VDC deliverables, including drawings, models, and BOMs, before they reach the shop, as an independent check on VDC's own QA/QC.
* Audit VDC's QA/QC process and record results, and raise gaps with VDC leadership.
* Track shop-found drawing, model, and BOM issues, and feed trends back to VDC and Engineering.
* Hold deliverables that fail verification until corrected.

**Nonconformance, Corrective Action & Quality Performance**

* Own the nonconformance (NCR) process, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive actions, including supplier issues.
* Track and report quality metrics, including rework, weld repair, NCR trends, and customer complaints.
* Work with Industrial Engineering and plant leadership to turn quality data into improvements.

**Quality Stop-Work Authority**

* Exercise stop-work authority when product, process, or documentation does not meet requirements, escalating to the SVP as needed.
* Define clear criteria for stop, hold, and release.

**Production Readiness & Supplier Quality**

* Set quality requirements, inspection and test plans, and documentation for new products and projects at the production readiness gate and manage 3rd party inspection companies.
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier quality, receiving inspection, and material certifications.
* Support customer quality requirements and audits for external customers.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
**This Role Works Closely With**

* Harris corporate QA/QC program leadership
* Manufacturing Operations, Industrial Engineering, Safety
* Engineering, VDC, and Product Engineering
* Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Fulfillment & Logistics
* Manufacturing Business Development and Estimating
* Customers, auditors, and certification bodies

The Senior Manager owns the manufacturing quality system and independent verification. Plant leadership owns producing quality product in the shop.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Experience building and leading quality assurance or quality control across multiple manufacturing, fabrication, or prefabrication facilities, including hiring and developing quality staff.
* Experience leading ISO 9001 and ASME or other code-based certification and recertification, including internal audits and corrective action.
* Experience with inspection, nonconformance management, and root cause analysis.
* Ability to read engineering drawings, specifications, and codes.
* Ability to hold plant leaders accountable while keeping production moving.
* Strong communication skills with customers, auditors, and cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with nuclear quality assurance, ASME boiler and pressure vessel code, or other code-based quality programs.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* Experience with welding, piping, structural, or modular MEP fabrication.
* Certifications such as CWI, ASQ CQE/CQA/CMQ, or Lead Auditor.
* Experience with quality and production tracking systems such as STRATUS.

**This Role Is**
**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**

* The enterprise owner of the manufacturing quality system and certifications.
* The builder and leader of plant-level QA/QC across facilities.
* The authority for inspection, hold/release, and quality stop-work.
* An independent check that protects customers and Harris' reputation as the network scales.

**This Role Is NOT**

* The owner of plant production or shop-floor output (Manufacturing Operations).
* The owner of the Harris corporate QA/QC program.
* The owner of VDC's internal QA/QC (VDC).
* Responsible for safety programs or safety stop-work (Safety).
* The owner of product design or productization (Product Engineering).

**Your life at Harris**
As one of the country's leading mechanical contractors, Harris offers you the best of both worlds: the stability, resources and opportunities of a national company, and the team culture, creative spirit and customer loyalty of a local business. If you thrive on variety and new challenges, we want to meet you!
  
  
From stadiums to manufacturing facilities, power plants to hospitals, concert halls to classrooms, we handle projects of all sizes and complexity from multiple regional locations across the country.
  
  
**Harris Benefits + Compensation**

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
* 401K with company match
* Vacation time, sick time, and paid holidays
* Paid Parental leave
* Short-Term Incentive Plan

Visit our Careers Page for additional benefit details: https://www.harriscompany.com/careers/employee-benefits-at-a-glance

$111,060.64 - $166,590.97
  
  
The actual salary offer will vary by candidate based on a wide range of factors such as specific skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

* Compliance: Understand and comply with all applicable content standards, brand guidelines, company policies, and rules.

**Colorado Springs, CO | Full-Time | On-Site**

### **Lead Quality. Develop People. Protect the Mission.**

At Cogitic Corporation, quality isn't just a department, it's critical to our mission. We manufacture precision components supporting the U.S. Navy and national defense programs, where accuracy, accountability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

We're seeking an experienced, technically strong Director of Quality to lead our Quality Management System (QMS), develop our inspection team, and drive a culture of operational excellence.

**This is not a desk-only leadership position.** We're looking for someone who can think strategically, lead confidently, and remain technically engaged. The right person is just as comfortable leading an audit or developing a quality strategy as they are reviewing a complex drawing, troubleshooting an inspection challenge, or supporting CMM programming.

If you're a quality leader who takes ownership, develops people, and believes in getting things right the first time, we want to hear from you.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Quality Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Quality and Inspection team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and opportunities for growth.
* Build a high-performing team that values technical excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and proactive problem-solving.
* Balance strategic quality initiatives with daily operational priorities to support production and delivery commitments.

* Own, maintain, and continuously improve Cogitic's QMS, ensuring compliance with applicable customer, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
* Lead internal, customer, supplier, and external audits, ensuring findings are addressed effectively and on time.
* Drive corrective action efforts, including root-cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and verification of effectiveness.

Employee Value Proposition
  
​​​​​​At Taiho Oncology, the compassion we practice for our patients extends to our team, empowering and motivating them to do their best work for those who need it most. This is an exciting opportunity to lead critical Quality systems in a dynamic, collaborative, and global cross-functional environment.
  
  
**Position Summary:**  
​​​​​​​​​The Director, QA Ops – Document, Training & Records Management is responsible for the strategy, governance, and execution of Taiho Oncology’s controlled document management, GxP training management, archival, and records-retention programs. This position leads the team responsible for day-to-day activities in MasterControl and establishes scalable processes, system capabilities, and governance that support current operations and Taiho’s future business plans. The Director partners with Quality, functional leaders, Information Technology, system owners, affiliates, and global stakeholders to maintain compliant, efficient, and inspection-ready programs.
  
  
**Performance Objectives:**  
**​​​​Strategy, Governance and Leadership:**  

* Develop and execute the long-term strategy and operating model for controlled document management, GxP training management, archival, and records retention.
* Translate Taiho’s future plans into scalable processes, systems, governance, resources, and program roadmaps.
* Establish policies, standards, performance measures, risk controls, and continuous-improvement priorities and provide recommendations to senior management.
* Lead harmonization and standardization of document and training practices across TOI and applicable affiliates and global stakeholders.
* Manage, coach, and develop the team responsible for document, training, archival, and records-management activities; maintain clear roles, capacity, cross-training, succession planning, and business continuity.

**MasterControl and Quality System Oversight:**  

* Provide business ownership, strategic direction, and governance for MasterControl document and training capabilities.
* Oversee administration of document workflows, courses, curricula, assignments, job codes, user accounts, metadata, effective dates, access, archival status, and related records.
* Partner with Information Technology and validation stakeholders on enhancements, upgrades, integrations, access controls, user acceptance testing, Computer System Assurance documentation, and maintenance of the validated state.
* Evaluate and implement capabilities needed to align MasterControl with business growth, affiliate integration, data integrity, inspection readiness, and future quality-system plans.
* Ensure procedures, user guidance, training materials, reports, and support mechanisms remain current and effective.

**Controlled Document Management:**  

* Oversee the lifecycle management of controlled policies, standard operating procedures, work instructions, forms, guidance documents, and other GxP documents from creation through retirement and archival.
* Establish standards for templates, numbering, naming, metadata, review and approval, effective dates, revision history, periodic review, document relationships, distribution, and supersession.
* Ensure controlled documents receive appropriate Quality and administrative review and that document owners resolve quality, workflow, implementation, and timeliness issues.
* Lead periodic assessment and cleanup of the controlled-document environment, including obsolete, duplicate, or floating documents and attachments.
* Provide document-management leadership and evidence support during audits, inspections, due diligence, and compliance reviews.

**GxP Training Management:**  

* Establish the strategy and governance framework for GxP training across TOI and applicable affiliates.
* Ensure training requirements, curricula, courses, job codes, assignments, and records are aligned with job responsibilities, controlled documents, organizational changes, and compliance obligations.
* Oversee onboarding, role changes, transfers, leaves of absence, and separation processes as they affect training requirements and records.
* Ensure required training is assigned, completed, tracked, documented, reported, and retained; monitor compliance and escalate material risks.
* Oversee new-hire Quality training, document creator/revisor training, instructor-led training, read-and-understand activities, assessments, and other approved training methods.
* Lead improvements that strengthen training effectiveness, learner experience, role alignment, reporting, and inspection readiness.

**Archival and Records Retention:**  

* Develop and oversee the strategy for identification, transfer, storage, protection, retrieval, retention, disposition, and migration of applicable quality records.
* Partner with Legal, Information Technology, Records Management, functional stakeholders, and Quality Assurance to establish and maintain appropriate retention requirements and controls.
* Ensure electronic and physical records, as applicable, remain authentic, complete, readable, secure, traceable, accessible, and retrievable throughout the retention period.
* Identify and remediate risks involving legacy records, decentralized repositories, inconsistent practices, obsolete formats, or system migrations.
* Maintain inspection readiness; support audits and regulatory inspections; lead remediation, CAPA, and risk-management activities related to assigned processes.
* Establish and report metrics for document timeliness, training compliance, overdue activities, processing volume, archival status, system performance, and program risk.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Education/Certification Requirements:**  

* ​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, quality, regulatory affairs, information management, business, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other regulated life-sciences industry.
* Significant experience in Quality Assurance, controlled document management, GxP training, archival, records retention, and regulated quality systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and complex cross-functional programs; experience supporting regulatory inspections and audits required.
* Experience with MasterControl document and training modules, validated computerized systems, and system implementations, upgrades, or migrations strongly preferred.
* Comprehensive knowledge of GxP quality-system principles and regulated document, training, archival, records-retention, and data-integrity practices.
* Demonstrated ability to establish strategy, governance, and future-state plans while ensuring effective and timely operational execution.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, delegation, succession planning, stakeholder management, and change-leadership skills.
* Strong project, program, risk, and regulatory management abilities, including development of metrics, management reporting, and sustainable process improvements.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, analytical, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
* Sound judgment and proven ability to define problems, analyze data, assess risk, manage competing priorities, and implement compliant, scalable solutions.
* Highly developed organizational skills, attention to detail, accountability, and commitment to collaboration and inspection readiness.

Asahi Kasei Therapeutics is the global specialty pharmaceutical business of Asahi Kasei. We are a commercial-stage company committed to positively impacting health by expanding therapeutic options that improve the lives of patients around the world. Drawing upon our strong heritage of scientific innovation, we aim to help reshape care in transplantation, nephrology, immunology, infectious diseases and other underserved conditions.  
  

**Job Description:**

  

The Senior Director of Quality Operations is a strategic and hands‑on leader responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of all GMP/GDP activities executed internally and by external partners for the company’s products, supporting both clinical trials and commercial distribution, working with the VP of QA, QC and AD

  

This role provides oversight across CDMOs and testing labs, ensuring timely product disposition, investigation management, and quality support throughout the product lifecycle.

  

The base compensation range for this role is $230-260K. Base Compensation is influenced by many factors including, but not limited to: time in the role, previous experience, skills, knowledge, performance, work requirements, internal equity, and business / economic conditions.

  

The Senior Director QA Operations is accountable and responsible to:

* Ensure that the company's global Quality Management System (QMS), processes, and procedures required in the development, manufacture, supply and distribution and related activities are established, maintained and continuously improved in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including but not necessarily limited to GMP and GDP.
* Provide global and independent Quality Management support, and in particular GMP and GDP oversight, leadership, expertise, reviews and as required quality approvals.
* Assure a satisfactory state of control and compliance with the AKTX QMS, and applicable GMP and GDP standards, authorizations, internal policies, procedures and protocols related to product for clinical trials and commercial manufacturing,
* Actively identify and communicate compliance issues or risks, develop and oversee plans to rectify issues or mitigate risks.

The Senior QA Director works in close collaboration with AKTX functional heads and process owners leading the development, supply and distribution of AKTX medicinal products.

  

**Tasks and responsibilities/accountabilities**

* Take an active role in development and delivery of AKTX strategy, objectives and targets.
* Support development of the QA unit and its way of working, budget, and deliverables in accordance with agreed corporate and individual objectives.
* Lead QA Operations and provide strategic leadership to QA operations staff by driving development, performance, coaching initiatives and ensuring optimal resource allocation to achieve organizational goals and deliver on targets, and objectives
* Collaborate within QA and with process owners, management and departments to establish, maintain and continually improve a fit-for-purpose, robust and effective global QMS.
* Act as owner of assigned business and quality management processes within the QMS and drive and ensure their suitability and effectiveness, and continual improvements.
* Provide oversight across CDMOs and service providers for clinical and commercial programs, ensuring timely product disposition, investigation management, and quality support throughout the product lifecycle.
* Serve as the quality lead in cross-functional CMC teams, partnering with MTO, QC/AD, Regulatory, Clinical, PAM and Supply Chain to ensure end-to-end GMP compliance

postedPay.title: Director, PXT - Amazon Leo Production Operations

records.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon has committed more than $10 billion to Amazon Leo, a low Earth orbit satellite network designed to bring fast, affordable broadband to customers around the world. Production Operations is where that ambition becomes physical. Every Leo satellite weighs more than 1,000 pounds, contains roughly 4 million individual components, and is designed and built in-house on a 172,000 square foot custom production line in Kirkland, Washington, capable of producing up to five satellite a day. The team completed its 1,000th satellite in September 2026 (https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-builds-satellites), making Leo one of the largest and most advanced satellite production operations in the world.  
From the factory, satellites move to a 100,000 square foot payload processing facility at Kennedy Space Center in Florida that can support three launch campaigns at once, and to launch operations in French Guiana. With more than 80 launches secured across four launch providers, Leo plans to double its launch rate to more than 20 missions in its second year. The organization spans eight sites today across multiple states and ground stations across multiple countries, with more investments coming through in the times ahead.  
This role builds on Amazon's deep operations heritage and takes it to newer heights. You will partner with an organization that brings together aerospace, RF, supply chain and manufacturing experts, recruited from the leading space and defense companies, alongside a skilled hourly production and launch workforce building and launching satellite in clean rooms, across shifts, and on mission-critical launch campaigns. Few people leaders anywhere get to shape all of this at once: precision satellite manufacturing across multiple satellite generations, export-controlled and government production, and Amazon Leo's first employing entity outside the US.  
The people decisions made in the next 18 months will shape this organization for the next decade. As the senior PXT leader for Production Operations, you will make them alongside the VP of Production Operations and the multiple Directors who lead satellite manufacturing, launch operations, supply chain, quality, ground gateways, global trade and compliance, enterprise technology, and Manufacturing Systems Engineering and New Product Introduction. You won't be inheriting a playbook. You'll be writing it.  
What makes this role unique  

* Two talent markets, one interwoven strategy. Build differentiated people programs for a highly technical corporate workforce competing in one of the most constrained talent markets in the world, and for a large, fast growing hourly manufacturing and launch workforce, under a single coherent people strategy.
* Organization design at a defining moment. Shape org design, leadership formation, and succession as the organization scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production in parallel, with a leadership team forming as it grows.
* People infrastructure Amazon has never built. Create job families, compensation, and career frameworks for roles Amazon has never hired before, people processes for export-controlled and cleared work, and Amazon Leo's first non-US employing entity at a launch site.
* Proactive employee and labor relations. Set a direct-engagement and labor relations strategy for an hourly workforce, across factories and launch sites in multiple states and countries.

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as strategic people partner to the VP of Production Operations and Director-level function leaders, advising on organizational design, talent architecture, site strategy, and workforce planning across corporate technical and hourly populations.
* Shape the multi-year organization design for Production Operations as it scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production, including new leadership roles and structures.
* Lead talent strategy for specialized technical roles (aerospace manufacturing, RF and telecommunications engineering, satellite quality, supply chain and trade compliance, AI and automation), competing against established aerospace and defense employers.
* Build scalable HR infrastructure for a 24/7 manufacturing and launch operation, including new-to-Amazon approaches to timekeeping, attendance, performance management, and shift support.
* Lead people strategy for Launch Operations, including sustainable staffing models for launch campaigns, rotational teams, off-shift coverage, and recurring travel.
* Set a proactive labor and employee relations strategy in partnership with Global Employee Relations and Labor Relations, coaching senior operations leaders on direct employee engagement at every site.
* Define people requirements for export-controlled and government manufacturing, including security clearances, cleared hiring pipelines, and compliant people processes, with Legal and Security.
* Stand up Amazon Leo's first non-US employee population at an international launch site, including employment contracts, compensation and benefits, payroll, and statutory compliance.
* Drive leadership development, calibration, promotion readiness, and succession planning across a rapidly expanding senior leadership bench.
* Build and lead a team of HR Business Partners, operating through a deep matrix across HR Partners, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Talent Management, Employee Relations, PXT Technology, and international partners.

  
Click the link to see how Amazon’s growing constellation of custom-built satellites will work together to bring internet connectivity anywhere on the planet: https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-satellite-internet-works

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 15+ years of progressive human resources experience
* 10+ years of experience as an HR business partner supporting senior executives
* 7+ years of experience leading HR strategy for large-scale manufacturing, production, or operations organizations with hourly or shift-based workforces
* 5+ years of experience leading HR strategy for organizations operating across multiple countries and legal entities
* Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Human Resources or MBA
* Experience with employee and labor relations in union represented or union-exposed environments
* Experience designing organizational structures, compensation frameworks, and job architecture for large, fast-growing organizations
* Experience leading people strategy in aerospace, defense, satellite, telecommunications, or advanced manufacturing
* Experience supporting highly technical engineering populations alongside hourly production workforces
* Experience supporting launch, flight, field, or campaign-based operations with rotational or travel-intensive staffing
* Experience designing people processes for export-controlled (ITAR/EAR) or government cleared work environments
* Experience standing up new sites, greenfield operations, or new country employing entities
* Track record of building senior leadership teams and coaching executives through rapid organizational change
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and to build mechanisms that scale beyond any single leader

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Compensation Range**

$240,000 - $280,000 / Year

**Overview**

**At The Cheesecake Factory Bakery, We Don't Do Ordinary!** Nothing is scaled down. Not the pride, not the fun, and definitely not the teamwork. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of our Bakery business, lead great people, and strengthen the systems behind the iconic cheesecakes our guests have loved for decades.

**As the VP, Quality Assurance & Food Safety**, you’ll report to the Bakery President and lead food safety, quality assurance, sanitation, and technical services across two bakery plants totaling more than 160,000 square feet and supporting more than 600 staff members. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact: setting the strategy, rebuilding organizational trust, strengthening audit readiness, and elevating Good Manufacturing Practices through disciplined root cause analysis and corrective action. You’ll operate at both the executive and plant levels, bringing the leadership, technical expertise, and influence needed to create lasting change.

**You’ll thrive in this position if you are:**

* **A Trusted Executive Leader:** You build credibility through transparency, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through, earning the confidence to influence decisions at every level.
* **A Strategic, Hands-On Quality Leader:** You set the vision while staying connected to operations, understanding risk, removing barriers, and translating strategy into consistent execution.
* **An Audit and Compliance Expert:** You build a culture of year-round readiness where issues are identified early, corrective actions are effective, and findings are sustainably closed.
* **A Disciplined Problem Solver:** You look beyond the immediate issue, using data, risk assessment, and root cause analysis to solve systemic problems and prevent recurrence.

**Responsibilities**

* Set and lead the Bakery division’s Quality Assurance and Food Safety strategy across both facilities, establishing clear expectations for risk management, performance, and accountability.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the Bakery President and executive leadership, providing clear perspective on food safety and quality risks, audit readiness, significant incidents, and corrective actions.
* Ensure trust and confidence in the function through technical credibility, transparency, strong partnerships, and consistent execution.
* Strengthen compliance and operational discipline across GMPs, HACCP, SQF, AIB, sanitation, allergen controls, environmental monitoring, traceability, supplier quality, microbiological testing, and recall readiness.
* Establish sustained audit readiness and ensure findings have clear ownership, effective corrective actions, and lasting resolution.
* Ensure highly systematic and disciplined adherence to product and process standards on a real-time basis to guarantee our cakes are beautiful and delicious.
* Build greater rigor around root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions, addressing systemic issues rather than symptoms.
* Provide leadership across product and process quality, customer complaints, foreign-material controls, product holds, specifications, labeling, formulas, recipes, and Technical Services.
* Establish meaningful metrics and use data to identify trends, prioritize risk, and hold the organization accountable for results.
* Lead significant food safety, quality, sanitation, and regulatory matters with urgency, sound judgment, and appropriate escalation.
* Build and develop a high-performing Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Sanitation, and Technical Services organization with the talent and capabilities needed for long-term success.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Research and Development, and Human Resources to strengthen ownership and accountability for food safety and quality across the business.
* Prioritize resources and investments against the greatest risks and opportunities while effectively managing the function’s budget.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Sanitation, or Technical Services within food manufacturing, including senior-level, multi-site responsibility.
* Demonstrated success leading food safety and quality strategy, organizational transformation, culture improvement, and high-performing technical teams.
* Deep expertise in GMPs, HACCP, preventive controls, sanitation, microbiological risk, allergen management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recalls, supplier quality, AIB, SQF, and food safety management systems.
* Extensive experience leading regulatory, certification, customer, and internal audits from preparation through corrective action and sustainable closure.
* Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, risk assessment, and incident investigation.
* Proven ability to build organizational trust, strengthen accountability, influence senior leaders, and lead through significant change.
* Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, chemistry, food science, food safety, biology, engineering, or a closely related discipline.

**What we prefer:**

  

* Leadership experience within the bakery or dessert industry; experience in similarly complex food-manufacturing environments will also be considered.
* Master’s degree in a related technical or business discipline.
* Relevant certifications such as SQF Practitioner, HACCP, PCQI, or Certified Food Scientist.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Benefits**

* Eligible to participate in an annual incentive bonus program
* Eligible for an annual long-term equity award in accordance with company Plan and approval process.
* Medical, Dental & Vision
* Access to a company car or car allowance
* Eligible for benefits on the first day of the month following date of hire
* Flexible vacation

* Tuition Reimbursement of $2,500 for qualified programs
* Adoption Assistance Benefit of $2,500
* 25%-35% discount when dining as a guest
* Reusable gift card loaded annually for your dining enjoyment

**About the Company**

The Cheesecake Factory Bakery creates over 35,000 delicious cheesecakes per day across our two facilities in Calabasas, CA and Rocky Mount, NC plus other baked products for our restaurants, international licensees, and third-party bakery customers.  
  
The Cheesecake Factory Bakery is a subsidiary of The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated. Recognized as a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® since 2014, The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a global $3.8 billion public company with more than 370 casual dining restaurants and over 48,000 staff members.  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming workplace for all. We welcome applicants from a wide variety of identities, ideas, perspectives, backgrounds and experiences to apply. Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  
Overview
  
The Vice President of Distribution Center Operations will lead the product distribution strategy and drive an economically competitive operation that delivers both best-in-class customer experience and distribution cost advantages across all facilities supporting Vestis Rental and Direct Sale customers.
  
This leader will influence and reinforce a portfolio of core values and accountability standards centered on safety, workforce engagement, customer experience, operational efficiency, and innovative solutions that support business goals. This role is responsible for deploying strategies and actionable plans that deliver measurable performance improvement.
  
This leader will also define and advance the technology roadmap for Distribution Center Operations, identifying opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, automation, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies to improve safety, productivity, quality, service, capacity, and cost.
  
The Vice President will promote data-driven performance visibility, real-time corrective action, and strong cross-functional collaboration. This leader will work effectively with business partners to identify, address, and resolve operational issues.
  
This role will set goals and oversee key metrics related to customer fill rates, customer satisfaction, footprint utilization, inventory management, optimization and total DC cost, along with other key measures tied to Distribution Center Operations.
  
Responsibilities/Essential Functions

records.title: Manufacturing Operations Director
records.description:
LISI AEROSPACE is ranked 60th in the global aerospace value chain and specializes in the design and manufacture of high-tech metal components to enhance aircraft safety and performance. Active since 1950 in the fastener market (no. 3 worldwide), LISI AEROSPACE has been a recognized player in metal components for aircraft engines and airframes since 2011. With its dedication to industrial excellence, LISI AEROSPACE aims to become a leader in costs, quality, deadlines and workplace safety. This mindset is represented at every level of our company and by all of our team members. At LISI AEROSPACE, we focus above all on advancement and flexibility. Every employee is empowered and has the latitude they need to carry out their assignments and develop their skills. We provide this mobility and training through our Corporate University, the LISI Knowledge Institute (LKI). As a result, our company is growing fast and always welcoming new talents.
  
  
**COMPENSATION:** $160,000.00 - $200,000.00 annually
  
  
**SCHEDULE:** 4/9 + 4
  
  
SUMMARY
  
The Director of Manufacturing is responsible for production, delivery and quality of highly engineered aerospace fasteners, utilizing machining, forging, thermal treatment and coating operations. In addition to these responsibilities, the Director of Manufacturing will also be responsible for safety, environmental results, efficiencies and effectiveness of the assigned production unit and/or groups. The individual will act as a senior management representative in the assigned production units and ensure that company policies and guidelines are accurately interpreted and implemented. Develops and implements optimal, cost-effective manufacturing processes and methods in accordance with product specifications and quality standards. Minimize process variation and maximize efficiency of both existing and new product manufacturing process.
  
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodation for disabilities may be made for one or more of the following:
  
  

* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for profit and loss results as established for the assigned production units by the organization’s budget or forecast process.
* Responsible for achieving and sustaining agreed health and safety goals while using effective management techniques to communicate goals, corrective action and create an environment of best-in-class safety practices.
* Responsible for the manufacturing and planning of best-in-class products in the assigned factory, utilizing world class techniques, clear achievable goals that align with the corporate business strategy.
* Ensure customer service levels are met and that delivery/quality Key Production Indicators (KPI) are tracked and communicated.
* Responsible for staff development, assessments, and ensuring new team members selected to join the organization have the training and development necessary to integrate them into our continuous improvement culture.
* Establishes goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPI) to assigned production units to be flowed down from P&L, HSE, Customer Service Performance, and Quality goals that are communicated and tracked on a regular basis to ensure production group activity aligns with production unit goals.
* Works with inter-departmental or cross functional staff to resolve issues with machinery, product quality, product development, Health, Safety, and Environmental, and continuous improvement.
* Develops, implements, and tracks clear action plans to improve agreed upon deficiencies with the use of problem-solving techniques, such as 8D corrective actions, statistics, capability studies (SPC), Total Preventative Maintenance (TPM).
* Plans and develops capital equipment forecasts using input from others, in order to achieve safety improvements, increased productivity, and optimizes our core skills.
* Manages professional and non-professional staff to achieve their goals through goal setting, performance appraisals, counseling, and team building.
* Must be able to prioritize and manage resources to achieve projects results even when time and/or resources are constrained.
* Ensure quality management system is adhered to and improved as a part of our continuous improvement effort.
* Organize and maintain high standards of performance, quality and customer service within all departments.
* Responsible for implementing company policies and guidelines as prescribed by management
* Supports, leads, and adheres to all business accreditations, such as AS9100, ISO14001, and others as acquired or required.
* Ensure all people placed under their assigned area of responsibility, or all persons who may be affected by equipment or processes placed under their responsibility are complying with the rules and regulations set forth by Federal, Local and State government, and LISI Aerospace policies, procedures and plans.
* Responsible for and ensuring that all employees attend all training provided and for adhering to all HSE procedures, policies, and plans, conforming to reporting requirements, and safe operating procedures at all times.
* Responsible for ensuring employees in assigned area are aware of their requirement to bring any known or suspected nonconformance for all company procedures or legal requirements to management’s attention immediately.

Ways of Working, Experience, and Behaviors
  
  
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
  
  

* Analytical – Ability to analyze and understand complex information, product specification, and critical technical information. Able to resolve complex problems to resolution. Able to scrutinize information providing direction and guidance on risks, strategy, planning, and actions
* Technical Skills – Technical knowledge including but not limited, to specification interpretation, product application, product quality, quality systems, International Standards, safety and environmental management, customer relationship management, project management, Lean concepts, Six-Sigma, and people development and leadership.
* Oral Communication - Speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens intently to others and seeks clarification; Provides clear and pleasant responses to inquiries regardless of the situation; Presents complex concepts in a simple manner to achieve understanding at all levels of the organization. Demonstrates group presentation skills working in a global environment; actively participates in meetings providing clear information.
* Written Communication – Writes documents clearly and accurately. Transfers production data into meaningful written documents that can be understood by all levels of the organization. Writes comprehensive well-developed policies and work instructions. Writes clear actions and audit reports.
* Teamwork - As management Team Member must lead by example, adhere and apply all company and legal regulations. Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Places success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed; Follows the company guiding principles and values; Recognizes accomplishments of team members.
* Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns actions and department activities and action plans to mission, vision and strategic goals.
* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Contributes to profits and revenue; Conserves organizational resources.
* Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities of self and others; Uses time efficiently; Plans for resources in a creative way only adding cost as absolutely necessary; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
* Professionalism - Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.

Supervisory Responsibilities
  
  
Directly and/or indirectly supervises Supervisors/Managers, and other team members assigned to the production units and production groups; Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the assigned production units. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the HSE responsibility, organization's policies and applicable laws; Responsibilities include but are not limited to interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
  
  
ESSENTIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  
  
Education and/or Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree (Engineering background preferred) from a four-year college or university. Master’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of experience and education
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience in the Aerospace Industry or Manufacturing environment preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years related experience required or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Customer interface/interaction experience related to understanding of customer specifications, quality and satisfaction required.

Language Skills
  
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Must be able to write accurate reports, business correspondence, technical manuals, policies, and procedures. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the public.
  
  
Mathematical Skills
  
Ability to work with highly complex mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
  
  
Reasoning Ability
  
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract concrete variables.
  
  
Computer Skills
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual should have advanced knowledge of Computer software programs for word processing, spreadsheets, presentation such as but not limited to Microsoft Word; Microsoft Excel; Microsoft Access, Project Plan or corrective Action system.
  
  
Certificates, licenses, registrations
  
  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS, WORK ENVIRONMENT, HEALTH AND ,SAFETY
  
  
Physical Demands
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods of time, and to speak or listen. The employee is frequently required to sit and requires eye-hand coordination, repetitive hand movement and manual dexterity use hands to finger, handle, or feel. The employee is occasionally required to stand for extended periods of time and walk. The employee must occasionally bend, reach to shoulder level and lift, carrying, pushing and/or pulling up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus. Hearing level within normal/average range.
  
  
Work Environment
  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud in the manufacturing unit.
  
Safety and Environmental
  
The responsibilities of the position include compliance with company and governmental safety, environmental and hazardous materials regulations and procedures. Employees will be required to wear personal safety equipment such as safety glasses, hearing protection, or proper footwear PPE in specified areas.
  
  
Fully responsible for implementing safety and environmental rules within area of responsibility. Must uphold all safety standards and have in-depth knowledge of safety. Must be a coach and model safety excellence by wearing prescribed PPE and ensuring employees under his span of control are adhering to all safety rules. Has ultimate responsibility and authority to stop production if any hazard is present that may affect the safety of the employees in the shift.
  
  

* Ensure compliance with HSE procedures, instructions, guidelines and golden rules
* Ensure that the HSE procedures and instructions of his/her department are always adapted and updated
* Ensure the acquisition and maintenance of HSE skills of its employees in relation to the tasks performed by its teams
* Ensure that the equipment under his/her responsibility is in good condition and operates safely. If this is not the case, he/she will ensure that protective measures are taken and/or that the equipment is consigned
* Identify and deal with HSE risk situations during the appropriate PSM
* Manage emergency situations with the help of the first aiders and first response team members
* Relay and lead HSE communication within his/her teams
* Ensure that the necessary resources are available to guarantee the preservation of the health and safety of the people in his/her department
* Ensure that the necessary resources are made available to guarantee the limitation of the environmental impact of his/her department
* Within his/her scope, implement actions to achieve the site's HSE objectives
* Participating to the HSE management review

LISI is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin.

**About the Opportunity:**

A well-established manufacturing organization in the aviation and aerospace industry is seeking an experienced Director of Production to oversee and improve its manufacturing operations.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone with direct aerospace or aviation manufacturing experience who can manage production activities, lead teams, improve operational efficiency, and ensure consistent product quality and on-time delivery.

The ideal candidate is a practical, floor-oriented leader who understands production planning, manufacturing processes, equipment maintenance, and resource management.

* Oversee daily manufacturing and production activities to ensure operational efficiency, product quality, and timely delivery.

* Ensure compliance with aviation manufacturing standards, safety regulations, environmental requirements, and customer specifications.
* Work closely with department managers and supervisors to establish performance goals and maintain accountability.

* Support facility improvements, equipment upgrades, capital projects, and the implementation of new manufacturing technologies.

* Direct experience in aviation or aerospace manufacturing operations is required.
* Previous experience managing production teams, manufacturing schedules, and operational resources.
* Strong understanding of production planning, manufacturing processes, maintenance coordination, and quality control.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to improve productivity, control costs, and meet production targets.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

records.description:
Help manufacturing businesses turn their technology investments into lasting success. As Director of Consulting Services, you’ll lead consulting managers and their teams across the Americas, bringing people together to deliver successful ERP implementations and support existing customers.

You’ll combine strategic direction with direct customer engagement—building trusted relationships, resolving complex challenges, and helping your teams deliver on their commitments. With an anticipated services portfolio of approximately $15–20 million in revenue, you’ll have the opportunity to shape delivery performance while developing the people behind it.

  

**What you will be doing:**
===========================

* Lead consulting managers and their teams, connecting individual contributions to shared goals, customer success, and business performance.
* Guide delivery across new manufacturing ERP implementations and existing customer engagements, keeping teams aligned on scope, timelines, quality, and customer priorities.
* Build trusted relationships with customer leaders, listening to their needs and engaging proactively to address risks and strengthen confidence.
* Take ownership of customer escalations, bringing the right people together to develop practical recovery plans and deliver on agreed commitments.
* Oversee portfolio revenue performance, delivery risks, and resource needs, partnering with consulting leadership to balance capacity and business priorities.
* Contribute to customer and pre-sales discussions, reviewing proposed commitments and statements of work to identify gaps and delivery risks.
* Coach and develop consulting managers through clear feedback, shared knowledge, and opportunities to strengthen their leadership.
Partner across sales, consulting, and other customer-facing teams to improve handoffs, solve recurring challenges, and find smarter ways to deliver customer value.  

  

**What you will likely bring:**
===============================

* Progressive experience in ERP consulting or professional services delivery, with a proven record of leading teams and delivering customer outcomes.
* Experience leading through managers, building accountability, and supporting professional growth.
* Confidence managing complex customer escalations, navigating difficult conversations, and rebuilding trust through action.
* Strong understanding of ERP implementation lifecycles, delivery governance, scope management, and risk assessment.
* Commercial judgment and the ability to connect revenue performance, resource decisions, and customer priorities.
Clear communication, collaborative problem-solving, and the ability to guide teams through change.  

  

**What will set you apart:**
============================

* Experience supporting manufacturing customers and understanding their business processes.
* Success overseeing a consulting services portfolio of comparable scale.
A record of improving delivery practices and strengthening partnerships across teams.

records.description:
**At ACI we build our company and our culture not by counting people, but by making our people count!**

Atlantic Constructors is seeking dynamic, motivated, career minded individuals to join our expanding team! Atlantic Constructors has been recognized as an industry leader in the Mid-Atlantic Region for over 50 years.

**Benefits:**

* ***$0.00 COST FOR MEDICAL, DENTAL, SHORT TERM DISABILITYLIFE INSURANCE (EMPLOYEE ONLY) COVERAGE!***
* Dental Insurance Plan
* Vision Insurance Plan
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with Generous Company Matching
* Health Savings Plan with Generous Company Matching
* Wellness Programs

Atlantic Constructors offers competitive benefits, for more information check out our comprehensive list on our website. ACIBuilds.com

**Role Overview:**
==================

The Director of Offsite Production is responsible for the leadership, performance, and continued growth of offsite production across company facilities. The role oversees carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication and non-volumetric prefabrication and manufacturing, including pipe racks, equipment skids, supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies. The Director establishes the operating systems, production standards, capacity, and cross-functional coordination required to deliver safe, compliant, high-quality work on schedule.

This leader is accountable for implementing improvements that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability. The Director will implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, eliminate waste and production constraints, reduce rework, and create repeatable processes that support scalable offsite manufacturing. The position works closely with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, and field operations to align production with project and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Offsite Production Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Provide enterprise leadership for pipe fabrication, prefabrication, and manufacturing operations across company facilities and approved external production partners.
* Translate backlog, project schedules, and sales forecasts into capacity plans, staffing requirements, production priorities, and facility needs.
* Establish a consistent operating cadence for production planning, readiness reviews, constraint management, performance reporting, and executive escalation.
* Develop scalable operating standards that support growth while maintaining safety, quality, cost control, and predictable delivery performance.
* Coordinate work across facilities to balance demand, available labor, equipment, and production capability.

**Pipe Fabrication Operations**
-------------------------------

* Direct carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication operations, including material receiving, cutting, beveling, fit-up, welding, inspection, testing, coating coordination, staging, and shipment.
* Ensure spool sequencing, production release, shop loading, and work packaging align with approved drawings, project priorities, and field installation requirements.
* Maintain compliance with applicable codes, specifications, welding procedures, ASME and AWS requirements, customer quality plans, and company standards.
* Improve material traceability, weld documentation, inspection records, testing status, and turnover packages for fabricated systems.

**Prefabrication and Manufacturing Operations**
-----------------------------------------------

* Lead production of non-volumetric prefabricated assemblies, including pipe racks, equipment skids, structural supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies.
* Develop repeatable production cells, workstations, tooling, fixtures, travelers, and assembly sequences that improve flow and reduce variation.
* Ensure manufacturing plans account for structural, mechanical, electrical, controls, insulation, coatings, testing, preservation, packaging, and logistics requirements, as applicable.
* Support the transition of first-of-a-kind work into stable, repeatable production through lessons learned, standardized design, and controlled process updates.

**Production Planning and Readiness**
-------------------------------------

* Establish production-readiness criteria to confirm approved drawings, bills of material, work instructions, quality requirements, tooling, materials, and labor are available before work is released.
* Partner with Engineering and VDC to improve constructability, spool and assembly breakdown, drawing release sequencing, and design for manufacturing and assembly.
* Coordinate with Procurement and material-control teams to maintain visibility to shortages, supplier commitments, receiving status, kitting, and point-of-use material availability.
* Identify production constraints early, assign recovery actions, and communicate schedule or capacity risks to Project Management and executive leadership.
* Maintain production schedules that clearly identify priorities, dependencies, resource loading, planned output, and required shipment dates.

**Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement**
-------------------------------------------------

* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability across all offsite operations.
* Implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, including 5S, standard work, value-stream mapping, visual management, cellular production, daily tiered accountability, Kaizen events, mistake-proofing, and continuous-flow principles.
* Evaluate workflows, facility layouts, material movement, staffing, tooling, and equipment utilization to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, waste, waiting, excess handling, rework, and other non-value-added activity.
* Use time studies, cycle-time analysis, workload balancing, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving to improve production performance and reduce manufacturing lead time.
* Develop and maintain standard work instructions and repeatable manufacturing processes that improve safety, quality, training effectiveness, and output predictability.
* Lead initiatives to reduce setup and changeover time, control work in process, improve material flow, and increase productive labor utilization.
* Maintain an improvement pipeline with defined owners, target benefits, implementation dates, and verified results; ensure completed improvements are standardized and sustained.
* Evaluate and implement automation, machinery, software, tooling, and manufacturing technologies that improve safety, quality, efficiency, and capacity.

**Throughput Capacity and Performance Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Establish production targets and capacity models based on takt time, cycle time, labor availability, equipment constraints, facility limits, and project demand.
* Track and improve key performance indicators such as safety performance, labor hours per spool or assembly, plan attainment, throughput, work in process, first-pass yield, rework, equipment utilization, and on-time completion and shipment.
* Develop visual dashboards and tiered performance reviews that provide timely, accurate information to supervisors, project teams, and executive leadership.
* Analyze performance gaps, determine root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions, and verify that results are sustained.
* Use production data to validate estimating assumptions, workforce plans, capital investments, and future capacity requirements.

**Supplier and External Fabrication Partner Management**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Qualify, onboard, and manage third-party fabrication and manufacturing partners when additional capacity or specialized capability is required.
* Define scopes of work, quality requirements, documentation, inspection points, schedule expectations, material responsibilities, and delivery requirements for outsourced work.
* Monitor supplier performance for safety, quality, responsiveness, cost, schedule adherence, and corrective-action closure.
* Coordinate external production with internal Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and logistics teams.

**Estimating and Preconstruction Support**
------------------------------------------

* Support Estimating and Preconstruction with production strategies, labor assumptions, production rates, facility requirements, tooling, equipment, subcontract capacity, and logistics considerations.
* Review proposed scope, drawings, specifications, and schedules to identify production risks, constructability issues, testing requirements, and opportunities for prefabrication or standardization.
* Provide fact-based labor and throughput data to improve estimate accuracy and establish achievable production commitments.
* Participate in make-or-buy decisions and recommend the most effective production approach based on capability, capacity, cost, risk, and schedule.

**Quality Safety and Delivery**
-------------------------------

* Promote a production culture in which safety, quality, and operational discipline are built into the process and are never traded for output.
* Partner with Safety and Quality leaders to establish training, inspections, hold points, audits, nonconformance controls, and corrective-action processes.
* Ensure completed work is inspected, tested, documented, preserved, packaged, and released in accordance with project and company requirements.
* Drive reduction of defects, weld repairs, material damage, punch-list items, field rework, and incomplete turnover documentation.
* Coordinate staging, loading, transportation readiness, and shipment sequencing to support safe handling and efficient field installation.

**Team Leadership and Development**
-----------------------------------

* Build and lead an accountable organization of production managers, superintendents, supervisors, planners, coordinators, and skilled craft professionals.
* Define roles, decision rights, staffing plans, performance expectations, and development paths for the offsite production team.
* Train leaders and production personnel in Lean principles, standard work, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, visual management, and data-driven decision-making.
* Develop succession plans and cross-training programs that increase workforce flexibility and reduce dependency on single points of knowledge.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, teamwork, continuous improvement, and respect for people.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, manufacturing, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience in fabrication, prefabrication, manufacturing, construction operations, or a closely related production environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated success improving production throughput, labor productivity, quality, schedule performance, and operating discipline.
* Practical experience implementing Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement systems in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of pipe fabrication, welding, structural fabrication, production planning, material control, quality systems, and shop operations.
* Ability to build capacity plans, interpret production data, identify constraints, and translate performance information into corrective action.
* Experience coordinating with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, suppliers, and field teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, financial, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent formal training in Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Experience with ASME, AWS, weld-quality programs, fabrication codes, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Experience with production-planning, ERP, manufacturing execution, scheduling, and performance-dashboard systems.
* Working knowledge of fabrication and detailing platforms such as Stratus, Tekla, SpoolFab, or comparable systems.
* Experience establishing or expanding multi-facility prefabrication and manufacturing operations.
* Experience implementing automation, advanced tooling, production-line design, and capital improvement projects

Visit us at www.acibuilds.com for more information!

records.description:
**About Tutor**
---------------

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**The Role**
------------

As Head of Technical Operations, you’ll own manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations. We build hundreds of robots a year today and need to build a lot more. You’ll own how we get there, including the teams, suppliers and facilities, and work closely with engineering along the way.

You’ll report to the CTO. This is an onsite role in Watertown, MA.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Scaling production from hundreds of robots a year to many more
* Manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations
* The teams, suppliers and facilities behind production
* A close partnership with engineering

**Requirements**
----------------

* Ran manufacturing or operations at a company that builds complex hardware in volume
* Built an operations function and hired the people who run it
* Been responsible for a fleet of products in the field, including service and support
* Sets clear targets and hires well
* Comfortable on a factory floor

**Nice to have:**

* Robotics, or other products that combine hardware and software
* Experience with contract manufacturers
* Experience with quality systems

**What to Expect**
------------------

We want you to know exactly what to expect. Here’s what our interview process typically looks like:

* **Recruiter interview:** A conversation with a member of our Recruiting team about your background and what you’re looking for.
* **Hiring manager interview:** A deeper conversation with the hiring manager about the role and your experience.
* **Onsite:** A presentation with the team, 1:1s with key team members, and a tour of our facility.

Some roles include additional steps, such as a technical assessment or take-home exercise. If yours does, we’ll let you know up front. Throughout the process, we’ll aim to keep you updated at each step as quickly as possible.

**Why Tutor?**
--------------

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**Benefits**
------------

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation Range: $250K - $350K

Director of Operations, North America

**About Us:**

We are committed to finding smart solutions that enable an intelligent and seamless world. Our success as a world-class leader in technology has evolved from humble beginnings. In 1896, the enterprising father and son team of A.J. and George A. Briggs partnered with S.A. Buffington, a Chicago lawyer, to establish Chicago Telephone Supply Company (later to become CTS).

Today, CTS is a leading designer and manufacturer of sensors, actuators, and electronic components for suppliers and original equipment manufacturers. We have over 20 locations in 12 countries and more than 3,500 employees. Our innovative sensing, connectivity, and motion solutions offer a diverse range of products across diversified end markets including transportation, medical, aerospace and defense, and industrial. We are at the forefront of supporting innovating life-changing technology, focusing on quality to keep people safe, healthy, and happy.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Director, North America provides strategic and operational leadership for the regional manufacturing network, ensuring safe, compliant, cost-effective, and customer-focused execution across assigned sites. This position requires a hands-on, execution-focused leader who can standardize operating processes, improve performance variability across sites, coach plant leadership teams, and convert strategic business priorities into measurable operational and financial results. Backed by more than a century of engineering excellence in thermal management technology, Modexus Solutions has sharpened its focus as a specialized leader in commercial HVAC and data center solutions into a new era.
