**Job Summary**
The
**Director, Manufacturing Process Development**
will develop, characterize, scale, validate, transfer, and optimize manufacturing processes for dental consumables globally. This role translates product, chemistry, material, quality, and customer requirements into robust, compliant, cost-effective manufacturing processes within an FDA- and ISO-regulated environment.
  
  
Reporting to the VP, Innovation & R&D, this leader bridges R&D Engineering, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Procurement, driving manufacturing readiness, technical risk management, and process ownership. The role leads a team of engineers and requires strong influence, relationship-building, and cross-functional navigation skills.
  
  
*Candidate must reside within a commutable distance to Pomona, CA. This is not a hybrid or remote opportunity and requires onsite presence 4 days per week.*
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Develop process development strategy and roadmaps aligned to business and portfolio priorities, setting standards, governance, and resourcing for development, scale-up, validation, and lifecycle support.
* Lead, coach, and develop a process engineering team, building technical depth, accountability, and succession planning.
* Develop scalable manufacturing platforms, standards, and reusable process technologies to accelerate future product introductions and operational excellence.
* Drive development and adoption of innovative manufacturing technologies and automation solutions to improve scalability, quality, efficiency, and competitive advantage.
* Partner with product development teams to embed design-for-manufacturability principles early in product and formulation development.
* Own process development from feasibility through validation and transfer for adhesives, composites, cements, endodontic, and other dental consumable platforms, defining process specifications, critical parameters, and controls.
* In collaboration with Chemistry team, characterize material and process behavior (e.g., rheology, mixing, variability, hold times) to build scientific understanding linking materials, equipment, and finished-product performance.
* Apply Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, and risk-based tools to define process design spaces, control strategies, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate manufacturing, scale-up, and commercialization risks throughout the product lifecycle.
* Lead pilot builds, scale-up, qualification, validation, and manufacturing transfer, ensuring readiness criteria, documentation, and training are in place.
* Provide process development leadership on New Product Development (NPD), commercialization, and lifecycle teams, aligning scope, risk, resources, and timelines across functions.
* Serve as the key technical liaison between Manufacturing and R&D, building trust and alignment across functions without relying on positional authority.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to optimize processes, troubleshoot issues, and improve capability across the product lifecycle, clarifying handoffs from development to routine manufacturing.
* Collaborate on investigations into nonconformances, deviations, and quality events using root-cause analysis and statistical methods to drive effective CAPAs.
* Define equipment and process requirements and partner with cross-functional teams and vendors on selection, integration, and automation to improve safety, quality, and efficiency.
* Drive measurable improvements in yield, throughput, cycle time, capability, and cost through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure all activities comply with the Quality Management System (QMS), FDA requirements, ISO 13485, GMP, EH&S, and applicable SOPs; support audits, CAPAs, and regulatory submissions.
* Communicate strategy, readiness, risk, and outcomes to senior leadership, ensuring sound documentation and escalation practices.
* Travel approximately 25% domestically and internationally to support manufacturing sites.

**Incidental Duties:**
The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, and additional responsibilities may be assigned, as required, by management.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Qualifications:**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. This individual must be able to function in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change rapidly. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline required; master’s degree or PhD preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience across developing, scaling, or validating manufacturing processes in a regulated or formal quality-system environment is required.
* 5+ years of people and cross-functional leadership experience required.
* Experience in supporting multi-site or global manufacturing operations preferred.
* Experience with Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma tools and/or methodologies required.

**Skills/Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, gain commitment, and lead through relationships, technical credibility, data, and shared business objectives required.
* Exceptional relationship-building and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to create alignment and trust between Manufacturing and R&D required.
* Strong people leadership skills with a record of developing technical talent, building capability, setting clear expectations, and driving accountability required.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills, including Design of Experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, process capability, root-cause analysis, and risk-based decision making required.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex programs, prioritize resources, manage ambiguity, resolve conflict, and drive execution across functions and sites required.
* Strong business and operational acumen, including the ability to balance safety, quality, compliance, delivery, innovation, capacity, and cost required.
* Strong verbal, presentation, facilitation, and technical writing skills in English, with the ability to communicate effectively from the manufacturing floor through executive leadership required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with formulated medical-device products preferred.
* Ability to build business cases and use data to support equipment, automation, process technology, capacity, and cost-improvement investments preferred.
* Intermediate Microsoft Office skills, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, required; proficiency with statistical analysis software and aptitude to learn enterprise systems preferred.

records.description:
Crusoe is on a mission
*to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*
. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.
  
  
We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.
  
  
We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.
  
  
If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.
  
  
**About This Role:**
The
**Senior Manager, Quality Management Systems (QMS)**
will lead the development, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Crusoe's enterprise Quality Management System across multiple manufacturing facilities, supplier operations, subcontractors, and field deployment activities.
  
  
This individual will be responsible for establishing a scalable, standardized, risk-based QMS that enables consistent product quality, manufacturing process control, regulatory and customer compliance, and operational excellence across the organization.
  
  
The role will provide strategic and operational leadership for QMS governance, internal and external audits, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), document and records management, quality processes, compliance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead and develop a team of QMS professionals, auditors, and documentation specialists while partnering closely with Product Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Field Quality leadership.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of progressive Quality Management System experience, including substantial people-management experience in complex manufacturing environments. This individual must be capable of translating quality standards and business requirements into practical operating processes that improve manufacturing effectiveness, prevent defects, reduce operational risks, and support organizational growth.
  
  
**The ultimate objective is to establish a proactive, business-enabling QMS that drives consistency, accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement across Crusoe's growing AI Data Center infrastructure manufacturing and deployment ecosystem.**
**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Enterprise QMS Strategy, Governance & Leadership

+ Own and lead the enterprise Quality Management System strategy, architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.
+ Establish and maintain a scalable QMS aligned with ISO 9001:2015 and applicable customer, regulatory, contractual, and industry requirements.
+ Develop standardized Quality policies, procedures, processes, work instructions, forms, and records applicable across all manufacturing facilities and operational functions.
+ Establish QMS governance, process ownership, accountability matrices, escalation mechanisms, and management review processes.
+ Ensure consistent implementation of Quality Management System requirements across Brighton, Tulsa-1, Tulsa-2, Arvada, Ponchatoula, and other future manufacturing and operational locations.
+ Establish a process-based, risk-oriented approach to quality management rather than a documentation-driven compliance culture.
+ Partner with Quality leadership to establish annual QMS objectives, strategic initiatives, resource plans, and performance targets.
+ Lead QMS maturity assessments and develop roadmaps to strengthen process effectiveness and organizational readiness.
+ Ensure QMS requirements are appropriately integrated into product development, manufacturing, supplier management, and field operations.

* ISO Compliance & Audit Management

+ Own the enterprise internal and external audit program, including audit planning, scheduling, execution, reporting, and follow-up.
+ Maintain organizational readiness for ISO 9001 certification, surveillance audits, recertification audits, and customer or third-party audits.
+ Lead and oversee internal audits across manufacturing, engineering, procurement, supplier quality, production, inspection, testing, and field operations.
+ Ensure audit programs evaluate actual process implementation and effectiveness rather than merely verifying documentation.
+ Manage relationships with external certification bodies, registrars, customer auditors, and regulatory or industry assessment organizations.
+ Establish risk-based audit schedules considering process criticality, historical performance, operational changes, and previous audit findings.
+ Ensure audit findings are appropriately classified, assigned, investigated, corrected, and closed within established timelines.
+ Verify corrective action effectiveness and prevent recurrence of systemic audit findings.
+ Develop and maintain qualified internal auditor resources across multiple facilities and functions.

* CAPA, Nonconformance & Continuous Improvement

+ Establish and govern enterprise-wide CAPA, nonconformance, deviation, and quality escalation processes.
+ Ensure effective root cause analysis using structured methodologies such as 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, fault tree analysis, and other appropriate problem-solving techniques.
+ Drive accountability for corrective and preventive actions across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Operations.
+ Monitor CAPA aging, overdue actions, recurrence rates, effectiveness verification, and systemic trends.
+ Identify recurring process failures, systemic weaknesses, and opportunities for organizational improvement.
+ Establish standardized requirements for nonconformance documentation, containment, disposition, investigation, and closure.
+ Lead cross-functional improvement initiatives that reduce process variation, eliminate waste, improve first-pass yield, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
+ Ensure lessons learned from internal defects, supplier issues, customer complaints, and field failures are incorporated into the QMS.

* QMS Documentation & Records Management

+ Own enterprise document and records management governance.
+ Establish standardized requirements for document creation, review, approval, release, revision control, distribution, retention, and obsolescence.
+ Ensure controlled management of Quality Manuals, policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, inspection plans, test procedures, forms, and quality records.
+ Implement effective document control processes across multiple facilities and functional organizations.
+ Ensure personnel have access to current and approved documentation at the point of use.
+ Establish document ownership and periodic review requirements.
+ Eliminate uncontrolled documentation, obsolete work instructions, inconsistent forms, and duplicate processes.
+ Drive adoption and effective utilization of electronic QMS platforms and digital document management solutions.
+ Ensure objective evidence and records are maintained to demonstrate process conformity and effectiveness.

* Risk Management & Operational Quality Governance

+ Establish enterprise-level Quality risk management processes.
+ Ensure risk-based thinking is incorporated into business processes, product realization, supplier management, manufacturing operations, and field activities.
+ Oversee QMS-related risk assessments and coordinate with functional leaders on DFMEA, PFMEA, process risk assessments, and operational controls.
+ Establish escalation mechanisms for significant Quality risks, process deviations, regulatory concerns, and potential customer impacts.
+ Ensure changes to products, processes, suppliers, equipment, and organizational structures are appropriately evaluated for QMS impact.
+ Drive management review processes that evaluate QMS performance, organizational risks, customer satisfaction, audit results, CAPA effectiveness, and improvement opportunities.

* Multi-Site Standardization & Deployment

+ Establish a consistent enterprise QMS framework while allowing controlled, documented site-specific requirements where necessary.
+ Lead QMS deployment, implementation, and maturity improvement across existing and new manufacturing facilities.
+ Partner with site Quality leaders to ensure standardized processes are effectively implemented and sustained.
+ Conduct periodic site assessments to evaluate QMS effectiveness, process adherence, and compliance maturity.
+ Establish cross-site benchmarking and sharing of best practices.
+ Ensure new manufacturing facilities and acquired or outsourced operations are incorporated into the enterprise QMS framework.
+ Develop standardized QMS deployment and operational readiness plans for new facilities.

* Customer, Supplier & Regulatory Quality Support

+ Partner with Supplier Quality leadership to ensure QMS requirements are incorporated into supplier qualification, supplier audits, corrective actions, and supplier performance management.
+ Ensure subcontractors and outsourced manufacturing partners operate under appropriate Quality requirements and controls.
+ Support customer audits, quality assessments, and contractual compliance requirements.
+ Ensure effective management of customer complaints, quality escapes, and external nonconformances through the enterprise CAPA framework.
+ Partner with Product and Manufacturing Quality to ensure appropriate quality planning and process controls are established.
+ Maintain awareness of applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, and customer-specific Quality requirements relevant to electrical and mechanical infrastructure manufacturing.

* People Leadership & Organizational Development

+ Build, lead, and develop a high-performing QMS organization.
+ Directly manage QMS personnel, including QMS Leads, Quality Auditors, QMS Documentation Specialists, and other assigned Quality professionals.
+ Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance expectations, and individual development plans.
+ Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, talent assessments, and succession planning.
+ Develop technical and leadership competencies within the QMS organization.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.
+ Establish effective working relationships with site Quality leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
+ Identify resource requirements and develop headcount and organizational plans to support current and future business growth.
+ Mentor and develop future Quality leaders and technical subject matter experts.

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Establishing, monitoring, and improving measurable QMS performance indicators, including:

+ QMS Compliance
+ Audit Management
+ CAPA Effectiveness
+ Document Control
+ Multi-Site Standardization
+ Process Effectiveness
+ Organizational Development
+ Customer Quality
+ Continuous Improvement

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* Educational Foundation: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Industrial Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Professional Experience:

+ 7+ Years of Dedicated Experience in QMS, plus additional experience in Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Assurance.
+ 5+ Years of People Leadership Experience: Including managing and developing Quality professionals and technical teams (these years may overlap with the 10+ above).

* QMS Expertise: Demonstrated experience owning, implementing, and improving enterprise or multi-site Quality Management Systems.
* ISO 9001 Expertise: Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 requirements and certification processes.
* Core Quality Methodologies: Demonstrated expertise in CAPA, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and continuous improvement.
* Quality Documentation & Document Control: Experience developing and implementing Quality policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions, and document control systems.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience managing cross-functional Quality initiatives across Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Supply Chain.
* Risk & Process Management: Strong understanding of risk-based thinking, process management, and operational excellence.
* eQMS Implementation: Experience implementing or administering electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS).
* Influence & Accountability: Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive organizational accountability without relying solely on hierarchical authority.
* Communication & Analytical Skills: Excellent written, verbal, analytical, organizational, and presentation skills.
* Travel: Willingness to travel 25–40% of the time, based on business needs.
* Safety and Compliance: This position is designated a safety-sensitive position and/or is located in a safety-sensitive facility; drug and alcohol program participation is required. Must be able to pass a background check.

**Bonus Points:**

* Advanced Education: Master's degree in Engineering, Quality, Operations Management, or Business Administration.
* Professional Certifications: ASQ Certified Quality Manager (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or equivalent professional credentials.
* Lead Auditor Certification: ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification.
* Industry Experience: Experience in electrical equipment, switchgear, switchboards, power distribution, mechanical assemblies, data center infrastructure, aerospace, automotive, energy, or other complex manufacturing industries.
* Industry Standards: Familiarity with UL 891, UL 508, applicable IEC, IEEE, NEMA, NFPA, and other relevant industry standards.
* Multi-Site QMS Deployment: Experience managing QMS deployment across multiple manufacturing facilities and outsourced manufacturing operations.
* Digital Quality Systems: Experience with digital QMS platforms, ERP integration, document management, and quality analytics.
* Lean & Six Sigma: Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and operational excellence methodologies.
* NPI & Scale-Up: Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI), manufacturing scale-up, and new facility launches.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation:**
Compensation will be paid in the range of $190,000 - $215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
  
  
Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Overall responsibilities for maintaining ISO compliance for Quality and Environmental management in addition to overseeing internal quality manufacturing management.
* Provide training on ISO 9001.
* Ensure all audit responses are closed out in a proper and timely manner
* Participates with other senior leadership to establish strategic plans and objectives.

At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices.

Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.
  
  
**Join Our Team as a Senior Manager - Supplier Quality**
!
  
  
The Senior Manager - Supplier Quality is responsible for ensuring that all suppliers meet or exceed the company’s quality standards through strategic audits, risk mitigation, and continuous supplier development. This role emphasizes proactive engagement with suppliers to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and ultimately ensure the quality of supplied components to S&C. The position also oversees the qualification and ongoing evaluation of suppliers to align with the company’s operational and commercial objectives.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Supplier Audits & Qualification: Formulate and implement a comprehensive operational strategy to drive continuous quality improvement initiatives within the supplier quality function. Lead a team that conducts comprehensive audits and supplier qualification processes, ensuring compliance with quality standards and the prevention of defective component shipments from the supplier to S&C. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess supplier capabilities and align with company requirements.
* COPQ: Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Take ownership of reducing the cost of poor quality (COPQ) by analyzing trends in supplier-reported issues, identifying root causes, and implementing preventative measures to ensure continuous improvement in product quality.
* Production Part Approval Process (PPAP): Oversee the PPAP process to validate supplier-provided components meet specified requirements. Ensure that documentation, testing, and approvals are conducted thoroughly and accurately.
* Risk Analysis and Mitigation: Perform supplier risk analysis by evaluating historical performance, process controls, and financial stability. Develop and execute mitigation strategies to minimize potential supply chain disruptions.
* Corrective Action and Accountability: Lead the resolution of supplier-related quality issues through effective corrective action processes. Establish clear accountability frameworks to ensure sustained improvements and proactive prevention of non-confirming/defective components before receiving them.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a subject matter expert in Supplier Quality, staying abreast of industry best practices, standards, and technological advancements and ensuring the greater quality function is well-versed in the latest quality methodologies and tools, facilitating a high level of technical proficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Analyze quality feedback and metrics to identify trends and improvement opportunities. Set team targets for various KPIs and collaborate with production groups to recommend quality targets. Implement a data-driven decision-making process to enhance overall product quality and operational efficiency.
* QA System Support: Manage the meticulous documentation of quality processes, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and internal and external compliance requirements. Provide strategic guidance for regular review and updates, incorporating changes in processes, standards, and best practices to maintain a compliant and dynamic quality management system.
* Functional Leadership: Provide strong leadership and direction to managers and senior contributors, setting clear performance expectations, and fostering a culture of accountability and excellence. Conduct regular performance assessments, provide constructive feedback, and facilitate career development opportunities to support individual growth and organizational succession planning.
* Thought Leadership: Provide thought leadership and best-practice direction to the quality assurance team, ensuring the execution of quality goals that contribute towards the larger goals of S&C.
* Compliance: Understand and comply with all applicable content standards, brand guidelines, company policies, and rules.

**Required**
**Core Leadership & Management**

* 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in Supplier Quality, Quality Engineering, or related manufacturing quality roles.
* 5+ years in leadership or senior management roles overseeing global suppliers and multi-site operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field; advanced degree or Six Sigma Black Belt preferred Preferred
* Experience in a large (2+ billion-dollar revenue) B2B manufacturing company.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a global Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) team, setting strategic direction, driving accountability, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
* Strong executive presence with the capability to influence cross‑functional leaders in engineering, operations, procurement, and manufacturing.
* Demonstrated track record of managing complex supplier ecosystems and driving measurable improvements in quality performance.
* Technical & Quality Expertise
* Deep expertise in advanced quality tools and methodologies, including APQP, PPAP, FMEA, MSA, SPC, 8D, and root-cause/containment fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing process controls, capability studies, product validation, and statistical quality management.
* Ability to assess supplier technical capability and process maturity through detailed audits and data-driven evaluation Supplier Management & Performance Improvement
* Experience developing and deploying supplier quality strategies to ensure robust selection, onboarding, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Proven ability to drive corrective action and continuous improvement using structured problem-solving techniques.
* Hands-on experience establishing supplier scorecards, performance targets, and escalation management processes. Operational Excellence & Risk Management
* Strong capability in managing supplier risk, including process risk assessments, qualification reviews, and proactive risk mitigation planning.
* Demonstrated experience improving cost, quality, and delivery through Lean/Six Sigma methodologies.
* Expertise in quality system requirements such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or industry-specific standards Experience & Education

**Education**

**Job Description**
The Director PMO NPI/NPD is responsible for leading the successful transition of new products from R&D into scalable volume manufacturing. Sitting within the PMO and reporting to the VP of Production Engineering and Continuous Improvement (PECI), this role owns NPI execution, manufacturing readiness, and phase-gate milestone delivery across the product portfolio. The Director partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product Management to ensure products transition seamlessly into volume manufacturing — meeting customer, quality, cost, and delivery expectations — while building the processes, tooling, and team capabilities needed to scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**New Product Development & Launch**

* Own PLM milestone tracking, phase-gate execution, and portfolio pipeline alignment to ensure timely and effective product launches
* Drive product commercialization from R&D handoff through launch, ensuring new products meet or exceed customer, quality, cost, and delivery requirements
* Align cross-functionally on the new product pipeline and launch readiness across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product Management

**Manufacturing Readiness & Scale-Up**

* Lead the transition of products from R&D into volume manufacturing, establishing scalable and repeatable production processes
* Develop and ramp manufacturing capability and capacity for new products at the R&D site
* Establish and continuously improve the R&D production line to support prototype and pilot builds

**Automation, Tooling & Test**

* Lead automation initiatives including tooling, test fixtures, and production test requirement definition
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to ensure test and tooling solutions are scalable for volume production

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of Technical Program Managers and the Engineering Manager for Prototype and Pilot Builds
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement within the NPD PMO function

**Skill & Abilities**
**Ownership & Accountability**
Ability to drive NPI program outcomes from R&D handoff through volume manufacturing launch. Holds themselves and their team to commitments, drives decisions, and escalates risks proactively — ensuring programs stay on track.
  
  
**Program & Portfolio Management**
Ability to manage multiple NPI programs simultaneously across the portfolio, maintaining phase-gate discipline, milestone ownership, and pipeline visibility from commercialization through volume launch.
  
  
**Commercialization & NPI Execution**
Ability to take products through the commercialization phase — from R&D handoff to volume manufacturing — on time and within cost, quality, and delivery targets.
  
  
**Manufacturing & Production Readiness**
Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, scale-up requirements, tooling, automation, and test development — with the ability to translate R&D outputs into production-ready solutions.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence**
Ability to align and drive execution across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product Management without direct authority over all stakeholders — critical in a PMO structure.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking & Prioritization**
Ability to manage competing program priorities at the portfolio level, make sound trade-off decisions, and keep initiatives aligned to business objectives.
  
  
**Team Development**
Ability to lead, develop and effectively scale a team to ensure the right capabilities and resourcing are in place at the right time.
  
  
**Stakeholder Communication & Reporting**
Ability to synthesize program status, risks, and decisions into clear, concise communication for senior leadership and the c-suite.
  
  
**Travel**
Ability to travel 10-20%
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field
* 15+ years of program management experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment, with a focus on new product introduction (NPI), product transitions, or manufacturing scale-up
* 5+ years of team leadership/management role within a PMO, R&D, or Operations function
* Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production readiness, and product commercialization
* Familiarity with PLM systems and phase-gate product development processes
* PMP, Six Sigma, or equivalent certification

* Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field; MBA a plus
* Experience with automation systems, production tooling, and test fixture development
* Deep knowledge of phase-gate execution, PLM milestone management, and portfolio pipeline alignment
* Demonstrated success scaling products from prototype/pilot builds to volume manufacturing

**Expiration Date:** 11/30/2026

**JOB SUMMARY**

Responsible for communicating the concept of Total Quality Management through advising, coaching, training, and facilitating. Position works with direct reports, General Managers, and other staff to develop and implement quality assurance strategies. The position is responsible for ensuring that quality processes meet company’s mission and brand standards, target customer needs, ensure employee satisfaction, and focus on continuous improvement at the property level. .

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Managing Quality Assurance Goals**

* Coaches managers on adopting the Total Quality Management leadership style.

* Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.

* Directs property quality efforts to address critical customer requirements.

* Facilitates process improvement teams, assuring use of the systematic processes, and improvement is achievable and measurable.

**Leading Quality Assurance Team**

* Trains team members and managers on problem solving, process improvement and strategic planning techniques

* Develops systems to enable employees to understand guest satisfaction results.

* Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

* Coaches managers on adopting the Total Quality Management leadership style.

* Educates new employees on the foundations of the quality processes, how to use quality tools and their role in continuous improvement.

* Familiarizes employees with the daily quality production reports and how to spot trends in their work areas and initiate root cause analysis.

**Managing Quality Tools**

* Ensures that management practices at all levels are aligned with quality tools.

* Uses data collection methods to compile, display, track, and analyze defect trends.

* Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.

* Analyzes issues and identifies trends.

**Managing the Guest Experience**

* Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

* Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

* Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

* Creates an atmosphere in all properties that meets or exceeds guest expectations.

**Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities**

* Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.

* Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

* Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in quality assurance.

* Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.

* Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.

* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.

* Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

* Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.

* Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

* Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*

records.title: Head of Technical Operations (Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Field)

postedPay.title: Head of Technical Operations (Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Field)

records.description:
**About Tutor**
---------------

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**The Role**
------------

As Head of Technical Operations, you’ll own manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations. We build hundreds of robots a year today and need to build a lot more. You’ll own how we get there, including the teams, suppliers and facilities, and work closely with engineering along the way.

You’ll report to the CTO. This is an onsite role in Watertown, MA.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Scaling production from hundreds of robots a year to many more
* Manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field service and robot operations
* The teams, suppliers and facilities behind production
* A close partnership with engineering

**Requirements**
----------------

* Ran manufacturing or operations at a company that builds complex hardware in volume
* Built an operations function and hired the people who run it
* Been responsible for a fleet of products in the field, including service and support
* Sets clear targets and hires well
* Comfortable on a factory floor

**Nice to have:**

* Robotics, or other products that combine hardware and software
* Experience with contract manufacturers
* Experience with quality systems

**What to Expect**
------------------

We want you to know exactly what to expect. Here’s what our interview process typically looks like:

* **Recruiter interview:** A conversation with a member of our Recruiting team about your background and what you’re looking for.
* **Hiring manager interview:** A deeper conversation with the hiring manager about the role and your experience.
* **Onsite:** A presentation with the team, 1:1s with key team members, and a tour of our facility.

Some roles include additional steps, such as a technical assessment or take-home exercise. If yours does, we’ll let you know up front. Throughout the process, we’ll aim to keep you updated at each step as quickly as possible.

**Why Tutor?**
--------------

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**Benefits**
------------

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation Range: $250K - $350K

records.description:
**PVC Plant Manager - Dallas**

**Who we are:**  
Atkore is forging a future where our employees, customers, suppliers, shareholders, and communities are building better together – a future focused on serving the customer and powering and protecting the world.

With a global network of manufacturing and distribution facilities, Atkore is a leading provider of electrical, safety and infrastructure solutions.

  

**Who we are looking for:**  
We are currently looking for a Plant Manager to be based out of Dallas, TX. Reporting to the Vice President Operations, this person will be responsible for directing and managing plant operations for extrusion processing, maintenance, quality, and shipping/receiving. This position will coordinate plant activities through the planning with departmental managers to ensure the total manufacturing objectives are accomplished in a safe, timely and cost-effective manner.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore. Experience in lean manufacturing or business system-based company is a requirement.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide direction, development and leadership for the facility and share best practices with other Plant Managers in running a safe, productive, cost-effective plant
* Establish and monitor overall plant performance for production and quality standards.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages and salaries.
* Participate in regular P&L reviews to ensure that budgets are met; develops and implements programs for optimal equipment utilization, equipment maintenance, and labor and material costs
* Control and minimize labor overtime, premium freight and repair expenses.
* Provide leadership and training to accomplish the company goals and objectives.
* Maintain existing plant facilities and equipment; replace or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary.
* Manage capital asset maintenance.
* Implement and maintain preventative maintenance programs.
* Provide Safety and Health direction and support to personnel; ensures compliance with OSHA and environmental regulations.
* Incorporate shop floor organization and plant cleanliness among plant personnel.
* Demonstrate and promote our key Atkore values of Accountability Teamwork, Integrity, Respect, and Excellence, through actions and decisions.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field and/or a minimum of 5 years plant/general management experience in a manufacturing environment or prior success as a Plant Manager or equivalent position at Atkore.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Background with manufacturing methods, process improvement programs and procedures required.
* Advanced knowledge and experience of PVC Water pipe extrusion process preferred.
* Ability to implement Lean Manufacturing practices and drive continuous improvement.
* Six Sigma / Project Management experience.
* Excellent written and communications skills
* Computer literate. Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Proven experience as a mentor/developmental manager for employees
* Available to occasionally work off shift to provide training and facilitate continuous improvement initiatives to all production shifts.
* Ability to work both as a member of a team, a team leader or as an individual contributor.
* Experience managing in a matrixed, mid-to-large organization
* All associates must embrace and foster and environment that supports our core values of Integrity, Respect, Excellence, Teamwork and Accountability.

  

**Within 3 months, you’ll:**

* Complete your Atkore Immersion and training requirements.
* Understand how your job will help deliver Atkore’s strategy.
* Gain an understanding of your team.
* Have developed relationships with the key stakeholders for this role.
* Be well-versed in Atkore’s Business System and the importance of your role to daily operations.

  

**Within 6 months, you’ll:**

* Maintain and be accountable for KPI visual reporting while actively participating in Lean Daily Management activities, including GEMBA walks.
* Create and modify standardized work and ensure consistent application by all team members.
* Hire talent into your organization, coach and manage performance of your team members and compensation management responsibilities for direct reports.
* Identify ways to strengthen the team’s commitment to Atkore’s core values of Accountability, Teamwork, Integrity, Respect and Excellence.

  

**Within 12 months, you’ll:**

* Be managing an efficient plant and team that delivers Atkore’s strategy.
* Have meaningful performance conversations with your direct reports.
* Be able to resolve any issues quickly and safely.

Atkore is a six-time Great Place to Work© certified company and a four-time Top Workplaces USA award winner! We’re committed to creating an engaged, aligned workforce driven by a collaborative culture. Our team **strives** for breakthrough results and **stays**focused on being standout leaders. We consistently live the Atkore mission, strategic priorities, and behaviors consistent with our core values.

**Join our team and align yourself with an industry leader!**

records.description:
**At Carbon, our mission goes beyond 3D printing. We are enabling creators everywhere to make what the world needs, right now. Our company is built on the idea that diverse fields of study must come together to solve intractable problems. We have grand ambitions to create technology that will influence industry around the world. You will be joining a diverse team with a vibrant culture, where team success is as important as celebrating individual contributions.**

  

**Help us change the world and we will help you change yours.**

  

**Job Description:**

  

We are seeking a Head of Production & Supply Chain Operations to lead our Hardware Production Team and the end-to-end logistics and inventory function that keeps Carbon’s global supply chain running. This role is critical to scaling our production operations while maintaining our commitment to safety, quality, and cost efficiency, while ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and reliable flow of Carbon’s inventory and freight worldwide. The ideal candidate is a disciplined, detail-oriented leader who thrives in a hands-on manufacturing environment, knows how to build, inspire, and motivate high-performing teams, and can operate effectively across both production and supply chain disciplines. Reporting to the Director of Supply Chain, this individual will own the end-to-end production process and the logistics and inventory organization, driving continuous improvement and ensuring our products and materials meet the highest standards from supplier to customer.

  

***This role will be spending time at both our Thomas Rd, Santa Clara and Borregas Ave, Sunnyvale locations and you will be expected to be in-office 5 days per week.***

  

**What You Will Do**

  

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop a team of manufacturing technicians and logistics and inventory staff, building a culture rooted in accountability, pride in craftsmanship, and continuous learning.
* Set clear performance expectations and conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, and skills assessments to elevate individual and team capabilities across production and logistics/inventory functions.
* Foster a positive, motivated work environment where team members feel valued and engaged, resulting in strong retention and morale.
Create training programs and cross-training plans to ensure workforce flexibility and depth across all production stations and logistics/inventory operations.  

  

**Safety**

* Champion a safety-first culture across the production floor and logistics and warehouse operations, ensuring compliance with all OSHA regulations and company safety policies.
* Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and incident investigations; implement corrective and preventive actions promptly.
* Develop, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) that prioritize operator and warehouse safety in every task.
Track and report safety metrics, driving toward zero-incident goals through proactive hazard identification and mitigation.  

  

**Quality**

* Own product quality throughout the manufacturing and assembly process, ensuring every product meets rigorous quality standards before shipment.
* Implement and manage quality control checkpoints, inspection protocols, and testing procedures at critical stages of production.
* Collaborate with Ops Engineering and Quality teams to resolve defects, perform root cause analysis, and drive corrective actions.
Monitor yield rates and first-pass quality metrics, using data to drive continuous improvement initiatives.  

  

**Cost & Operational Efficiency**

* Manage production budgets, labor costs, and material utilization to meet or exceed cost targets without compromising safety or quality.
* Own budget and cost outcomes for Carbon’s freight, logistics, and inventory programs.
* Identify and implement process improvements using Lean manufacturing principles to reduce waste, improve throughput, and increase efficiency.
* Plan and manage production schedules, capacity, and resource allocation to meet delivery commitments and customer demand.
Partner with Strategic Sourcing and Planning to optimize inventory levels and ensure timely availability of components and materials.  

  

**Logistics & Inventory Leadership**

* Own management accountability for the cost, service levels, and integrity of Carbon’s global goods flow, including all inbound and outbound freight and global inventory accuracy and compliance.
* Lead, mentor, and directly manage the team of inventory and logistics staff, setting priorities and building scalable processes as Carbon grows.
* Ensure full compliance with international trade regulations and dangerous goods/hazardous materials requirements.
Establish and track logistics and inventory KPIs (cost per shipment, on-time delivery, inventory accuracy, freight as a percentage of revenue) and drive continuous improvement against them.  

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting**

* Serve as the primary liaison between the production floor and the Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality teams to ensure seamless product launches and design-for-manufacturability feedback.
* Serve as the primary management point of contact for Finance, Legal, EH&S, Sales, contract manufacturing partners, and 3PLs on logistics, inventory, and trade compliance matters.
* Participate in new product introduction processes, contributing manufacturing insights during design reviews and pilot builds.
Provide regular production, logistics, and inventory status reports, KPIs, and escalation updates to senior leadership.  

  

**Qualifications**

  

**Required:**

* 8+ years of experience in a manufacturing or production management role, with demonstrated success leading teams of technicians or production operators.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Experience managing, overseeing, or working closely with logistics, freight, and inventory functions, including leading teams responsible for freight and inventory control.
* Proven ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams in a hands-on manufacturing environment, with a track record of maintaining safe production environments.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand complex electromechanical assemblies and manufacturing processes.
* Demonstrated discipline and meticulous attention to detail in managing production operations, documentation, and quality systems.
* Experience managing budgets, schedules, and resource planning.
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to partner effectively with a senior individual-contributor expert to translate strategy into team execution.  

  

**Nice to Have:**

* Understanding of workplace safety regulations (OSHA).
* Lean manufacturing certification (e.g., Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt).
* Experience with ISO 9001 or similar quality management systems.
* Background in 3D printing, additive manufacturing, or precision hardware production.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems and production tracking tools.
* Familiarity with Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles.
Familiarity with international trade compliance and dangerous goods/hazardous materials regulations.  

  

*You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Carbon, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.*

  

By clicking the “APPLY FOR THIS JOB” button and submitting your job application, you agree you have reviewed the complete Privacy Notice for Employees, Independent Contractors and Job Applicants , which explains the categories of personal information we collect about you, the purposes for which the categories of personal information shall be used and your rights with respect to our use of such personal Information.

  
  

At Carbon, we look at the person holistically and carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining salary. The compensation bracket for this position is $182,400 - $273,600 (per year). In order to maintain equitable internal pay practices, we aim to hire new employees near the midpoint of $228,000 taking into account your experience, work location, certifications, and the unique skills you bring to the role. If you are not based in our Sunnyvale office, the range above will be adjusted for the geographical differential associated with your actual work location.

  

For more information on how we modify your pay based on your location, please refer to our geographic differentials chart .

  
  

Carbon also offers to our eligible employees a comprehensive total rewards package that includes equity, benefits, and time off programs. For details on our total rewards package, visit https://www.carbon3d.com/about/life-at-carbon .

records.description:
**Position Overview:**

Can you lead strategic engineering initiatives while driving operational excellence across a multi-site logistics network? As the Senior Manager of Industrial Engineering, you will combine hands-on engineering expertise, customer engagement, and project leadership to improve safety, efficiency, and standardization across large-scale distribution and contract packaging operations throughout ID Logistics' national footprint. Leading multiple Senior Industrial Engineers across sites and customers, you will serve as both a people leader and an active contributor directly managing key initiatives while supporting your team's success. This highly visible, customer-facing role requires strong presentation skills, a commitment to exceptional customer service, and the ability to influence results across complex, multi-site operations.

**Location:** Hybrid. We are hiring 1 role out of any of the following locations. This role will be posted in multiple locations. (Somerset, NJ or Kenosha, WI)  
**Work Schedule:** M-F 8am-5:30pm with flexibility to work outside of normal business hours for any site level emergencies.  
**Travel Specifics:** Up to 25–50% depending on project needs across sites subject to change based on business needs.  
**Competitive Compensation:** A competitive total rewards package including an attractive annual salary $104,000-$146,000, performance-based bonus, and comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, generous PTO, sick time, and company holidays. Compensation is based on experience, skills, and education.

**Responsibilities:**

* Follow corporate and site-specific Good Manufacturing Practices and report non-compliance when observed.
* Observe all company safety rules and support enforcement and training as appropriate.
* Own the identification, prioritization, and execution of major continuous improvement and automation initiatives, including development of business cases, ROI analyses, implementation roadmaps, and post-implementation performance validation.
* Lead and develop a team of Industrial Engineers and engineering leaders by building capability, establishing clear performance expectations, coaching talent, and creating succession plans that support long-term organizational needs.
* Partner with assigned customers and facilities and take the lead to identify and then document best practices for layout design, process flow, productivity and others to ensure safety first, standardized, and efficient operations.
* Serve as a senior partner during customer solutioning and bid activities by shaping engineering concepts, reviewing pricing assumptions, supporting capital and vendor decisions, and presenting strategic recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Upon project approval, partner with IT, automation providers, integrators, controls teams, and operations leadership to govern systems integration, technology deployment, and solution validation, ensuring engineering designs translate effectively into sustainable operational performance.
* Establish and monitor engineering governance, KPIs, and reporting frameworks that measure service, productivity, utilization, quality, and capital effectiveness, and use insights to drive executive decision-making and operational accountability.
* Collaborate with senior operations and customer leaders to develop long-range engineering roadmaps that support network expansion, service innovation, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement across the business.

#LI-SALARY

Requirements:

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree or a Master's degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field is required.
* 8+ years of relevant experience, including leadership of engineering teams and large-scale initiatives.
* 3+ years' experience in operations, manufacturing, distribution, or warehouse environments, with demonstrated leadership in complex, multi-site networks and strong knowledge of engineering support models in high-volume, customer-facing operations.
* Proven success leading continuous improvement initiatives that deliver measurable business impact to ensure safety while improving cost, performance, service level, throughput or capacity.
* Advanced technical proficiency in Excel and/or Access
* Strong working knowledge of AutoCAD and Warehouse Management Systems
* Exceptional leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and change management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, and lead through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree.
* Strong experience with Power BI, SQL, and other data mining tools preferred.

  
Req Benefits: ID Logistics offers a generous benefits package for eligible associates to include 401K with match, Health, Vision, Dental and vacation and sick time. Compensation is determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, internal equity, and geographic location. The posted range is presented to illustrate variables within these factors.

records.title: Director of Quality
records.description:
**Director of Quality**

Job Type: Full time - Permanent

Location: Bethel, CT📍

A global, private equity backed medical device contract manufacturer is growing fast. With around 20 ISO 13485 certified sites, they make the precision components and sub-assemblies inside many of the world's leading medical devices, from laser-processed nitinol to thin-wall tubing. They're now looking for a Director of Quality to lead product quality and QMS compliance at one of their largest manufacturing sites.

**What you'll do:**

* Own manufacturing quality performance end to end, partnering with Operations to build quality into daily production
* Drive SPC, process capability and data-led problem solving directly on the manufacturing floor
* Lead validation strategy (IQ/OQ/PQ) and quality for New Product Introduction, from development into full-scale production
* Keep the QMS inspection-ready against ISO 13485 and 21 CFR 820, and host FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Be the senior quality contact for high-visibility customers and lead the supplier quality program
* Build, mentor and train a quality team in tools like pFMEA, Gage R&R, RCA and CAPA

**What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or management
* 7+ years in a medical device quality management role
* Hands-on manufacturing quality leadership in an ISO 13485 / 21 CFR 820 environment
* Experience hosting FDA inspections and ISO audits
* Lean and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt
* Contract manufacturing, finished device assembly, sterilization oversight, eQMS / ERP and CQA (preferred)
* Willingness to travel around 25%

This is a chance to lead quality at a flagship site within a high-growth medtech manufacturer, with real influence on how quality scales across a global network.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing
records.description:
***Custom Fabrication & Assembly Manufacturing | Southeast Alabama***
**Location:**
Dothan, AL (Onsite).
*Relocation assistance is available.*
**Compensation:**
$165,000 to $180,000 base, plus 10% annual bonus
 
 
**Reports to:**
President, Signage Division
 
 
**Team:**
Top leader on site for a custom manufacturing facility with approximately 125 employees across welding, metal fabrication, CNC, forming, electrical, and assembly
 
 
**Required**

* 7+ years of hands-on manufacturing leadership experience with direct responsibility for plant-level performance, whether as a Director of Manufacturing, Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or similar role
* Experience leading a labor-intensive, high-mix, low-volume operation such as a job shop, fabrication, or build-to-order environment. Broad manufacturing judgment matters more than deep expertise in any single process
* A track record of improving throughput, labor efficiency, quality, and on-time delivery through steady, practical improvements while keeping production running
* Working knowledge of manufacturing cost, including labor standards, earned hours or standard costing, and how floor performance shows up in a plant P&L
* Strong floor presence and the ability to earn trust with a long-tenured workforce, build real buy-in, and hold people accountable when the reasons for falling short do not add up
* Experience building repeatable systems and a leadership structure that keep a plant running dependably without relying on any one person
* Resourcefulness and comfort delivering results in a lean environment without large corporate engineering or support teams behind you
* Clear, professional communication with executive and finance leadership, including regular reporting on plant performance
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands-on manufacturing experience will be considered
* Genuine comfort relocating to and leading in a small Southern community

**Nice to Have**

* Background in custom fabricated products such as signage, store fixtures, displays, architectural metals, or electrical closures
* Industrial engineering training or a similarly technical, process-focused background
* Experience in a private equity-backed or recently acquired manufacturing business
* Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement experience applied in a practical, hands-on way
* Experience scaling production capacity, including adding shifts or growing output in a constrained labor market

**The Opportunity**
Our client is a private equity-backed national company that designs, builds, and installs branded products for well-known multi-site businesses across North America. This role leads their primary manufacturing facility in Southeast Alabama, a custom, build-to-order operation where a skilled team works hands-on with aluminum, steel, and electrical components, producing a wide variety of products in small lots.
 
 
The plant has made steady progress in recent years, with lower costs, better quality, and more reliable delivery. The next step is a strong, hands-on leader who can keep that momentum going and take the operation further. This is not a turnaround and not a maintenance role. It is a long-term opportunity to increase output, keep improving cost and efficiency, and build an operation that runs dependably every day.
 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Own plant performance: Lead every aspect of the facility, including safety, quality, throughput, delivery, and cost, with accountability for the plant P&L.
* Lead from the floor: Spend a good part of every day in production, getting to know the people, understanding what drives them, and building the trust that makes change stick.
* Find early wins: In the first 90 days, learn how the factory runs, stabilize performance, and identify practical process changes that make work easier for the people on the floor.
* Drive throughput and cost: Partner with the division President and finance leadership on a multi-year plan to increase output and reduce manufacturing cost, then deliver against it.
* Build repeatable systems: Put processes, metrics, and a leadership structure in place that let the plant run reliably without intensive oversight or dependence on any single person.
* Develop the team: Coach and grow the existing leadership group, including long-tenured leaders who know the product inside and out, and shape the structure the plant needs going forward.
* Hold the line on accountability: Understand the work well enough to see past excuses, set clear expectations, and follow through consistently.

**Why This Role Is Different**
This is the top leadership seat on site. The division President is based in another state, so this person will have real ownership and autonomy over how the plant runs, along with a leadership team that is invested in their success and has done this job before.
 
 
You will not be starting from scratch. The plant has a solid foundation, a clear direction, and the backing of a growing national platform and patient, long-term ownership. The opportunity is to take what has been built and make it better, with room to put your own mark on the operation.
 
 
**The Culture**
The plant has a loyal, tenured workforce that wants to do good work and takes pride in what it builds. The right person brings both process discipline and genuine people skills, someone who can hold the team to a high standard while building the relationships that earn real buy-in. Leadership is not looking for someone to shut things down and start over. They want a steady, visible leader who can find improvements while the work keeps moving, and who will feel at home in a close-knit, small-town Southern community.

records.title: Site Process & Manufacturing Engineering Director
records.description:
At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily - rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros, trams, maintenance services and integrated systems.

**More Than a Job: A Mission**

We seek a visionary leader to drive process and manufacturing excellence, designing and implementing advanced solutions that elevate operational performance. Join dedicated teams committed to transforming rail mobility, where your leadership shapes the future and leaves a lasting legacy.

**Your Role, Your Impact**

* Lead scalable process improvements to optimize manufacturing efficiency and support growth.
* Foster cross-functional collaboration between engineering, production, and quality teams.
* Ensure reliability and compliance in manufacturing operations through robust systems.
* Champion innovation by introducing new technologies and methodologies.
* Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across the site.

You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility, ensuring seamless integration of business and technology.

**What You Bring**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or related field**
 .
* **Extensive manufacturing (industrial) engineering experience (ideally minimum 8-10 years), including proven leadership responsibilities**
 .
* Experience in working with an ERP (such as SAP) for Bill of Materials, Routings, Configuration follow-up.
* Working knowledge of Quality and Health & Safety standards and systems.
* Expertise in lean manufacturing, process optimization, and industrial automation.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, regulatory standards, and operational excellence.
* Proven leadership, strategic thinking, and ability to inspire high-performing teams.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Achievement of delivery timelines and strategic manufacturing goals.
* Effective collaboration and leadership across multidisciplinary teams.
* Reduction in defects, increased efficiency, and proactive troubleshooting.

**Alstom, A Great Place to Grow**

* Work with cutting-edge technology and drive strategic vision.
* Make a global impact from our West Mifflin office.
* Advance your career through continuous learning and development.

Here, progress isn't always easy but the impact is real. Because the scale is massive, the tasks are complex when the system runs, the train moves, and the city connects that feeling stays with you. And the legacy lasts.

records.description:
Want to learn more about this role and Jobot? Click our Jobot logo and follow
 
our LinkedIn page!
 
 
 
Job details:
 
**Strong engineering leader needed with extensive PCB & SMT experience / Relocation assistance available**
This Jobot Job is hosted by: Christine McNamara
 
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
 
and sending us your resume.
 
Salary: $160,000 - $180,000 per year
 
 
 
**A bit about us:**
We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Operations Leader to drive performance, efficiency, and team development within a fast-paced SMT / PCB manufacturing environment. This role will lead engineering and operations initiatives focused on continuous improvement, process optimization, and operational excellence, while developing and scaling a high-performing technical team.
 
 
The ideal candidate brings a strong Lean Manufacturing mindset, deep experience in electronics contract manufacturing (SMT/PCB), and the ability to drive accountability and measurable results across the organization.
 
 
\*\*Relocation assistance available for those not local to the area
 
 
 
**Why join us?**
Medical, Dental, Vision coverage
 
401(k) with company match
 
Relocation assistance
 
Annual performance bonus
 
Generous PTO & sick leave
 
 
 
**Job Details**
Key Responsibilities:
 
 
Operations & Continuous Improvement
 

* Lead Lean Manufacturing initiatives to improve throughput, yield, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
* Identify and drive process improvements across SMT lines, PCB assembly, and supporting operations
* Implement and sustain Lean tools (Kaizen, 5S, value stream mapping, standard work, etc.)
* Analyze production data to identify inefficiencies and drive corrective actions
* Reduce scrap, rework, and downtime through structured problem-solving methodologies

Engineering Leadership
 

* Oversee engineering activities related to process development, troubleshooting, and optimization
* Partner with production to resolve complex technical and process challenges
* Support new product introductions (NPI) and ensure smooth transition into production
* Drive best practices across SMT processes including soldering, reflow, pick-and-place, inspection, etc.

Team Development & Leadership
 

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers, technicians, and support staff
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement
* Establish clear KPIs and performance metrics for engineering and operations teams
* Identify skill gaps and implement training / development plans

Cross-Functional Collaboration
 

* Partner with quality, supply chain, and production leadership to align operational goals
* Drive collaboration between engineering and manufacturing teams to improve execution
* Support customer needs and ensure alignment with delivery and quality expectations

Qualifications:
 
 
Required:
 

* 7–10+ years of experience in electronics contract manufacturing (SMT / PCB environment required)
* Proven leadership experience managing and developing technical teams (engineering or maintenance)
* Strong background in Lean Manufacturing / Continuous Improvement
* Hands-on experience with SMT processes (pick-and-place, reflow, inspection, etc.)
* Demonstrated success driving operational efficiency, process improvements, and accountability
* ITAR eligibility required; experience working in an ITAR-regulated environment is a strong plus
* Individual must be a US Citizen due to ITAR regulations

Preferred:
 

* IPC certification (IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721, etc.)
* Experience with high-mix, low-volume or high-speed production environments
* Exposure to automation, process engineering, or advanced manufacturing technologies

Interested in hearing more? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button.
